jobs.title: Manager NPD (Skincare & Haircare)
jobs.description:
**Job Title:**
Manager NPD (Skincare & Haircare)

**Location:**
New Delhi, India

**Company:**
MARS Cosmetics

**About MARS Cosmetics:**

MARS Cosmetics is a globally recognized beauty brand that thrives on innovation, diversity, and empowering individuals through high-quality beauty solutions. Headquartered in New Delhi, MARS Cosmetics is committed to offering groundbreaking products that meet the ever-evolving needs of consumers worldwide.

**Role Summary**

Own end-to-end skincare and haircare product development from concept to launch, driving formulation, packaging, claims, costing, timelines, and cross-functional execution with internal teams and 3P manufacturers.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Lead the NPD pipeline across skincare (serums, gels, emulsions) and haircare (shampoos, conditioners, masks, oils, scalp treatments, styling): identify opportunities, build briefs, define hero claims/USPs, and execute launch plans.
2. Manage formulation development with 3P labs/OEMs, from prototypes and performance benchmarks through stability, finalization, and scale-up.
3. Translate consumer problems into measurable product targets (e.g., hydration, brightening, anti-hairfall, anti-dandruff, frizz control, scalp oil control).
4. Drive packaging development: component selection (pumps, droppers, flip-tops), compatibility and leakage/transport testing, artwork readiness, and vendor coordination.
5. Own product quality and performance: sensorial targets (texture, foam, slip, rinse feel), fragrance direction, efficacy and claims substantiation inputs, safety, and QA handover.
6. Build and control timelines using stage-gates; manage risks, iterations, and stakeholder alignment.
7. Own product costing (COGS/BOM): target pricing, value engineering, MOQ planning, and margin guardrails.
8. Coordinate regulatory readiness for India, including labeling/claims compliance and documentation with RA/QA partners.
9. Benchmark competitors and global trends (actives, delivery systems, textures, formats) and convert them into actionable specs.

**Requirements**

1. 4–8 years in skincare and/or haircare NPD (brand side or OEM/ODM), with multiple launches shipped.
2. Strong formulation and packaging understanding: emulsions/gels/serums for skincare; surfactant systems, conditioning polymers, silicones, and oils for haircare; compatibility and stability basics.
3. Experience running vendor cycles with Indian/China/SEA partners, including iteration discipline, negotiation, and scale-up execution.
4. Strong project management; comfortable with BOM, COGS, MOQ, margin targets, and launch scorecards.
5. High ownership, fast execution, and strong cross-functional communication.

jobs.title: Senior manager - Sensory & Consumer Insights
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About us:**
With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations. Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other. Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
**About The Function**
Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world. With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships. It’s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers’ hands, you’ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Senior Manager, Sensory Science**
Diageo India Bangalore Research & Development
  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
**Sensory strategy and governance:**
Define sensory strategy, protocols, standards and governance across innovation, renovation, quality and commercialization.
  
  
**Sensory study design:**
Design fit-for-purpose sensory studies for product development, benchmarking, quality, claims and consumer understanding.
  
  

* Panel leadership: Recruit, train, calibrate and manage expert sensory panels; establish panel performance monitoring and accreditation.

**Innovation support:**
Translate sensory and consumer insights into product design direction for aroma, taste, mouthfeel, balance, aftertaste and overall experience.
  
  
**Consumer and flavour intelligence:**
Integrate consumer insights, market trends, launched products, food-service inspirations and expert inputs into innovation pipelines.
  
  
**Quality and manufacturing support:**
Support sensory quality governance, first batch approvals, specifications, investigations and corrective actions across units.
  
  
**Claims substantiation:**
Design evidence to support sensory claims such as smoothness, refreshment, taste superiority, flavour notes and differentiation.
  
  

* Digital and analytics: Drive use of digital sensory platforms, dashboards, automated reporting and AI-enabled insight tools.

**SENSORY EXPERTISE REQUIRED**


* Descriptive Analysis / QDA, consensus profiling and product benchmarking. Discrimination testing: Triangle, Duo-Trio, Tetrad, Paired Comparison, A-not-A and similarity testing.
* JAR, Penalty Analysis, CATA/RATA, preference mapping and drivers of liking.
* Threshold studies: detection, recognition and JND; sensory shelf-life and product matching.
* Panel performance assessment, repeatability, reproducibility, agreement analysis and training design.
* Strong understanding of flavour chemistry, ingredient functionality, aroma-taste interactions and mouthfeel.

**STATISTICAL AND DIGITAL CAPABILITY**


* Strong working knowledge of ANOVA, Mixed Models, PCA, PLS, Cluster Analysis, DOE, Penalty Analysis and Preference Mapping.
* Ability to convert complex sensory and consumer data into clear business recommendations.
* Hands-on experience with tools such as XLSTAT, JMP, R, SPSS, Compusense, RedJade, EyeQuestion or equivalent platforms.
* Comfort with data visualization, dashboards, automated analysis and AI-enabled insights tools.

**QUALIFICATION AND EXPERIENCE**
**Education:**
Master's or PhD in Sensory Science, Food Science, Food Technology, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Consumer Science, Statistics or related discipline.
  
  
**Experience:**
6-8 years in Sensory Science, Product Development, Flavour Science or related R&D roles.
  
  
**Industry background:**
Beverages, alcohol, spirits, RTDs, flavours, food, FMCG or consumer products preferred.
  
  
**Panel experience:**
Proven experience in building, managing and governing expert sensory panels in innovation and quality contexts.
  
  
**Leadership Competencies**

* Strategic and consumer-centric mindset with strong scientific rigour.
* Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders across R&D, Marketing, Quality, Supply, Regulatory and external partners.
* Strong communication, storytelling and ability to simplify data for leadership decisions.
* High ownership, accountability, result orientation and comfort working through ambiguity.
* Coaching mindset with the ability to build capability across R&D, Quality and manufacturing teams.
* Curiosity for flavours, consumers, culture, product trends and emerging technologies.

**EXTERNAL AND INTERNAL INTERFACES**
**Internal:**
R&D, Product Development, Innovation, Marketing, Quality, Supply, Regulatory, Legal, Procurement, Commercial and manufacturing units.
  
  

* External: Flavour houses, sensory and consumer research agencies, fermentation experts, ingredient suppliers, universities, start-ups, mixologists and brand ambassadors.

**SUCCESS MEASURES**


* Sensory insights influencing key innovation, renovation and quality decisions. Consumer-preferred and differentiated products delivered to market.
* Strong sensory panel capability and governance across R&D and manufacturing units.
* Faster, more confident product development and commercialization decisions.
* Robust sensory evidence for claims and product communication.
* Improved sensory consistency across manufacturing sites.
* Successful adoption of digital sensory systems, dashboards and analytics.

**Working with us**
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.Ready to bring your best This could be your opportunity.
  
  
*If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.*
**Recruitment Scam Warning**
*Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.*

**Company Description**
Syngenta Bioscience Private Limited (SBPL) is one of Syngenta's three global Research & Technology centers, our Goa facility stands at the forefront of agricultural innovation. Our world-class team specializes in developing novel active ingredients, pioneering sustainable synthesis routes and advancing cutting-edge chemical technologies. We have diverse scientific talent pool, with deep expertise in organic chemistry, drives solutions that enhance global food security and sustainable agriculture. At SBPL Goa, we combine scientific excellence with meaningful career growth opportunities, contributing directly to Syngenta's mission of feeding a growing world sustainably.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Purpose**
Lead the Analytical team of 5 to 6 scientists in delivering reliable, timely and compliant analytical support to Product Chemistry, Formulation Development, Technology & Sourcing, Manufacturing and Quality. The role requires strong technical expertise, structured problem solving, people leadership, and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Technical and Operational Excellence**

* Lead analytical testing, method development, validation, transfer, verification and troubleshooting activities for active ingredients, intermediates, formulations and relevant raw materials.
* Ensure methods, instruments, laboratory systems and data meet applicable Quality, Health Safety and Environment (HSE), Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and data-integrity requirements.
* Provide expert scientific judgement for complex deviations, out-of-specification results, investigations, root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions.
* Drive laboratory efficiency, robustness and continuous improvement through fit-for-purpose technologies, standardization, automation and lean ways of working.
* Ensure high-quality technical reports, analytical documentation and defensible scientific data to support product, process and regulatory decisions.
* Manage laboratory resources, priorities, capacity, equipment readiness and budget to meet agreed service levels.

**People Leadership**

* Build a capable, engaged and inclusive Analytical team through clear objectives, regular feedback, coaching and performance management.
* Develop technical capability, succession pipelines and individual development plans using structured learning, peer learning and on-the-job experience.
* Promote a culture of scientific curiosity, ownership, collaboration, safety, quality and continuous improvement.
* Recruit, retain and develop talent; ensure appropriate competency assessment and training for laboratory roles.
* Lead by example in applying Syngenta behaviours and creating a respectful, diverse and rightful working environment. The internal people-management framework highlights talent development, coaching and inclusive leadership as core expectations.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner closely with Product Chemistry, Process Technology, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Supply, HSE and external laboratories/suppliers.
* Translate business and technical needs into clear analytical strategies, plans, priorities and realistic delivery commitments.
* Communicate complex analytical findings clearly and influence decisions at project, site and regional levels.
* Manage stakeholder expectations proactively, escalating risks, resource constraints and technical issues early with practical options for resolution.
* Represent Analytical in cross-functional project teams, audits, technical reviews and customer/regulatory interactions where required.

**Key Interfaces**
Internal: Product Chemistry, Process Technology, Manufacturing, Quality Assurance/Quality Control, Regulatory Affairs, HSE, Production & Supply Chain, Research, HR and Finance.
  
  
External: Contract research/testing laboratories, equipment vendors, consultants, auditors and regulatory bodies.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* A PhD or Post Doc with specialization in Analytical Chemistry is preferred OR Organic chemistry or allied sciences qualification with high exposure to analytical and or formulation activity from a reputed institution in India or abroad. A 10+ years of experience analytical laboratory experience, including 5+ years leading teams or technical workstreams. OR
* Master’s degree in chemistry preferable analytical or allied Science, area from the reputed Universities with strong academic records and good communication skills Typically, 15+ years of relevant analytical laboratory experience, including 5+ years leading teams or technical workstreams.
* Deep practical experience with chromatographic and spectroscopic techniques, e.g., HPLC/UPLC, GC, LC-MS/GC-MS, IC, UV-Vis, IR and particle/physical-characterisation techniques as relevant to the function.
* Demonstrated experience in analytical method lifecycle management, validation, transfer, stability/support testing, data review and investigation leadership.
* Experience working in a regulated quality environment (GLP etc.,) and leading stakeholder-facing technical projects.

**Essential Competencies**

* Technical expertise: recognised analytical subject-matter expertise; sound scientific judgement; disciplined problem-solving.
* People leadership: develops people, gives clear feedback, manages performance and builds inclusive, accountable teams.
* Stakeholder management: communicates with influence, builds trust and aligns diverse functional priorities.
* Delivery focus: plans effectively, manages risk and resources, and delivers to agreed quality, cost and timeline commitments.
* Continuous improvement: challenges inefficient practices and converts learning into sustainable laboratory improvements.
* Quality, safety and integrity: demonstrates uncompromising commitment to HSE, quality systems and data integrity.

**Additional Information**
**People are at the heart of what we do:**

* Once a year Full body check

* Paid Vacation of 30days, 12 Paid Holidays, Maternity and Paternity Leave, compassionate leaves
* Education assistance – for your career growth

Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. jobs.title: Assistant Manager – Gummies & Nutraceuticals (R&D)
jobs.description:
Job Description | Mosaic Wellness Pvt. Ltd. | Research & Development
  
  
**Role at a glance**
Mosaic Wellness is hiring an Assistant Manager to own gummy and nutraceutical development, from bench formulation to commercial launch.
  
  
**Position**
Assistant Manager – Gummies & Nutraceuticals
**Function**
Research & Development (New Product Development)
**Location**
Thane West, Mumbai
**Reports to**
Head of R&D
**Experience**
6–10 years in nutraceutical R&D, including hands-on gummy development
**Education**
M.Sc. (Science) or M.Tech in a relevant discipline
**Travel**
Regular visits to CDMO and supplier sites across India
**Employment**
Full-time
  
  
**About Mosaic Wellness**
Mosaic Wellness is a Mumbai-based, digital-first health and wellness company. Its consumer brands, including Man Matters, Be Bodywise and Little Joys, serve men’s, women’s and children’s health and nutrition needs.
  
  
Our R&D team develops science-led nutraceuticals, functional foods and personal care products with manufacturing partners across India. Gummies are a key format across the portfolio.
  
  
**Role purpose**
You will own gummy and nutraceutical products end to end: formulation on the bench, scale-up at CDMOs, and a stable, compliant commercial launch.
  
  
The role solves the hard problems of the gummy format: high active loads, taste masking, sugar reduction, texture and shelf-life stability. You will be R&D’s point person for this category across brands, working closely with Brand, Quality, Regulatory, Procurement and manufacturing partners.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Formulation and product development**

* Develop gummies across gelling systems (gelatin, pectin, carrageenan, agar, starch), including vegan, sugar-free and reduced-sugar variants.
* Formulate with demanding actives: vitamins, minerals, botanicals, probiotics, prebiotic fibres and other high-load ingredients.
* Engineer taste and texture through bitterness masking, flavour and acid profiling, chew optimisation, colour stability, sanding and oil coating.
* Design out gummy failure modes: sweating, stickiness, crystallisation, syneresis, heat deformation, browning and active degradation.
* Extend expertise to other formats as needed: powders and sachets, tablets, capsules, effervescents and chewables.

Mosaic Wellness Pvt. Ltd. | Page of
  
  

* Run bench trials, Design of Experiments (DoE) and sensory evaluations, with complete lab records.

**Process development, scale-up and tech transfer**

* Define critical process parameters: cook temperature and solids (°Brix), deposit pH and temperature, deposit weight, curing conditions and final water activity.
* Lead pilot, scale-up and first commercial batches on starch mogul and starchless depositing lines at CDMO sites.
* Prepare tech-transfer packages: formula, bill of materials, process flow, Master Formula Record inputs and specifications.
* Troubleshoot weight variation, tailing, mould sticking and yield loss to deliver right-first-time commercialisation.

**Stability, quality and analytics**

* Design accelerated and real-time stability studies under ICH-aligned conditions (including Zone IVb, 30 °C/75% RH) to set overages and shelf life.
* Write raw material, packaging and finished-goods specifications; review analytical data with in-house teams and NABL-accredited labs.
* Select packaging for moisture and oxygen protection, backed by water-activity and moisture-sorption data.
* Lead root-cause analysis and CAPA for deviations, out-of-specification results and consumer complaints.

**Regulatory and documentation**

* Keep formulations and labels compliant with FSSAI’s Health Supplements and Nutraceuticals Regulations (2022), Labelling and Display Regulations (2020) and AYUSH norms where relevant.
* Check ingredient permissibility, RDA-based limits and label claims; prepare technical dossiers, including for Non-Specified Food approvals.
* Support export-market requirements (e.g., GCC, US 21 CFR) with Regulatory Affairs.

**Ingredients, partners and cost**

* Scout and qualify new ingredients, technologies and suppliers, and develop alternate sources for supply resilience.
* Assess CDMO capability and build strong technical partnerships with manufacturing and ingredient partners.
* Hit COGS targets through formulation and process value engineering, without compromising efficacy or sensory quality.

**Collaboration and team**

* Translate brand and consumer briefs into technical briefs, and deliver launches on the NPD calendar with cross-functional teams.
* Guide and mentor junior scientists, and share learnings across R&D.
* Track global gummy and delivery-format trends, and contribute to patents and scientific publications.

**What We’re Looking For**
**Education**
**One Of The Following**

* M.Sc. in Food Science and Technology, Food and Nutrition, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biotechnology or Pharmaceutical Sciences
* M.Tech in Food Technology, Food Engineering, Chemical Engineering or Pharmaceutical Technology

Mosaic Wellness Pvt. Ltd. | Page of
  
  
**Experience**

* 6–10 years in R&D or NPD for nutraceuticals, health supplements or functional foods, at a consumer brand, nutraceutical company or CDMO.
* At least 3 years of hands-on gummy development, with products taken from concept to commercial launch.
* Scale-up experience on mogul or starchless depositing lines, in-house or at a CDMO.
* A track record of stability-led formulation, setting overages and shelf life for vitamins, botanicals or probiotics.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong grasp of hydrocolloid and sugar/polyol science: gelation, pH and calcium sensitivity, glass transition, crystallisation and water activity.
* Confident with analytical data: assay and HPLC results, moisture and water activity, texture analysis and microbiology.
* Working knowledge of FSSAI nutraceutical and labelling regulations, GMP and HACCP.
* Structured experimentation (DoE), clear technical documentation and crisp reporting.
* Able to run several projects, CDMOs and stakeholders in parallel.

**Good to have**

* Experience with tablets, capsules, softgels, powders or effervescents alongside gummies.
* Probiotic, high-fibre, high-load or centre-filled gummy development.
* Work with microencapsulated actives or other novel delivery formats.
* Exposure to export regulations: US 21 CFR 111, GCC (GSO) or EU.
* Experience in a D2C or fast-growing consumer health company.
* Patents or peer-reviewed publications.
* Statistical tools such as Minitab, JMP or Design-Expert.

**What Success Looks Like In The First 12 Months**
Within a year, gummies are a dependable, scalable platform for Mosaic’s brands.
  
  

* Gummy and nutraceutical launches delivered on the NPD calendar, scaled up right first time at CDMOs.
* Every launched SKU meets label claim through shelf life, backed by robust stability data.
* Measurable COGS savings from value engineering on existing products.
* A stronger gummy platform: documented process windows, qualified alternate suppliers and fewer quality complaints.

**Why join**
You get real ownership, scientific depth and room to grow.
  
  

* Own a key format end to end, with direct influence on what reaches consumers.
* Work in a lean, decentralised R&D team where scientists own their projects and decisions sit close to the bench.
* Grow beyond gummies into nutraceuticals, functional foods and novel delivery technologies.
* Build your scientific profile through patents and publications, alongside leaders with deep global CPG experience.

**Seed Production Research and Stock Seed Manager- Jalna (Maharashtra)**
A strong seed supply foundation begins with effective stock seed management, high-quality seed production research, and close coordination across breeding, production, and supply chain teams. This role is critical in taking informed decisions on New product introduction (NPI’s) and ensuring the timely availability of quality stock seeds and driving continuous improvement in seed production processes.
  
  
**Make a Difference as a Seed Production Research & Stock Seed Manager**
As a
**Seed Production Research & Stock Seed Manager**
, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing stock seed management and seed production research activities to support breeding, product development, and commercial seed production objectives. jobs.title: Coffee Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Coffee Program Manager**

**About the Role:**

We're looking for a Coffee Program Manager who can do two things equally well: dream up drinks people want to talk about, and build the systems that let multiple outlets execute them exactly the same way, every time. This role does not include roasting or green coffee sourcing — that sits with our Head Roaster and Quality Team. Your world is the bar: recipes, technique, equipment, training, and the guest-facing experience across every location. This is a role for someone who gets genuinely excited about a new milk texture or extraction tweak, but who also can't stand watching a great drink get executed inconsistently three miles away.

**What You'll Own:**

**Menu & Drink Development**

● Design and test new beverages (espresso-based, batch, seasonal, non-coffee) from concept to menu-ready

● Stay ahead of trends and translate them into drinks that fit our brand and margins

● Partner with the Head Roaster and Quality Team to build drinks around each roast's strengths

● Run tastings and calibration sessions to pressure-test new recipes before rollout

**Operations & Consistency**

●
Build and maintain SOPs and recipe specs (dial-in parameters, pour ratios, milk temps, presentation) so every outlet produces the same cup

● Design and run training programs for baristas and shift leads, including onboarding and skill certification ● Set up quality-control checks (cupping, spot audits, secret-shopper visits) across all outlets

● Manage equipment standards and maintenance schedules to eliminate variance from bad kit

● Own recipe costing and pour costs; balance creativity against margin targets

**Cross-Outlet Execution**

● Visit outlets regularly to audit execution against spec, not just review reports

● Create feedback loops so issues at one location get fixed everywhere, not just patched locally

● Coordinate menu rollouts and timing across all locations so launches land together

● Assist with B2B Accounts and Quality Programs where required

● Conduct Coffee Workshops when required (Customer Facing)

**What You Bring**

● 3+ years managing a multi-location beverage or coffee program, or equivalent experience running a high-volume single site with clear ambition to scale

● A track record of drinks you've created that actually shipped and sold

● Deep hands-on espresso/bar craft — a genuinely trained palate that can dial in, identify defects, and talk origin characteristics

● Systems thinking: your default is “how do I make this repeatable,” not just “how do I make this good once”

● Comfortable building training materials, SOPs, and checklists from scratch

● Basic P&L literacy — pour cost, recipe costing, labor impact of menu decisions

● Willingness to travel regularly between outlets

**Nice to Have**

● Experience working alongside a dedicated roasting/quality team and large team of Baristas

● Competition or judging experience (barista competitions, cupping certifications)

● Experience launching a new outlet's bar program from zero

● Experience with a range of equipments such as semi-automatic and automatic

jobs.description:
**Reporting to:**
Director; working closely with Production, R&D, Purchase, Stores, Engineering, Fulfilment and Finance

**Employment:**
Full-time

**Location:**
CC Manufacturing Unit, Bangalore (Onsite)

**Experience:**
6+ years in Quality Assurance / Food Safety, including at least 2 years in a managerial role

**Working Days:**
Monday to Saturday

**CTC:**
Up to ₹10 LPA + Benefits

**Role Purpose**

To lead and take overall responsibility for Quality Assurance, Food Safety and Quality Management Systems at CC Pet Foods, ensuring that all manufactured products consistently meet defined quality, nutritional, safety, regulatory and customer requirements.

He/ she will establish and drive a preventive, process-oriented quality culture across raw material sourcing, manufacturing, packaging, storage and dispatch.

The role is accountable for developing robust quality systems, managing the QA team, ensuring regulatory compliance, preventing product failures and driving the company's First Time Right and Zero Compromise on Food Safety philosophy.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Quality Management Systems & Regulatory Compliance**

* Own, implement and continuously improve the factory-wide Quality Management System (QMS).
* Develop and enforce SOPs, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Hygiene Practices (GHP), HACCP plans and food safety controls.
* Lead implementation, certification and maintenance of ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000 or equivalent food safety management systems.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian regulatory requirements, relevant BIS standards, customer specifications and internal quality policies.
* Establish quality policies, inspection standards, testing protocols and acceptance criteria across manufacturing operations.
* Lead internal, external, customer and certification audits, ensuring timely closure of non-conformities.
* Maintain complete, accurate and audit-ready quality documentation.

**2. Raw Material & Supplier Quality Management**

* Establish quality specifications and acceptance standards for meat, poultry, fish, organs, vegetables, grains, flours, oils, supplements, additives and packaging materials.
* Own incoming material inspection, testing, acceptance, rejection and quarantine procedures.
* Ensure compliance with approved specifications, Certificates of Analysis (COA), temperature requirements and other quality parameters.
* Lead supplier quality qualification, evaluation, audits and performance improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate with Purchase and Stores to address supplier quality issues and establish corrective actions.
* Ensure material traceability, proper storage conditions and FIFO/FEFO compliance.
* Develop risk-based inspection and sampling plans for critical raw materials.

**3. Manufacturing Process Quality Assurance**

* Own in-process quality assurance across wet food, baked products and dehydrated treats manufacturing.
* Establish and monitor critical quality parameters and process controls across weighing, mixing, cooking, baking, dehydration, cooling, filling and packaging.
* Ensure manufacturing compliance with approved formulations, process specifications and batch records.

* Review laboratory reports, investigate out-of-specification results and approve corrective actions.

* Define, monitor and report quality KPIs to senior management.

* Identify recurring process deviations and implement preventive improvements.
* Participate in equipment commissioning, process validation, new product trials and manufacturing scale-up.
* Collaborate with Production, R&D, Engineering and Procurement to improve product consistency and manufacturing efficiency.
* Promote data-driven quality decisions and continuous improvement across departments.

**9. QA Team Leadership & Department Management**

* Lead, mentor and develop the Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams.
* Define department structure, responsibilities, manpower requirements and shift coverage.
* Set performance objectives, review team performance and develop technical capabilities.
* Establish training programmes covering GMP, HACCP, hygiene, quality inspection, documentation and food safety.
* Manage the QA department budget, laboratory expenses and quality-related resources.
* Build a culture of accountability, integrity, disciplined execution and continuous improvement.
* Ensure independent and objective quality decisions, including escalation of critical food safety risks to management.

jobs.title: Head Roaster
jobs.description:
**Location:**
Panchkula (Tricity), on-site at the roastery. Relocation support provided
**Type:**
Full-time, leadership role
**Compensation:**
₹1.5 – 3 lakh per month, depending on depth of experience. We'll go to the top of the range for the right person.
**Reports to:**
Sharang, Founder

**Bloom Coffee Roasters**
is a B2B specialty roastery supplying 500+ café and brand partners across India. We roast on multiple commercial roasters. Our partners are café owners, F&B operators and serious coffee professionals, people who can't afford bad coffee.

The next chapter is simple to say and hard to do: roast exceptional coffee, prove it on the cupping table every day, and train the baristas who serve it so the cup in the café matches the cup on our table.

**The Role**

You'll own what leaves the roastery. Every profile, every batch, every bag that goes to 500+ cafés carries your signature. You'll build the roasting and quality program, lead cupping as a daily discipline, and work alongside our training team to turn roasting decisions into recipes baristas can actually nail.

This is not a production-line job. It's the person who decides what "good" means at BCR, and then makes it repeatable.

You'll also partner with our founders to set up the
**Bloom Academy**
, and you'll own its roasting program from day one.

What you will do

**Roasting**

* Own roast profiling on our roasters across espresso blends, single origins, filter and limited lots.
* Run production roasting at scale (hundreds of kg a day) with no drop in consistency: roast goals, reference curves, batch logs, color etc.
* Use roast software to set roast goals, track deviation batch by batch and keep reference curves up to date.
* Own green coffee inventory management: stock levels and purchase planning. Re-profile as new harvests land, and manage relationships with our planters and estates.
* Plan the roast schedule against sales orders with the production team.

**Cupping and Quality Control**

* Lead daily QC cupping. No profile goes into production without your sign-off.
* Evaluate offer, pre-shipment and arrival samples. Grade green and decide which lots go into which product.
* Write down our QC protocols, set consistency targets and track defects from batch to batch.
* Run sensory calibration sessions so the roastery, training and sales teams taste with the same vocabulary.
* Build direct relationships with producers: farm visits, cuppings at origin and processing trials where they make sense.

**Leadership**

* Train and mentor the roasting team, and grow junior roasters into leads.
* Set roasting and quality standards, write them down and make sure they're followed.
* Represent BCR's roasting in public: competitions, partner cuppings, events and content.

**What we're looking for**

**Must-haves**

* 5+ years in specialty coffee, including at least 2–3 years leading roasting or QC at a specialty roastery.
* Hands-on profiling on commercial drum roasters at production scale. Experience across different roaster types is a big plus.
* A daily cupping habit and a calibrated palate: you can grade green and score coffee.
* Data discipline: roast logs, roast goals and deviation tracking in Artisan or similar.
* Bar experience, past or present: you can dial in a grinder, build a recipe and teach it to a barista.

**Strong Pluses**

* Q Arabica Grader, or SCA Roasting / Sensory at Intermediate or Professional level.
* Green sourcing: worked with Indian estates, evaluated pre-shipment and arrival samples, or bought lots directly.
* Processing or fermentation trials with producers.
* Built a training program, training modules or a coffee academy.
* Competition experience as a competitor, coach or judge.
* International experience is a big plus: time at a specialty roastery outside India.

**Why BCR?**

1. **Scale with standards:**
   your work reaches 500+ cafés and the people drinking in them.
2. **Real backing:**
   a team that treats roasting and training as the core of the business, not a side function.
3. **Room to build:**
   you'll shape the QC system, the Bloom Academy's roasting program and the roasting culture from the top.
4. **Top-of-market pay**
   for someone who is genuinely excellent. What you're paid will reflect your capability and what you bring to the table — not a standard salary band.

How to apply

Email your CV or LinkedIn profile to careers@bloomcoffeeroasters.in with the subject "Head Roaster", or send us a DM with your resume!

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to Panchkula for a roasting and cupping session with the team.

*Serious Coffee People. For those who can't afford bad coffee.*

jobs.description:

We are excited to announce an opening for Sr. Manager, AIDLC at ACI. Please find below the details of the role and its responsibilities.

**Roles & responsibilities:**

* Own the AIDLC (AI-driven development lifecycle) workstream end to end: roadmap, delivery and outcomes. You report to the AI First head.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**E-Commerce Manager**

**| Online Business & Marketplace Operations**

**Role Details**

**Designation**

**E-Commerce Manager**

work from office

**Working Days / Hours**

10:00 AM to 06:30 PM

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Marketplace Business & Account Management**

* Own day-to-day operations and account coordination across Myntra, Nykaa D, Purplle and Zepto.
* Maintain effective working relationships with marketplace KAMs and functional contacts across cataloging, marketing, supply chain and claims.
* Track marketplace issues, resolve operational blockers and escalate pending commercial, listing, PO or supply-chain matters to the relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain marketplace-specific trackers, workflow sheets, reference files, monthly plans and communication threads.

**2. Sales Reporting, Analysis & Business Tracking**

* Monitor sales performance and update the daily sales tracker where applicable, including daily Zepto sales and Myntra sales feeds, and weekly Purplle sales tracking.
* Prepare and update monthly sales reports, including item-code/SKU-wise and L3/category-wise contribution.
* Update the CTS Google Sheet and account workings on an excluding-GST basis, coordinating with the relevant sales and accounts stakeholders.
* Track sales against agreed plans and targets; identify gaps and share performance updates with internal stakeholders.

**3. Catalog, Listing, Assortment & Product Lifecycle**

* Manage marketplace cataloging and listing workflows, including Myntra listing templates and style-ID master updates.
* Ensure the Myntra master file is maintained with EAN, style ID, SKU name, MRP and active/inactive status, and shared monthly as required.
* Keep Nykaa D catalog information aligned with Nykaa.com and coordinate quarterly SKU additions after reviewing tail SKUs.
* Conduct quarterly SKU/NPI reviews for Zepto and maintain assortment additions and discontinuations.
* Monitor listing health, product visibility, offer display and pricing on marketplace apps/websites.

**4. Pricing, Discounts, Offers & Promotional Planning**

* Check Myntra portal discounts three times daily and flag any displayed discount that breaches the applicable approved ceiling.
* Maintain discount and price-off files, upload approved discounts in the relevant portals and align offers with marketplace POCs and calendars.
* Maintain Purplle BAU and IHB offer structures and coordinate discount alignment with the Purplle POC.
* Manage Zepto discount uploads using the approved Zepto Master and ensure the on-invoice discount and additional discount are handled within approved policy.
* Coordinate with the Brand Manager and relevant teams on annual/periodic Joint Business Plan (JBP) targets, marketing plans and claim slabs for Nykaa D.

**5. Purchase Orders, Inventory & Supply Chain**

* Track marketplace POs and ensure they are received, reviewed and actioned within the platforms operating cadence.
* Reconcile inventory against open POs weekly for Myntra and Purplle, and follow up on shortages, pending orders and delivery issues.
* Coordinate Nykaa D weekly POs and obtain month-start stock-on-hand (SOH) and sales reports from the KAM.
* Coordinate Zeptos twice-weekly POs and resolve supply-chain or lead-time issues with the internal supply-chain team and marketplace SCM contacts.
* Follow up on POs for newly listed Myntra SKUs within the SOP-defined 1520-day timeline.

**6. Marketing, Visibility & Performance Advertising Coordination**

* Coordinate marketplace visibility plans and campaign requirements with marketplace marketing POCs.
* Work with the Performance Marketing/Ads team on PLA and PREP activity, as applicable; ensure budgets are management-approved.
* Close and review Zepto PLA visibility monthly and pursue FOC on-site visibility against PLA investment where applicable.
* Align monthly visibility on the Superstore by Nykaa app and coordinate relevant Purplle visibility/PREP plans and settlements.
* Maintain marketing decks, discounting files, listing guidelines, NPI files and monthly plans.

**7. Commercials, Claims, Settlements & Reconciliation**

* Verify marketing-investment and discount debit notes (DNs), claims and supporting workings before approval/sign-off, as applicable to each marketplace.
* Coordinate with MKKLs online and Accounts-Receivable teams for discount and advertising settlement checks.
* Track Nykaa D JBP claims against pre-agreed slabs and coordinate applicable visibility, discount and claim settlements.
* Coordinate Purplle visibility, MOQ, discount and PREP settlements with the marketplace POC; flag discrepancies for resolution.
* Coordinate the applicable 1% West Bengal TOT claim with the Accounts team for Nykaa D.
* Maintain an audit-ready record of approved discounts, claims, bills, DNs, settlement status and supporting files.

jobs.description:
**Company overview:**

PEP is a dynamic personal care company that proudly houses two innovative brands **mCaffeine & Hyphen**. With a passion for creating high-performance, conscious, and consumer-loved products, we are redefining the way personal care is experienced. While mCaffeine is Indias first caffeinated personal care brand, loved for its energizing and playful approach, Hyphen is built on the philosophy of simplifying skincare through science-backed formulations. Together, our brands reflect PEPs mission to deliver quality, creativity, and care to millions of consumers. We believe in Confidence over all skin & body biases.

**Come, join the pack!**

  

**Job Summary :** We're looking for a **Lead - R&D (Hair Care)** to own formulation and development for our Hair Care portfolio — shampoos, conditioners, hair masks, hair oils, hair serums and scalp care. This is a senior, hands-on role for a formulator who has built and launched multiple hair care products and understands surfactant chemistry, conditioning science and scalp health in depth. * 7–10 years of hands-on cosmetics/personal care R&D experience, with hair care as the primary focus
* Proven track record of personally formulating and launching shampoos, conditioners, hair oils, masks and/or scalp care products

* Experience with hair performance testing and hair fall / anti-dandruff claims substantiation

jobs.title: Decision Analytics Consultant - Commercial Analytics + AI Engineering
jobs.description:
ZS  is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by **bringing together data, science, technology** and **human ingenuity** to deliver better outcomes for all. Here youll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a **client-first mentality** to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

;

**Insights Analytics  ;**

**ZS's  Insights Analytics  group**    partners with clients to design and deliver solutions to help them tackle a broad range of business challenges. Our teams work on multiple projects simultaneously,  leveraging  advanced data analytics and problem-solving techniques. Our recommendations and solutions are based on rigorous research and analysis underpinned by deep  expertise  and thought leadership.  ;

  
  
 ****The role****    

A build-and-advise role. You lead build pods on AI-enabled analytics products and independently own core commercial analytics problems for the same client teams. Expect roughly a 60/40 split between AI engineering and core analytics, flexing with the release cycle. You own workstream-level delivery, manage 24 Associates / Associate Consultants, and are the day-to-day technical counterpart for client analytics and enterprise-AI stakeholders.

This is not a pure AI/ML engineering role. When build demand is low, you are staffed on core analytics workstreams for the same client; when it is high, you lead the build. Both halves are required.

;

**What  Youll    Do**  ;

* ****AI analytics engineering (~60%)****    
  + Own end-to-end build of insight pipelines on Databricks: certified Delta tables metric layer signal detection LLM narrative application surface.
  + Design agentic workflows on an agent SDK (Claude Agent SDK or equivalent): tool design, context and prompt engineering, governed context stores, fallbacks and failure handling.
  + Enforce guardrails in data and metadata governed tables, SQL-level scope control rather than in prompt instructions.
  + Build evaluation harnesses for LLM output: answer-quality rubrics, binary gates (numerical fidelity, grounding, compliance), regression suites, release gates; tracing via Langfuse/LangSmith or equivalent.
  + Deliver conversational analytics (NL-to-SQL) on governed semantic layers (Databricks Genie, Metric Views) with certified KPI definitions.
  + Set engineering standards: code review, Git/CI, unit and SIT test plans, UAT support, release notes, observability, cost and latency tracking.
  + Produce architecture documents, security / IT-risk evidence packs and status reporting with honest status legends (implemented / in-flight / planned / blocked).  
    
   ****Core commercial analytics (~40%)****    
  + Take ambiguous questions from any client function commercial, medical, market access, clinical development, supply chain, enterprise operations and structure them into decision-oriented analytical plans; own them end to end.
  + Pick the method the question needs diagnostic analysis, cohort and longitudinal analysis, segmentation, forecasting, test-and-control and causal inference, predictive modelling, optimisation and defend the choice.
  + Work across the client's data estate syndicated and patient-level real-world data, clinical and trial data, engagement and CRM data, payer and access data, operational and financial data integrating sources and resolving definitional conflicts.
  + Establish governed definitions (KPIs, cohorts, business rules) with the client and make them enforceable in code one definition, every surface.
  + Convert results into decisions: QC'd, client-ready narratives and decks; activation into workflows, dashboards or products; present to Director+ stakeholders.  
    
   ****Client team leadership****    
  + Plan, review and coach a team of 24; QC everything before it reaches the client.
  + Own workstream status, risks and dependencies with ZS leadership and client PMO.
  + Contribute to proposals, POVs and CST capability building reusable assets and AI upskilling of CST talent.

**;**  ;

**What  Youll  Bring**  ;

* A bachelors or masters degree in engineering (any discipline) with strong academic performance, particularly in analytics and quantitative coursework
* 5 8 years of relevant job experience. An MBA/PhD may substitute in lieu of work experience
* **SQL expert.** Window functions, cohort and longitudinal logic, performance tuning on claims-scale data.
* **Python production-grade.** pandas/PySpark, packaging, testing, Git; you have owned code others depend on.
* **Lakehouse platform** Databricks (Delta, Unity Catalog, Spark, Workflows) or comparable (Snowflake/BigQuery + Spark).
* **LLM application engineering** Prompt and context engineering, RAG, function/tool calling, agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph or equivalent), evaluation and monitoring. You can explain how your system failed and what you changed.
* **Applied analytics** solving business problems in a stakeholder-facing role, spanning more than one method family: diagnostic and cohort/longitudinal analysis, segmentation, test-and-control / causal inference, forecasting, predictive modelling; statistical rigour and explicit QC. Life-sciences or healthcare analytics experience strongly preferred any function (commercial, medical, market access, clinical development, operations); hands-on with real-world data (claims, EHR, registries), clinical/trial or engagement data a plus.
* **Consulting skills.** Structure ambiguity, own deliverables end to end, communicate crisply in PowerPoint, Excel and in the room.
* **People leadership.** Has led 2+ people on delivery with accountability for their output quality.
* Fluency in English
* Client-first mentality
* Intense work ethic
* Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

* Monitor complaint trends and ensure timely closure of field issues.

* Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support to dealer service teams.

* Monitor KPIs related to field complaints, warranty claims, and dealer performance.

* Reduction in repeat field complaints.
* Reduction in warranty claims and warranty costs.
* Timely closure of field issues.
* Dealer technical support response time.

* Team management and leadership abilities.

**Job Title:** Production Manager- Sanitary Pads & Hygiene Products

**Location:** Pune

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Department:** Production/ Operations

**Reports To:** Managing Director

**CTC:** 10-15 LPA

**Direct reports**: Production, Maintenance & Engineering, Quality Assurance / Quality Control, Planning & Stores, EHS, Plant HR/Admin (via functional heads)

**Company Description:**

Xolopak India Ltd is a pioneering company in manufacturing sustainable consumable products for HORECA, Bakery and Home/Personal care industry in India. We operate in B2B and institutional business within this segment and have a pan India presence. Our products include single use wooden cutlery, ice-cream sticks and spoons, cake bases, Silver Pouches, luxury napkins etc. Our prestigious customers include some of the largest brands in the food and ice-cream industry.

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a seasoned production Manager to lead end-to-end plant operations for our sanitary napkin and personal hygiene product lines. The role carries full ownership of production, quality, cost, safety, compliance and people, and is accountable for delivering output at the required quality, yield and cost, with a strong focus on high-speed sanitary pad conversion lines.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Production & Operations Management**

* Lead daily plant operations across sanitary pad lines (including ultra-thin, XL and overnight variants) and allied hygiene products such as baby diapers, adult incontinence products, panty liners and wipes, where applicable.

* Ensure achievement of production plans, OEE, line efficiency, throughput and on-time delivery targets.

* Drive reduction of material wastage, rejections, downtime and changeover time across converting, packaging and secondary packing lines.

* Work with Planning, Sales and Supply Chain on production scheduling, capacity planning and demand fulfilment.

**2. Quality & Regulatory Compliance**

* Maintain product quality in line with BIS standards (IS 5405 for sanitary napkins), and applicable FDA/medical-device-type and customer specifications.

* Ensure GMP, hygiene-zone discipline, clean-room and contamination-control practices suitable for products in contact with the body.

* Lead implementation and maintenance of ISO 9001, ISO 13485 (where applicable), ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certifications, and prepare the plant for customer, regulatory and third-party audits.

* Oversee root cause analysis, CAPA, complaint investigation and change control.

**3. Technical & Process Leadership**

* Provide deep technical oversight on raw materials (fluff pulp, SAP, nonwovens, release paper, films, adhesives, hot melts) and their impact on product performance.

* Lead process optimisation, new product trials and scale-up in coordination with R&D and Quality.

* Evaluate, select and commission new machinery; oversee installation, validation and stabilisation of new lines.

* Drive automation, digitisation (MES, SCADA, vision inspection) and modernisation of lines.

**4. Maintenance & Engineering**

* Ensure high equipment uptime through preventive and predictive maintenance, spare-parts planning and TPM practices.

* Oversee utilities including compressed air, HVAC, dust extraction, steam and power, with a focus on energy efficiency.

* Manage capex projects for capacity expansion, debottlenecking and replacement.

**5. Cost, Budgeting & Financial Management**

* Own the manufacturing budget, conversion cost, material yield and cost-per unit targets.

* Drive continuous improvement through Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen and 5S to improve productivity and reduce cost.

* Track and report plant KPIs and MIS to senior management on a regular basis.

**6. Environment, Health & Safety**

* Create and sustain a zero-harm safety culture; ensure statutory compliance under the Factories Act and related labour, pollution-control and fire-safety laws.

* Oversee waste management, effluent and emissions compliance, and sustainability initiatives (including waste reduction and recyclability).

**7. People Leadership**

* Build, mentor and retain a high-performing team of engineers, supervisors and operators.

* Drive skill development, succession planning, multi-skilling and a strong performance culture.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Education: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Chemical, Production, Industrial, Polymer or Paper & Pulp Engineering. MBA or PG diploma in Operations Management is an advantage.

* Certifications (preferred): Lean / Six Sigma Black Belt, internal auditor for ISO standards, TPM.

**Preferred Experience:**

* 18–25 years of manufacturing experience, with at least 8–10 years in a senior plant or operations leadership role.

* Must have extensive, hands-on experience in sanitary pad manufacturing; experience in baby diapers, adult diapers or other medical / personal hygiene products is strongly preferred.

* Proven track record of running high-speed converting lines, commissioning new lines and managing multi-line plants.

* Experience managing large teams (200+) in a regulated, high-volume FMCG or healthcare manufacturing environment.

**Key Skills & Competencies:**

* Strong knowledge of absorbent hygiene product (AHP) processes: fluff pulp defibration, SAP dosing, core forming, lamination, embossing, ultrasonic and thermal bonding, adhesive application, cutting, folding, wrapping and packing.

* Familiarity with leading machine suppliers and technologies in the hygiene industry.

* Strong command of OEE, TPM, Lean, Six Sigma and data-driven problem solving.

* Sound understanding of GMP, quality systems, regulatory norms and audit readiness.

* Capex planning, vendor negotiation and project management ability.

* Excellent leadership, decision-making, communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* Production volume vs plan, OEE and line efficiency

* Material yield and wastage percentage

* Cost per unit and conversion cost vs budget

* Quality metrics: customer complaints, rejection rate, audit findings

* On-time delivery and order fulfilment

* Safety performance (LTIFR, incidents) and compliance record

* Attrition, training hours and talent development

--------------------

**Position: Executive – NPD**
=============================

**New Product Development (Confectionery)**
===========================================

**Department:** Product and Technology Development (PTD)
  
**Category:** Confectionery
  
**Location:** NPD Laboratory, Greater Noida
  
**Reporting To:** Senior Manager

### **1. Job Purpose**

To support New Product Development activities in the confectionery category through hands-on laboratory work, prototype preparation, sample development, product evaluation and execution of R&D trials. The position will be primarily based in the NPD laboratory and responsible for ensuring timely preparation of quality prototypes, lab report preparation and samples as per project requirements.

### **2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Laboratory Prototype Development**

* Prepare laboratory-scale prototypes for various confectionery and its allied products as per project briefs and technical requirements.
* Execute product formulation, ingredient weighing, mixing, processing and sample preparation.
* Support the development of new product concepts, flavors, textures, shapes and variants.
* Work on product modifications and formulation adjustments based on feedback from internal stakeholders.
* Maintain consistency and reproducibility of laboratory prototypes.

**B. Sample Preparation & Management**

* Prepare product samples for internal evaluations, sensory assessments, consumer testing and customer presentations.
* Ensure proper labelling, coding, packaging and storage of prototype samples.
* Maintain sample records, formulation details and development history.
* Coordinate timely dispatch and availability of samples for different stakeholders.

**C. Laboratory Trials & Equipment Handling**

* Conduct laboratory trials using confectionery processing equipment and laboratory tools.
* Operate and maintain laboratory equipment while following established operating procedures.
* Ensure proper cleaning, sanitation and maintenance of laboratory equipment and workstations.
* Support pilot-scale and factory trials whenever required.

**D. Documentation & Data Management**

* Maintain accurate records of formulations, raw material consumption, trial observations and process parameters.
* Prepare laboratory trial reports and maintain sample tracking records.
* Update formulation sheets, trial logs and product development databases.
* Ensure proper documentation and traceability of all development activities.

**E. Raw Material & Inventory Management**

* Maintain laboratory raw material inventory and ensure availability of ingredients required for development activities.
* Monitor raw material consumption, expiry dates and storage conditions.
* Coordinate with procurement and warehouse teams for raw material requirements.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of food ingredients as per recommended conditions.

**F. Quality, Safety & Hygiene**

* Follow food safety, personal hygiene and laboratory safety practices.
* Ensure cleanliness and housekeeping of the NPD laboratory.
* Identify and report any deviations in raw material quality or laboratory processing.
* Follow established SOPs and maintain good laboratory practices.

**G. Cross-functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with NPD team members for timely execution of development projects.
* Support Marketing, Quality, Production and other stakeholders in sample preparation and product evaluation.
* Incorporate feedback from sensory evaluations and internal product reviews into subsequent prototypes.

### **3. Key Skills & Competencies**

* Hands-on experience in food product development or confectionery laboratory operations.
* Basic understanding of confectionery ingredients, formulations and processing techniques.
* Practical knowledge of weighing, mixing, heating, forming, depositing and sample preparation.
* Good observation, analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Basic computer knowledge (MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint).
* Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple sample development requirements and timelines.
* Good communication and coordination skills.

### **4. Educational Qualification**

* M.Tech in Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy Technology or related disciplines.

### **5. Experience**

* **Preferred experience:** 2–5 years in Food R&D, New Product Development or laboratory operations.
* Experience in confectionery products such as gummies, jellies, hard-boiled candies, toffees, lollipops or similar categories will be preferred.
* Freshers with strong practical knowledge and relevant academic exposure may also be considered.

### **6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely preparation and delivery of prototype samples.
* Accuracy and consistency of laboratory formulations.
* Successful execution of assigned laboratory trials.
* Accuracy and completeness of trial documentation.
* Effective management of laboratory raw materials and inventory.
* Compliance with laboratory hygiene, safety and housekeeping standards.
* Responsiveness to internal sample development requirements.

### **7. Nature of Role**

This is a hands-on, laboratory-oriented position requiring regular involvement in prototype preparation, product development experiments, sample handling and laboratory operations. The incumbent will be primarily stationed at the NPD laboratory and will support factory/pilot and factory trials as and when required.

New Product Development

Food Science

Food Technology

Lab handling

jobs.title: Manager Group Demand Planning
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

DÖHLER – WE BRING IDEAS TO LIFE.®  
Döhler is a global producer, marketer and provider of technology-driven natural ingredients, ingredient systems and integrated solutions for the global food, beverage and life science & nutrition industry. Döhler is all about mastering sensory experience and nutritional performance. Being sustainable by nature, Döhler helps to nourish the world better: Good for people – Good for planet.

 **Job Description**

The Data Scientist – Demand Planning & Supply Chain Analytics (m/f/d) is part of the Demand Planning function within Global Business Services (GBS) and is responsible for developing and improving data-driven forecasting, planning, and decision-support solutions for the assigned portfolio.  
The role combines advanced analytics, statistical modelling, and machine learning with business understanding to improve forecast accuracy, supply chain visibility, service levels, inventory performance, and planning efficiency — with particular focus on continuously improving the statistical (base) demand forecast that underpins Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP/IBP).  
The position acts as a bridge between Sales, Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Finance, IT, and business stakeholders by translating complex data into actionable insights and scalable analytical solutions.  
The role has no disciplinary responsibility and reports to the Manager Demand Planning.  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
Your Responsibilities  
1. Demand Forecasting & Advanced Analytics  

* Develop, maintain, and improve statistical forecasting and machine-learning models for demand planning.
* Integrate statistical forecasts with market intelligence, customer information, commercial input, promotions, and business assumptions.
* Analyze historical demand, trends, seasonality, outliers, demand variability, and forecast bias.
* Identify the key drivers influencing demand and quantify their impact on forecast performance.
* Evaluate and improve forecasting approaches through back-testing, scenario analysis, and model benchmarking.
* Monitor forecast accuracy, forecast value added (FVA), bias, and other relevant planning KPIs.
* Challenge forecast figures from the business, other regions, and intercompany sources using data-driven insights.
* Support the definition and implementation of Make-to-Stock, Make-to-Order, or related supply strategies through analytical recommendations.
* Develop demand scenarios, sensitivity analyses, and risk assessments to support tactical and strategic decision-making.

2. Multi-Source Demand Signal Analysis & Reconciliation  

* Provide the analytical basis for combining multiple demand signal types into one coherent base forecast, including contracted/committed volumes, Lead-to-Order (LTO) pipeline volumes, customer-specific forecasts, and material-level statistical forecasts.
* Analyze and quantify the certainty, time horizon, and granularity differences between demand signal types, and provide data-driven recommendations to support the design and calibration of the demand hierarchy/waterfall logic owned by Demand Planning.
* Identify and flag inconsistencies, double-counting, or gaps between top-down (customer/portfolio) and bottom-up (material/SKU) demand layers, and provide analysis to support their resolution.
* Analyze historical LTO pipeline conversion behavior (e.g., conversion rates, typical phase-in timing) to support appropriate probability-weighting of pipeline volumes relative to contracted volumes.
* Analyze historical patterns of how annual/yearly contract volumes split into monthly (or other sub-annual) quantities, to improve the time-phasing accuracy of contracted demand.
* Analyze and document how incoming customer orders consume the statistical/base forecast over time (forecast consumption logic), and identify opportunities to improve its accuracy and transparency.
* Analyze how push-driven (“crop-driven”) business — volume determined by raw material availability/harvest timing rather than pull demand — is incorporated into the forecast, and run dedicated analytics to improve its treatment and accuracy.

3. Data Preparation & Quality Management  

* Ensure the quality, consistency, and completeness of demand, customer, material, sales, inventory, and supply chain data.
* Perform history cleansing and establish robust processes for identifying and treating outliers, one-off events, stock-outs, and exceptional demand.
* Support the integration of new customers, materials, products, flows, and data sources into IBP and related planning systems.
* Manage and improve statistical forecast parameters, including model selection, aggregation levels, time horizons, and forecast frequencies.
* Monitor data pipelines and investigate data inconsistencies affecting planning outputs.
* Establish standards for data preparation, documentation, version control, and reproducible analysis.

4. Business Partnership & Decision Support  

* Translate business questions and planning challenges into analytical requirements and practical data science solutions.
* Interface with Sales, Account Management, Business Units, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Finance, Controlling, and Operations on forecasting and planning topics.
* Support the analysis of business complaints relating to forecasts and new product introductions.
* Collaborate with Sales and R&D to obtain and validate LTO pipeline data at the appropriate stage of maturity for inclusion in the combined demand forecast.
* Analyze open contract quantities against call-offs and forecast figures in collaboration with Account Managers and business stakeholders.
* Support the development of a single, aligned forecast across Sales, Finance, Demand Planning, and Supply Chain.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer collaboration and create longer-term visibility of customer demand.
* Present analytical findings, assumptions, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Build strong working relationships and promote data-driven decision-making across the organization.

5. Strategic Planning & Modelling  

* Develop future demand projection models to support the five-year planning process.
* Support tactical and strategic demand planning for regional capacity analysis and capacity-related conclusions.
* Perform product and customer lifecycle analysis, including new product introductions, phase-ins/phase-outs, portfolio changes, and monitoring relevant system and master-data changes.
* Support business scenario planning, including demand upside/downside scenarios, supply constraints, customer changes, and market risks.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and process improvement in demand planning and IBP.
* Develop dashboards, reports, and self-service analytical tools for planning and business stakeholders.
* Ensure analytical solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business and IT standards.

 **Qualifications**

* Completed degree in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Applied Economics, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable quantitative field.
* 3–5 years of professional experience in data science, advanced analytics, demand planning, supply chain analytics, forecasting, or a related field.
* Strong expertise in statistical forecasting, time-series analysis, predictive modelling, and trend analysis.
* Practical experience applying machine-learning techniques to business or supply chain problems.
* Strong programming skills in Python or R.
* Good knowledge of SQL and experience working with structured and large-scale datasets.
* Experience with data visualization and dashboarding tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent.
* Sound understanding of demand planning, IBP/S&OP, supply chain processes, inventory management, and forecast performance measurement.
* Experience working with ERP, APS, IBP, or planning sys

jobs.description:
**Job Title**: Chemical Engineer – Pilot Plant & Production

**Department**: Production / Pilot Plant

**Location**: Andheri East, MIDC

**Reports To**: Project Manager & Production Manager / Plant Head

**Experience**: 1–4 years

**Qualification**: B.E. / B.Tech/ M. Tech in Chemical Engineering

**Purpose of the Role**

To support the scale-up of processes from the R&D laboratory to the pilot plant, participate in the installation, inspection, commissioning and operationalization of process equipment, and thereafter supervise safe, efficient and compliant plant operations. The role is critical to achieving reliable output, yield, quality, safety, and cost targets during the transition from laboratory development to pilot-scale operations.

**Company Context**

We are scaling up a precious metal refining process from a laboratory sale to a pilot plant. The process involves glass and glass-lined reactors, corrosive chemical systems, precious metal-bearing materials, and stringent requirements for containment, material recovery, safety, and traceability.

**Key Responsibilities-**

**Pilot Plant Installation & Commissioning**

* Actively participate in the scale-up process from a laboratory sale to a pilot plant.
* Review equipment specifications, layouts, P&IDs, utility requirements, and material-of-construction suitability against process requirements.
* Verify that installed process equipment meets design, process, safety, and quality requirements.
* Participate in pre-commissioning checks such as inspection, leak testing, calibration verification, utility readiness, instrumentation checks, and trial runs.
* Support commissioning, start-up, stabilization, and performance testing of pilot-plant systems.
* Identify installation gaps, equipment issues, or process deviations and coordinate corrective actions with engineering, vendors, maintenance, and R&D teams.
* Prepare and maintain commissioning documentation, equipment logs, SOPs, batch records, and operating instructions.

**Pilot Plant Operations & Supervision**

* Plan, supervise, and execute daily pilot-plant operations as per approved batch sheets, SOPs, and production schedules.
* Operate and supervise reactor systems, ensuring correct procedures and SOPs are followed
* Monitor critical process parameters and take timely corrective action where required.
* Ensure safe handling and transfer of chemicals in the process streams.
* Maintain accurate batch records, production logs, raw-material consumption records, metal accounting inputs, and daily pilot-plant reports.
* Coordinate with R&D, Quality, Maintenance, Stores, EHS, and Dispatch to ensure smooth material flow and minimal downtime.
* Troubleshoot process deviations, equipment issues, and quality concerns; conduct root-cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Optimize yield, reduce process losses, improve equipment utilization, and support recovery of valuable materials.
* Train and supervise operators and technicians on safe operating procedures, glassware handling, emergency response and process controls.

**Safety, Compliance & Continuous Improvement**

* Ensure strict adherence to EHS requirements, statutory regulations, pollution-control norms, PPE discipline, and safe work practices.
* Ensure proper handling, storage, labeling and disposal of hazardous chemicals, process residues, and waste streams.
* Support risk assessments, HAZOP reviews, incident investigations, and management-of-change activities for new or modified equipment and processes
* Participate in ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, customer, and safety audits; close audit observations within defined timelines.
* Drive continuous improvement through Lean, 5S, Kaizen, and structured troubleshooting initiatives.
* Support new-product trials, process validation, scale-up studies, and technology transfer from R&D to pilot plant.

**Required Skills**

* Strong fundamentals of chemical engineering, including mass and energy balance, fluid flow, heat transfer, reaction engineering, and process instrumentation.
* Hands-on understanding of pilot-plant and production equipment and associated piping and utilities.
* Practical knowledge of installation checks, commissioning activities, equipment trials, and plant start-up.
* Ability to read and interpret P&IDs, equipment drawings, SOPs, batch sheets, and technical specifications.
* Understanding corrosive chemical handling, hazardous-process safety, containment, and emergency procedures.
* Familiarity with precious-metal processing will be an advantage.
* Awareness of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 management systems.
* Good documentation, coordination, problem-solving, and team-supervision skills.
* Willingness to work at the plant site and support shift-based pilot-plant operations when required.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided

Work Location: In person

**Jubilant Pharmova Limited**
-----------------------------

Jubilant Pharmova Limited (formerly Jubilant Life Sciences Limited) is a company with global presence that is involved in Radiopharma, Allergy Immunotherapy, CDMO Sterile Injectables, Contract Research Development and Manufacturing Organisation (CRDMO), Generics and Proprietary Novel Drugs businesses.

In the Radiopharma business, the Company is involved in manufacturing and supply of Radiopharmaceuticals with a network of 46 radio-pharmacies in the US. The Company’s Allergy Immunotherapy business is involved in the manufacturing and supply of allergic extracts and venom products in the US and in some other markets such as Canada, Europe and Australia. Jubilant through its CDMO Sterile Injectables business offers manufacturing services including sterile fill and finish injectables (both liquid and lyophilization), full-service ophthalmic offer (liquids, ointments & creams) and ampoules.

The CRDMO business of the Company includes the Drug Discovery Services business that provides contract research and development services through two world-class research centres in Bangalore and Noida in India and the CDMO-API business that is involved in the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients. Jubilant Therapeutics is involved in Proprietary Novel Drugs business and is an innovative biopharmaceutical company developing breakthrough therapies in the area of oncology and autoimmune disorders. The company operates six manufacturing facilities that cater to all the regulated market including USA, Europe and other geographies.

**The Position**
----------------

**Job** **Summary****:**

The Project Financial Analyst supports financial governance, risk management, and cost control for pharmaceutical R&D and CapEx projects, including manufacturing and equipment sourcing. This role manages multi-million-dollar budgets, ensures timely execution, and provides strategic financial analysis and reports to senior leadership. Serving as the primary financial partner to Project Managers, Engineering, Clinical Development, and Operations globally, the analyst supports financial discipline and data-driven decisions. They also collaborate with CMOs for expenditure accounting during projects.

------------------------

* Maintain baseline budgets during development and construction and enforce change controls to prevent unauthorized spending
* Conduct monthly variance analysis comparing actual costs to budgets and adjust for timing, price, scope, or inefficiencies
* Assist in cost estimates and tracking for new and multi-year projects while maintaining SAP records

* Identify financial risks early and create dashboards with KPIs to alert teams and management
* Present monthly and quarterly variance reports explaining financial impacts of delays

* Monitor contractor billings, equipment, and vendor costs to prevent cost overruns
* Oversee Construction in Progress (CIP) account tracking and transition to fixed assets
