About the Role

AHS International Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced and skilled Associate R&D Manager to lead and support research and development activities, particularly in **Nutraceutical and Powder Formulations**.

The candidate will be responsible for developing new products, improving existing formulations, conducting trials, evaluating raw materials, and ensuring product quality, stability, taste, and regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge of powder formulation, nutraceutical ingredients, product development, and manufacturing processes.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Product Development & Powder Formulation**

* Develop new nutraceutical and dietary supplement formulations, especially powder-based products.
* Develop formulations for protein powders, whey protein blends, health supplements, nutraceutical powders, and other wellness products.
* Improve and optimise existing formulations for better quality, stability, taste, solubility, and cost-effectiveness.
* Conduct laboratory-scale trials, pilot batches, and support commercial-scale production.
* Work on product innovation according to market trends and management requirements.

**2. Research & Ingredient Study**

* Research and evaluate nutraceutical ingredients, raw materials, dosage levels, and their applications.
* Study ingredient compatibility, nutritional values, functionality, and safety limits.
* Identify and evaluate suitable raw materials and suppliers in coordination with the procurement team.

**3. Quality Control & Product Testing**

* Ensure product quality, stability, consistency, taste, texture, and solubility.
* Conduct formulation trials and evaluate product performance.
* Troubleshoot formulation and manufacturing-related issues.
* Coordinate with the Quality Control and Quality Assurance teams to maintain product standards.

**4. Regulatory & Compliance Support**

* Ensure formulations comply with applicable FSSAI nutraceutical regulations.
* Verify permitted ingredients, dosage limits, and regulatory requirements.
* Handle product label verification and review nutritional information, ingredient declarations, and product claims.
* Maintain proper R&D documentation, formulation records, and trial reports.

**5. Team & Department Coordination**

* Coordinate with manufacturing, quality, procurement, regulatory, and marketing departments.
* Guide and support the R&D team in formulation development and product trials.
* Monitor product development activities and ensure timely completion of projects.
* Prepare technical reports and present product development updates to management.

Required Skills

* Strong expertise in nutraceutical and dietary supplement formulation.
* Practical experience in protein powder and other powder formulations.
* Knowledge of whey protein, plant protein, vitamins, minerals, amino acids, and functional ingredients.
* Understanding of powder blending, mixing, solubility, stability, and flavour development.
* Knowledge of laboratory trials, pilot batches, and commercial production.
* Understanding of FSSAI regulations and product label verification.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, research, and team management skills.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Candidates with hands-on experience in nutraceutical, food supplements, sports nutrition, or health and wellness product manufacturing.
* Candidates having practical expertise in protein powder and nutraceutical powder formulation will be preferred.
* Experience in independently handling product development, formulation trials, and R&D activities will be an advantage.

Compensation

**Monthly Salary:** 40000 To ₹50,000 + Negotiable as per candidate profile.

**Work Location:** Agra, Uttar Pradesh  
**Employment Type:** Full Time

**Interested candidates can share their updated CV for consideration.**

As a key part of our Service Delivery operations, our catering team makes crucial decisions that enhance the customer experience and elevate our growing global brand.
  
  
As a
**Manager Culinary Development,**
you will manage the recipe, dish and menu design process to ensure Emirates remains at the forefront of global culinary trends and innovation. You will lead a centralised Culinary Development Centre of Excellence, responsible for creating, maintaining and governing the Emirates recipe bank. Working in collaboration with key stakeholders and leveraging customer insights and data, you will plan and develop network-wide menus that consistently delight our guests.
  
  
Additionally, you will plan and deliver Dubai-based culinary workshops focused on educating Emirates' global inflight and premium lounge catering partners on menu and dish preparation. In addition, you will oversee Emirates-owned food and beverage products, while developing and managing Emirates-nominated food suppliers to ensure the highest standards of quality, consistency and culinary excellence across the network. We are hiring for two distinct roles, each requiring specialist expertise in either North and South American cuisine development and innovation, or the development, standardisation and management of Special Meals (SPMLs), including Child, Medical, Religious and Allergen-Sensitive Meals.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will Be**

* Accountable for the planning and day to day management of the EK Culinary Centre of Excellence ensuring that annual targets of blue-sky cuisine innovations and individual dish creations are exceeded.
* In collaboration with the Service design team, responsible for supporting the decision making for flight/cabin level meal service standards.
* Accountable for the creation and development of detailed recipes that are conducive to performing optimally in the EK, network wide catering partner facilities.
* Responsible for documenting and version controlling all EK recipes and production methods in the EK owned, catering management system.

jobs.title: R&D and Innovation Packaging Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**
At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
  
  
**Summary:**
The R&D and Innovation Packaging Manager builds and leads a new pre-development and innovation capability within Product Operations. This role develops, pilots and proves packs, platforms and technologies before the brief, for launches two to three years ahead, so launch teams start from proven solutions instead of discovering risks late. It turns technical scouting, regulatory change such as the EU PPWR, and recurring quality issues into tested, ready-to-use solutions handed over to Packaging Development.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
:
  
  
**R&D Strategy & Portfolio**

* Build the packaging R&D roadmap for Y+2 and Y+3 launches from the Brand roadmap, consumer and retailer feedback, quality issues, COPQ and technical scouting.
* Select topics that help launches, fix what customers feel, make us different and can be ready in time.
* Manage the R&D portfolio, budget and timelines; stop topics that no longer create value.

**Platforms & Technology**

* Pre-develop functionally proven platforms in key categories (e.g., closures, applicators, mascara, gloss, compacts, pumps, airless).
* Run pilot molds, functional and compatibility tests on our formulas, then homologate with Quality.
* Prove supplier standard packs on our formulas before they are used in launches.
* Build and maintain the Packs Library: proven platforms and standards, with design rules and test files.

**Advanced Development & Innovation**

* Scout new materials, mechanisms, suppliers and manufacturing technologies in line with the roadmap.
* Take ideas to feasible concepts and prototypes, with early risk assessment and filling and assembly implications.
* Assess supplier technical and innovation capability; Procurement leads commercial terms.
* Document new technologies and flag intellectual property opportunities to Legal.

**PPWR & Sustainable Design**

* Translate PPWR design requirements (recyclability, recycled content, minimisation) into design rules, materials and platforms, with Regulatory owning the interpretation.
* Qualify recyclable, mono-material and recycled-content solutions on our formulas, for function and compatibility.
* Build PPWR-ready options into the Packs Library and the materials library for Y+2 and Y+3 launches.
* Track delegated and implementing acts with Regulatory, and update standards when they change.
* Provide technical evidence for conformity documentation; conformity sign-off for each launch sits outside R&D.

**Kaizen & Product Performance**

* Use complaints, reviews, quality trends and COPQ to target issues that repeat across products.
* Develop and test permanent improvements in application, dosing, closing, comfort and robustness.
* Turn each proven fix into updated specifications, design rules and standards

**Handover & Governance**

* Define readiness criteria for handover to Packaging Development: function proven, compatibility tested, homologated and documented.
* Hand over only proven solutions, and support the first launches that use them.
* Use our specification tool and the risk score at R&D stage, in proportion to novelty.
* Protect R&D capacity: support live launches through agreed handovers only, and escalate any trade-off to the Director.

**Leadership and Coaching**

* Build, lead and develop a small R&D team of packaging engineers and technical design support.
* Manage external partners: designers, prototyping houses, test labs and technology partners.
* Build a culture of curiosity, rigor and evidence.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategic Exposure**

* Partner with Product Development, Marketing, Design, Quality, Packaging Development, Procurement and Regulatory.
* Present the R&D pipeline, business cases and recommendations to leadership.
* Build long-term technical partnerships with innovative suppliers.

**Requirements**

* Proven record of taking new packaging concepts or technologies from prototype to industrial launch.
* Hands-on experience of pilot tooling, functional testing and formula/pack compatibility.
* Strong knowledge of materials, mechanisms and processes (injection, blow molding, assembly, decoration).
* Experience building platforms, standards or design rules used by development teams.
* Working knowledge of the EU PPWR and design-for-recycling guidelines (e.g., RecyClass).
* Network of innovative packaging suppliers and technology partners in Europe and Asia.
* Track record of building business cases and prioritizing with clear criteria.
* Able to review CAD models; experience with 3D printing and rapid prototyping.
* Track record of building a new function from scratch, with a curious, rigorous and evidence-based approach.
* 8+ years in packaging development, including significant pre-development or innovation experience in beauty, fragrance or luxury.
* Bachelor's/Master's in Packaging, Mechanical, Materials or Plastics Engineering, or Industrial Design.

**Benefits**

* Monthly "Self Love Days" - at company discretion
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting

*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

Raibal Holding is recruiting a permanent
**Group Research & Innovation Manager**
to run the Group’s research portfolio across a diversified farming platform, beginning with marine and agricultural research and extending across apiculture and livestock operations as the portfolio grows.

You will be the person who keeps the Group’s research organised, evidenced and moving: coordinating decisions on what to test, continue or stop, and making sure results reach the right destination, whether that is internal use on our farms, research services, commercial transfer or public benefit.

* **Prepare decisions:**

**What we’re looking for**

* Degree in science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent applied research experience
* Proven leadership of at least two applied research or innovation programmes, including at least one with a measured pilot or adoption result
* Background in marine science, aquaculture, agriculture, food or environmental research is strongly preferred
* Experience coordinating research partners and operating teams to deliver measurable results
* Track record of making and escalating well-reasoned recommendations, with responsibility for budgets
* Excellent written English and clear, structured communication

**Why join Raibal Holding**

A rare opportunity to build and run a Group-wide research portfolio within one of the region’s growing agriculture and farming platforms, where your work translates directly into operational improvements across multiple businesses.

jobs.title: NPI Manager
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
**About Gradiant**

Gradiant is a Different Kind of Water Company. With a full suite of differentiated and proprietary end-to-end solutions for advanced water and wastewater treatment powered by the top minds in water, the company serves its clients’ mission-critical operations in the world’s essential industries, including semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, critical minerals, and renewable energy. Gradiant’s innovative solutions reduce water used and wastewater discharged, reclaim valuable resources, and renew wastewater into freshwater. The Boston-headquartered company was founded at MIT and has over 1,400 employees worldwide. Discover us at www.gradiant.com.

**Job Overview**

* Own and lead the development of Gradiant’s mineral extraction technologies from laboratory concept through pilot validation, scale-up and commercial deployment, covering extraction, purification, concentration and conversion to the final products.
* Set the technical direction across extraction routes (e.g. sorbents/ion exchange, solvent extraction, membranes, precipitation/crystallization), lead the R&D team, and serve as the technical authority for customers, partners and internal project teams.

**Specific Duties/Responsibilities**

*Technology strategy and roadmap*

* Define and own the technology roadmap for mineral extraction, purification and conversion, aligned with business and market needs.
* Benchmark competing technologies, evaluate new chemistries (sorbents, extractants, membranes) and partner technologies, and drive IP generation.

*Lead R&D team and manage projects*

* Lead and mentor the R&D team across SG and AD Labs (scientists, engineers and interns); set priorities and guide experimental design and data analysis.
* Oversee planning, budgets, execution and tracking of projects and procurement; liaise with vendors, contractors and internal groups; prepare key presentations and reports for leadership.

*Process development and flowsheet design*

* Develop and optimize mineral extraction flowsheets for high recovery and selectivity over competing ions (e.g. Na, K, Mg, Ca, B), including impurity control, reagent/solvent management and recycle streams.
* Perform process modelling, mass and energy balances and techno-economic inputs to produce high-purity final product.

*Scale-up and technology transfer*

* Lead the progression from lab and bench scale to pilot and demonstration; design, procure and commission pilot units.
* Resolve scale-up challenges (e.g. phase separation, solvent loss, sorbent lifetime, fouling, impurity build-up, process stability) and prepare process design packages for engineering and project teams.

*Commercialization and customer support*

* Lead end-to-end application studies on real feeds (brines, produced water, leachates) from feasibility through process validation.
* Support proposals, feasibility studies and performance guarantees; provide on-site commissioning, troubleshooting and optimization at customer plants.

*Partnerships and stakeholder engagement*

* Build and manage collaborations with customers, technology providers, universities and suppliers to accelerate technology validation and deployment.
* Represent Gradiant’s mineral extraction technology in technical discussions with customers, partners and at industry forums.

**Qualification, Skills & Experience**

*Qualification*

* Ph.D. in Chemical or Environmental Engineering, Chemistry, Hydrometallurgy, Materials Science or a related discipline.
* Master’s degree with a strong industrial critical-minerals track record will also be considered.

*Skills*

* Deep expertise in at least one mineral extraction route (solvent extraction, ion exchange/adsorption, membranes or precipitation/crystallization), with working knowledge of the others.
* Process modelling and flowsheet design (mass/energy balances; tools such as Aspen, OLI or PHREEQC) and analytical methods (ICP-OES/MS, IC).
* Strong leadership, communication and customer-facing skills; able to translate technical results into business decisions.

*Experience*

* 10+ years in critical-minerals process development, including 3+ years leading technical teams.
* Proven track record taking a technology from lab through pilot to commercial or industrial operation.
* Hands-on experience in plant commissioning, troubleshooting and optimization, and in technology transfer to engineering or customers.
* Experience with industrial water/wastewater treatment and international customers is an advantage.

*Certificate*

* Preferred, not mandatory: Professional Engineer (PE/P.Eng), PMP, Lean Six Sigma or equivalent.

Gradiant is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.

We are on a journey to A Better Tomorrow™ by Building a Smokeless World. A world where smokers who would otherwise continue to smoke, have migrated to smokeless alternatives. Strategy and Purpose Brand and Innovation

The Scientific Engagement Manager APMEA West serves as the primary lead and coordinator for scientific engagement efforts in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus regions to promote uniform Tobacco Harm Reduction literacy and acceptance.

This position is vital for advancing Tobacco Harm Reduction acceptance with policy makers according to the CORA strategy and engaging the scientific community via KOLs and PHAs. It applies scientific evidence and advocacy materials to foster appropriate interaction with external scientists and regulators. The role helps develop evidence-based public policies and supports CORA on scientific and regulatory issues. It acts as BAT’s technical authority in relevant scientific regulatory activities. The role also guarantees that local APMEA West insights and evidence reach the distributed Scientific Affairs & CORA group.

In addition you will also be responsible of building nutrition capability across cross-functional teams to help our brands deliver better choices and enable Nestlé’s Purpose.

* Inspire nutrition, dietary & dietetics dimensions into business category strategy. Interpret/evaluate available knowledge and nutrition science to guide business partners and product developers.

+ Seismic Analysis and Design.

We are responsible for the end-to-end digital and physical Guest experience for all technology & digital-led initiatives across the Attractions & Entertainment, Food & Beverage, Resorts & Transportation and Merchandise lines of business as well as other initiatives including MyDisneyExperience and Hey, Disney!

In this lead role, you will guide cross-functional teams through the full project lifecycle, ensuring that digital and physical guest and consumer experiences are delivered reliably, efficiently, and with the creativity and innovation that define Disney.

**Responsibilities:**

As a Lead Tech Project Manager, you will serve as a lead and mentor for project teams, driving high-priority initiatives that support Disney Experiences’ technology and digital ecosystem across guest-facing and consumer channels. You will act as a problem-solver and team player, coordinating stakeholders, managing risk, and ensuring projects are delivered on time and on budget. This role matters because it connects technical delivery to business outcomes, requiring a subject matter expert who can communicate complex concepts clearly, influence decisions, and foster collaboration to achieve shared goals.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

jobs.title: D365 Business Central Functional Consultant
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Agrocorp International is a Singapore-headquartered agri-commodity trading and processing group operating across more than a dozen countries. Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is our core ERP platform, and we are rolling it out across group entities while deepening its use in those already live.

This is a central group role, not one tied to a single entity or site. You will lead implementations across new entities and manufacturing facilities, contribute to the redesign of our existing environment, and build the integrations and automation connecting Business Central to our wider systems landscape. The role suits someone who has moved beyond support into implementation — comfortable owning configuration and design decisions, and holding implementation partners to account on quality.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead Business Central implementations for new group entities — functional design, configuration, testing and deployment across finance, supply chain, inventory, procurement and sales.
* Implement and configure the manufacturing module for our processing plants: production BOMs, routings, work and machine centres, production orders, consumption and output posting, MRP and replenishment, lot traceability, production costing and yield variance. Support co-product and by-product costing design.
* Contribute to the redesign of our existing Business Central environment — posting processes, system logic, reporting and financial process alignment — and replace bespoke customisation with standard functionality where possible.
* Define and support integrations between Business Central and Salesforce, banking platforms, warehouse and plant systems. Own data migration: master data, opening balances, validation and reconciliation.
* Use AI tooling actively in delivery — requirements analysis, functional documentation, configuration design, test scripts and data preparation — to shorten implementation cycles.
* Design and build agentic workflows within and around Business Central to automate routine business and system processes.
* Track new Business Central features across Microsoft's release waves, assess their relevance and bring forward those that replace manual effort or existing customisation.
* Work with implementation partners and vendors, reviewing deliverables and functional specifications against agreed requirements. Act as the internal subject matter expert across the group and support site-based team members.
* Design and lead UAT, deliver user training, and provide go-live and hypercare support including on-site presence where required.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Commerce, Engineering, Supply Chain or a related field.
* 4–7 years implementing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or Dynamics NAV, with demonstrated hands-on manufacturing module experience in a live environment.
* Working knowledge of core accounting within an ERP: chart of accounts, posting groups, dimensions, period close, inventory valuation.
* Full implementation lifecycle experience — requirements, fit-gap, configuration, data migration, testing, training and go-live — including Configuration Packages / RapidStart.
* Strong documentation, analytical and stakeholder communication skills, and willingness to travel internationally for implementation phases.

**Preferred**

* MB-800 certification; process manufacturing, food or agri-processing experience.
* Understanding of AL extensions sufficient to review and specify development work.
* API and OData integration experience, particularly Salesforce to Business Central.
* Power Platform and Power BI; multi-entity, multi-currency and intercompany setups.
* Practical experience applying AI tooling or building agentic workflows in a business systems context.

jobs.title: Quality Manager, GBS
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Are you passionate about service excellence? Would you love to work for a global organization that is doing more good for people and planet?

**Job Functions**
=================

IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences, we deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.

  

Global Business Services: Delivering streamlined, scalable support—enhancing efficiency, compliance and service excellence across the company.

  

The role is based in Hyderabad, India(hybrid role). Be part of a creative, solution-oriented team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.

  

The Quality Manager leads the Quality Assurance team and drives scalable, standardized quality practices across the GBS organization. This role oversees the QA framework, leverages automation and analytics to enhance efficiency, and partners with stakeholders to translate quality insights into measurable business improvements. Through root cause analysis and continuous improvement, the role enables operational excellence and sustainable performance.

  

**Where You’ll Make a Difference**

* Lead, coach, and develop the Quality Assurance team, fostering a high-performance culture focused on quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Own and continuously enhance the GBS Quality Assurance framework, including standards, methodologies, governance, operating procedures, controls, and evaluation criteria.
* Ensure consistent, objective, and calibrated quality assessments across teams, processes, and stakeholder groups.
* Develop and execute a Quality Automation Roadmap, leveraging automation, analytics, AI, and intelligent monitoring solutions to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Establish and maintain quality reporting, KPIs, dashboards, and trend analysis to provide leadership with visibility into performance, risks, and corrective actions.
* Translate quality findings into actionable root-cause analysis, driving corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) and sustainable operational improvements.
* Partner with Operations, Process Owners, and cross-functional stakeholders to standardize quality practices, resolve systemic issues, and support the onboarding of new processes into the Quality framework.
* Identify, implement, and replicate quality best practices across functions, processes, and locations to strengthen consistency and business outcomes.
Periodically assess the effectiveness of the QA framework and influence stakeholders to advance a proactive, data-driven, and continuous-improvement-focused quality culture.  

  

**What Makes You the Right Fit**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Management, Continuous Improvement, Business Process Improvement (BPI), or related operational excellence functions.
* 2+ years of leadership experience, with a demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and lead high-performing teams.
* Experience within BPO, Contact Center, Shared Services, GBS, or similar service-oriented environments.
* Strong knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis, CAPA, process standardization, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Proven experience leading transformational change initiatives, process optimization programs, and operational improvement projects.
* Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to interpret operational and quality data, identify trends, and translate findings into actionable business recommendations.
* Excellent stakeholder management, presentation, and communication skills, with experience engaging senior leaders, executives, clients, and cross-functional teams.
Lean Six Sigma, PMO, or other quality/process improvement certifications preferred; ability to independently drive complex initiatives from concept to implementation and support business needs requiring up to 40% travel.  

  

**How Would You Stand Out?**

* Proven ability to transform Quality functions through automation, analytics, and AI-driven monitoring, reducing manual effort while increasing business impact.
* Strong track record of translating quality insights into root-cause-driven improvement initiatives that deliver measurable operational and customer outcomes.
Experience building and scaling standardized Quality frameworks across Shared Services, GBS, BPO, or Contact Center environments, driving consistency, governance, and continuous improvement globally.  

  

**Why Choose Us?**

* Play a key role in transforming Quality into a data-driven, technology-enabled function that influences business outcomes across a global organization.
* Enjoy a hybrid work model (3 days/week in office) with company-provided two-way transportation for added flexibility and convenience.
Accelerate your growth through learning and development programs, while building your career in an inclusive, collaborative environment that empowers people to learn, lead, and make a lasting impact.  

  

We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. We strive for an inclusive workplace that allows each of our colleagues to bring their authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, or disability.

Visit IFF.com/careers/workplace-diversity-and-inclusion to learn more

jobs.description:
**Product Mgr II**

**Do you want to make signing in to Elsevier products simple and secure?**

**Can you build identity and access products together with the product teams who depend on them?**

**About Our Team:-**

Our team owns Identity, Access and API Management for Elsevier. We're focused on making access to our products frictionless and secure, with modern access solutions that make customer onboarding easier and sign-in simpler, without compromising security. We work closely with the product managers of Elsevier's products, and with Technology, Design, Data, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, to solve real customer access problems. We value curiosity, innovation, and continuous improvement, and are committed to delivering exceptional experiences for our customers.

  

**About the Role:-**

As a Product Manager II on our team, you will work toward owning the end-to-end value and outcomes of identity and access features, from discovery through to delivery and adoption. You will act as the voice of the customer, using market insight, customer feedback, and data to identify opportunities and define solutions that make sign-in, onboarding and access management easy for customers, while meeting Elsevier's security and compliance bar.

  

Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will drive product requirements through specs for your feature area (using genAI and Spec-Driven Development (SDD) as part of your process), execute against the roadmap, and keep your features running well day to day. This role is ideal for a product professional who enjoys combining customer insight, a user-centric approach and data-driven decision-making. You'll partner directly with one or two engineering squads, running discovery through to delivery for your slice of the product, within an overall roadmap and prioritisation set by our Senior Product Manager for Identity and Access. From there, you'll grow into progressively larger scope, working toward owning the full arc of discovery, delivery, and outcomes for your own product area.

  

**Responsibilities:-**

* Own discovery and requirements for several product areas through the product lifecycle — including cross-product functionality (collaborating with other teams within the wider Identity and Access group) and end-to-end release process including collaboration with go-to-market.
* Work with the product managers of the Elsevier products that use your features. Identify customer problems and success measures, plan and sequence (shared) work, and make trade-offs together when identity and product priorities conflict.
* Represent Identity and Access in those product teams. Bring their needs back to the IAM roadmap, and design solutions so that what you build for one product also works for other Elsevier products.
* Collaborate with the other product managers in the Identity and Access team on cross-product functionality, so shared capabilities stay consistent across products.
* Directly support 1-2 engineering squads by answering engineering queries, using user-research insights and customer feedback to drive new product functionality, and collaborating with user experience to ensure the functionality delivered delights users.
* Gather customer insights at the source (customers, institutional admins, Customer Support) and use them, with data and market analysis, to drive product requirements and decisions.
* Own go-to-market and ongoing support for your features, including release plans and stakeholder communications for your product area
* Own how success metrics are defined and calculated, including adoption after release, ensuring they reflect business outcomes.
* Effectively prioritise customer issues, defects, and feature requests for resolution against the ongoing product roadmap.
* Monitor market trends and competitor activity in the identity and access space to inform your product decisions.
  

**Requirements:-**

* Proven Product Management experience, typically with 4-6 years in a product-focused role.
* Hands-on product experience in identity and access, for example authentication, single sign-on (SAML or OpenID Connect), user or customer onboarding, entitlements, or admin tools.
* Experience owning products, features, or significant areas of product functionality. Experience with platform products used by other product teams is a plus.
* Experience working closely with other product managers on shared roadmaps or cross-product features, including resolving conflicting priorities.
* Strong customer focus with the ability to identify and solve customer problems.
* Demonstrated success delivering product improvements with measurable business impact.
* Excellent analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation abilities, including with teams in other time zones.
* Experience working within Agile software development environments. Experience using genAI in product work is a plus.
* Commercial awareness and understanding of product strategy and business objectives.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required; a technical or business-related degree is preferred.

2. **Compliance**

Ensure product and process compliance in line with Nestlé policies, standards and legal requirements.

Ensure work place safety and effective communication of Safety, Health and Environment to all team members.

Conduct inspection / audits and investigate incidents to close gaps.

Ensure good and hygienic engineering practices are applied at all times.

Measure, analyse and improve line performance by using available systems / tools (AMM etc.)

Contribute to establishing energy and line standards.

5. **Continuous Improvement**

Support projects (team) by setting up / installation of new equipment, test run and ensuring readiness for mass production. Wherever required, participate in standard audits (HACCP, FSMS, GMP etc.)

jobs.title: Lead D&T Analyst – Commercial Capabilities
jobs.description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**

We are building and enhancing ecommerce data and technology capabilities for our North America (NAR) Sales organization. These capabilities bring together retailer, syndicated, digital shelf, and retail media data to support business reporting, analytics, and decision-making across ecommerce channels. As Lead D&T Analyst – Commercial Capabilities (Ecommerce), you will work with Sales, Ecommerce, and D&T teams to understand business requirements and support the delivery of data and technology solutions. You will contribute to the development and enhancement of ecommerce data products, dashboards, reporting solutions, and analytical capabilities. The role involves working with data engineering, BI, analytics, and technology teams to translate requirements into technical specifications, support solution development and testing, and ensure reliable delivery.Success in this role requires experience working with data and technology solutions, good problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage assigned deliverables in a collaborative environment. You will support solution quality, data validation, implementation, and ongoing improvements while working closely with business and technical partners.

  

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

You will work with Sales, Ecommerce, Operating Unit business partners, and D&T teams to understand requirements and contribute to the delivery and support of reliable data and technology solutions:

  

* Bring together retailer, syndicated, digital shelf, retail media, and other relevant data to provide NAR Sales with an integrated view of ecommerce performance; diagnose growth drivers and performance gaps.
* Frame business questions as analytical approaches, develop hypotheses, combine data sources, validate findings, and deliver evidence-based recommendations.
* Apply understanding of ecommerce business models, retailer platforms, marketplaces, quick commerce, and online grocery to identify channel performance drivers.
* Assess NielsenIQ, Circana, Numerator, retailer first-party/POS, digital shelf, and retail media data for quality, coverage, limitations, and suitability; communicate caveats.
* Measure digital shelf and retail media performance, including content quality, search visibility, availability, click-through and conversion rates, ROAS, and incremental sales where data permits.
* Partner with analysts, data engineers, project managers, BI developers, solutions architects, and business stakeholders across Sales, Ecommerce, and Operating Units to coordinate business logic and technical requirements for analytics solutions.
* Build trusted relationships across Sales, Ecommerce, Marketing, Category Management, Operating Units, and technology teams; communicate findings clearly and influence decisions.
* Serve as the ecommerce analytics SME for assigned workstreams; advise on data, processes, and solution options, and support measurement standards, data quality, and continuous improvement.
* Contribute to run, operate, and transform activities for assigned analytics capabilities, coordinating priorities, risks, dependencies, and issue resolution with partners.
* Partner with technical teams on unit and integration testing, data-quality checks, and automation; constructively challenge assumptions and support solutions that meet performance, quality, reliability, and responsiveness expectations
* Translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications, including data requirements, dependencies, expected outputs, and acceptance criteria. Seek clarification from business partners and technical teams as required.
* Support the development and maintenance of ecommerce reporting and capabilities by implementing business-defined measures and ensuring the underlying data and technology solutions are reliable and accessible. Business teams retain ownership of metric definitions and performance interpretation.
* Work with data and engineering teams to understand, validate, and integrate data from syndicated and retailer sources, including retailer first-party/POS data, digital shelf, and retail media platforms. Support data quality checks, identify and resolve data issues, and help ensure data is reliable and fit for its intended use.
* Collaborate with data engineering, data science, BI, product, and technology teams to develop and support ecommerce data products, dashboards, reporting solutions, and analytical tools, contributing to requirements, development, testing, implementation, documentation, and continuous improvement.
* Manage assigned D&T deliverables and coordinate with relevant partners to track progress, dependencies, issues, and implementation activities. Support ongoing maintenance, troubleshooting, and improvements to ensure assigned data products and technology solutions remain reliable and fit for purpose.
Contribute to a collaborative team environment by sharing knowledge, documenting solutions, supporting colleagues, and following established team practices. Demonstrate accountability for assigned responsibilities and deliverables  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Education – Full-time graduation from an accredited university (Mandatory- Note: This is the minimum education criteria which cannot be altered) with total Years of Experience 10+ years.
* 8+ years of relevant experience in Digital & Technology, data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, ecommerce technology, or related fields.
* Experience working on data, reporting, BI, or technology solutions, with responsibility for assigned deliverables, coordination, issue resolution, and implementation support.
* Good problem-solving skills, including working with multiple data sources, understanding data quality and limitations, and translating business requirements into functional or technical solutions.
Ability to communicate effectively with business and technical stakeholders, provide updates on assigned deliverables, and work collaboratively to resolve issues and support solution delivery.  

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Exposure to syndicated & retailer data, digital shelf platforms, or retail media data is preferred.
* Familiarity with ecommerce data and reporting concepts, including product content, search visibility, online availability, conversion, and retail media data.
* Working experience or exposure to cloud analytics platforms such as Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, SQL, data management, and BI tools such as Tableau. Familiarity with data integration, data warehouses, and SaaS analytics solutions is an advantage.
* Basic to intermediate understanding of CPG commercial processes and related Sales and Ecommerce data, including customer POS, category management, pricing, promotions, assortment, and market-share data.
* Exposure to agile or product-oriented delivery environments is preferred

  

**ELIGIBILITY**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

Experience: 4 - 8 Years

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Job Description:**

**Production & Process Management :**

* **End-to-End Production:** Supervise daily cheese production activities including milk standardization, pasteurization, curd preparation, cutting, molding, pressing, salting, and ripening.
* **Process Standardization:** Design and standardize critical processing parameters such as temperature, pH, coagulation, curd stretching, and syneresis (moisture control) to ensure product consistency.
* **Equipment Operations:** Operate, troubleshoot, and validate pilot-scale and industrial cheese-making equipment including cheese vats, separators, molders, and brining systems.

**Research, Development & Innovation (R&D)**

* **New Product Development:** Conceptualize, formulate, and commercialize new cheese varieties, including Mozzarella, Cheddar, Processed, Gouda, Brie, and regional artisanal cheeses.
* **Experimentation:** Innovate with adjunct cultures, enzymes, emulsifiers, and stabilizers to create differentiated flavor profiles and optimize product texture.
* **Yield Optimization:** Collaborate with production teams to scale lab trials to commercial levels while optimizing yield, cost efficiency, and quality consistency.

**Affinage (Cheese Ripening & Aging)**

* **Climate Control:** Manage cheese caves and aging facilities by strictly monitoring curing conditions like humidity (often above 90%), temperature (usually around 10°C), and aeration to promote proper microbial activity.
* **Maturation:** Turn, rotate, and apply surface treatments or washes to cheeses at appropriate intervals to maximize optimal drainage, even ripening, and flavor development.

**Quality Assurance & Food Safety Compliance**

* **FSSAI Compliance:** Ensure all formulations, packaging, and labeling comply strictly with FSSAI regulations and international food safety standards.
* **Safety Protocols:** Monitor Critical Control Points (CCP) in compliance with food safety frameworks like FSSC 22000 and HACCP.
* **Hygiene & Sanitation:** Maintain strict hygiene standards, assess environmental impact, and supervise Clean-In-Place (CIP) and manual sanitation protocols in the production area.
* **Testing:** Collaborate with the Quality Assurance team to conduct sensory evaluations, organoleptic testing, and monitor chemical/microbial properties.

**Leadership & Administration**

* **Team Management:** Train, supervise, and guide production operators and junior staff on best practices in cheese handling and safety.
* **Documentation:** Document experimental data, daily production reports, batch records, and formulation processes accurately for audits and traceability, utilizing tools like SAP or other ERP modules.

Work Location: In person

* **Senior Engineer - Mechanical**

  **Your Role:**

    

  The Senior Engineer - Mechanical is responsible for the design, development, and continuous improvement of mechanical components and products for multiple applications. The role independently leads mechanical development activities, provides technical expertise throughout the product lifecycle, and supports project execution through collaboration with customers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams. The Senior Engineer also supports less experienced engineers through technical guidance and knowledge sharing.

  + Initiate, develop, and maintain the mechanical DFMEA, dimensional management requirements, and Mechanical Special Product Characteristics.
  + If applicable, initiate and complete TALC processes for decorative components.
  + Submit product specifications, models, and drawings to Purchasing for quotation in accordance with established company processes.

jobs.description:
**Additional Information**  
**Job Number**26149935  
**Job Category**Sales & Marketing  
**Location**Sector 26, M.G. Road, Gurgaon Delhi Gurgaon Border, Gurgaon Harya 122002, India  
**Schedule**Full Time  
**Located Remotely?**N  
**Position Type** Management  

**JOB SUMMARY**

Leads and manages all day-to-day activities related to the sales function with a focus on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of property sales objectives. Achieves personal booking goals and makes recommendations on booking goals of direct reports.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Education and Experience**

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 3 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

OR

* 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 1 year experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

**Supporting Developing & Executing Sales Strategies**

* Works with sales leader to ensure understanding of sales strategy and effective implementation of this strategy for the segment.

* Works with management team to create and implement a sales plan addressing revenue, customers and the market for the segment led by the DOS.

* Assists with the development and implementation of promotions, both internal and external.

**Maximizing Revenue**

* Provides positive and aggressive leadership to ensure maximum revenue potential (e.g., sets example with personal booking goals).

* Recommends booking goals for sales team members.

**Managing Sales Activities**

* Monitors all day to day activities of direct reports.

* Approves space release for catering to maximize revenue (DOS, Group) in the absence of a Business Evaluation Manager.

* Participates in sales calls with members of sales team to acquire new business and/or close on business.

* Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).

**Analyzing & Reporting on Sales and Financial Data**

* Analyzes market information by using sales systems and implements strategy to achieve property’s financial room and catering goals.

* Assists Revenue Management with completing accurate six period projections.

* Reviews sales and catering guest satisfaction results to identify areas of improvement.

**Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service**

* Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies customer service and creates a positive example for guest relations.

* Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.

* Meets with guests during pre- and post-convention meetings to obtain feedback on quality of product (e.g., rooms, meeting facilities and equipment, food and beverage), service levels, execution against contract and overall satisfaction.

* Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.

* Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.

* Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of department meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.

* Executes and supports the company’s Customer Service Standards and property’s Brand Standards.

* Participates in and practices daily service basics of the brand.

* Executes exemplary customer service to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty by assisting the customer and ensuring their satisfaction before and during their program/event.

* Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to the company.

* Gains understanding of the property’s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution both prior to, and during the program/event.

**Building Successful Relationships**

* Develops and manages relationships with key stakeholders, both internal and external.

* Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels (e.g., Event Booking Center, Market Sales, GSO) to ensure the property needs are being achieved and the sales efforts are complementary, not duplicative.

* Works with Human Resources, Engineering and Loss Prevention to ensure compliance with local, state and federal regulations and/or union requirements.

* Attends customer events, trade shows and sales missions to maintain, build or develop key relationships with GSO Managers and customers.

**Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities**

* Interviews and hires management and hourly employees with the appropriate skills to meet the business needs of the operation.

* Utilizes all available on the job training tools for employees.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.*

jobs.title: D&T Analyst II – Supply Chain
jobs.description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**

The Role is D&T Analyst II Supply chain in INTL SC team. This role is Techno-functional Analyst who can guide the design and development of solutions for Supply Chain projects and deliver technical and functional expertise in **SAP demand chain** areas of Operations. This role will collaborate with different D&T, Business, Strategic and Engage teams to analyze requirements and deliver performance, resilient technical strategies and architecture that meet current and future needs.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Design and maintain resilient, scalable, and secure architectures for Supply Chain solutions across D&T projects, aligned with approved enterprise and solution architecture standards.
* Own the end-to-end OTC (Order-to-Cash) process and supporting solutions, covering process design, configuration, development, testing, release, and ongoing support. Ensure alignment with business requirements and D&T standards.
* Ensure OTC solutions meet agreed cross-functional requirements across security, integration, data, and operations. Identify, assess, and mitigate technical risks proactively.
* Support daily operations and technical upgrades for assigned solutions, meeting agreed OLA and SLA targets. Coordinate planned changes to minimize business disruption.
* Drive the implementation of D&T process improvement initiatives (e.g., Glean, ITSM, CI, ADO) for the Intl SC Product Team.
* Translate business requirements into scoped and approved development initiatives. Coordinate delivery with business and D&T teams, (technical, IT cost and development/testing schedule responsibility)
* Manage critical and complex OTC production incidents for assigned solutions. Communicate status, escalate risks, in line with defined KPIs and support procedures.
* Build effective working relationships with business stakeholders and external software vendors, technical-support teams, and service providers to achieve project and operational outcomes.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams and dependencies across solution design, delivery, upgrades, and operational handover.
Partner with business stakeholders to identify, assess, and prioritize opportunities to improve OTC processes and Supply Chain outcomes.  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Full Time graduation from an accredited university.
* Strong SAP Demand Chain knowledge with minimum of 6 to 10 years of experience with preferred experience across any of these – Order to Cash, Transportation, etc. Integration across SAP, Non-SAP systems.
* Self-starter with experience leading through ambiguous projects & tasks.
* Ability to work with and manage stakeholders at various levels within the organization.
* Ability to convert business challenges in Supply Chain into technical solutions and lead implementation.
* Ability to prioritize and complete multiple tasks on tight deadlines.
* Strong communication, Presentation and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with business stakeholders (understanding their needs and translating them into technical solutions), IT teams, and external vendors.
* Ability to organize, prioritize, follow-up and ensure execution of multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
* Good understanding of master data and transactional data required for SAP S/4 and Planning Tools (APO/OMP etc.)
Good understanding of Reporting tools Viz BW etc.  

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and apply new technologies.
* Track record as a strong team player with effective teamwork and communication skills.
* Experience with agile techniques and methods
* Good interpersonal skills – can deal and communicate effectively in English (both in writing and verbally) with systems colleagues and business users.
* An analytical, methodical, logical approach to problem solving, employing innovative approaches to business and technical challenges.
* Structured and self-disciplined approach to working – can work on own initiative.
* Able to work under pressure and to tight deadlines.
* Time management skills and the ability to prioritize multiple conflicting activities.
* Willingness to continue learning to expand and build on skill sets.
* Good understanding of integration technologies (e.g., EDI, MuleSoft, APIs, third-party systems) and managing data flows between systems.

  

**ELIGIBILITY**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Our client is a fast-growing B2C consumer platform serving users across the Middle East. They are in the middle of a transformation from a commercially-led organisation to a product-led one.

They are looking for experienced
**Product Engineers**
who think like owners, not ticket-takers.

**About the Role**

We're hiring a Senior Product Engineer to own a product area end-to-end: development, testing, deployment, monitoring, operations, and the KPIs that go with it. You'll work in a small, focused product squad, with real autonomy and accountability for outcomes.

This isn't a "build what's in the ticket" role. We want people with a genuine product mindset — who dig into the "why," push back when something doesn't serve the user, and don't stop until the outcome is actually accomplished.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the full lifecycle of a product area — development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and KPIs — working closely with a small product squad.
* Work on large-scale legacy systems and modernise them, maintaining a
  **zero-downtime policy**
  across an international, always-on consumer product.
* Build and maintain multi-tenant, multi-currency, multi-lingual systems used by our platform and its partners.

**What We're Looking For**

* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
* Prior experience working at a
  **B2C consumer product company**
  , ideally at scale (high-traffic, high-transaction-volume environments).
* A strong product mindset and a real sense of ownership — you treat your area like it's your own business.
* Solid hands-on experience with
  **authentication and authorisation**
  in production systems — token-based auth, session management, and a clear grasp of the distinction between the two.
* Practical experience implementing or integrating
  **OAuth 2.0**
  flows for user-aware, third-party/partner access — not just theoretical knowledge of the spec.
* Experience designing or securing
  **third-party/partner access**
  , including scoping what an external system can see or do.
* Comfort working with both
  **synchronous protocols**
  (REST, gRPC) and, ideally,
  **event-driven patterns**
  (e.g. message brokers like Kafka) — and good judgment about when each is the right tool.
* Exposure to
  **cloud-managed identity and API gateway tooling**

The successful candidate will be responsible for the operational activities related to new product development, from the initial product brief to the approval of the finished product, working closely with laboratories, manufacturers, international suppliers and internal teams, while ensuring compliance with quality standards, cost objectives and product launch timelines.

**technical product expertise, knowledge of the beauty market, aesthetic sensitivity and a commercial mindset**
.

**4. Packaging Development**

* Contribute to the research and development of primary and secondary packaging.

* Follow multiple product development projects simultaneously.
* Monitor timelines, deadlines and key project milestones.
* Coordinate operational activities with suppliers and internal departments.
* Contribute to ensuring compliance with the collection launch calendar.
* Identify and promptly report delays, issues and potential risks.
* Contribute to identifying operational solutions to ensure project objectives are achieved.

**8. Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with the Marketing team on product concepts and key product benefits.
* Support the Communications team in preparing technical product information.
* Work with Regulatory and Quality teams to verify product compliance, safety and documentation.
* Coordinate with Supply Chain to ensure proper procurement planning.
* Support the Retail and Training teams in developing product knowledge and understanding of new launches.

**PROFESSIONAL REQUIREMENTS**

* At least
  **3–5 years of experience in cosmetic product development**
  , preferably within beauty brands or cosmetics manufacturing companies.
* In-depth knowledge of the makeup and/or skincare market.
* Hands-on experience in formulation development and product sample evaluation.
* Knowledge of cosmetic ingredients, textures, product performance and manufacturing technologies.
* Experience in the operational management of international laboratories and suppliers.
* Knowledge of cosmetic packaging development processes.
* Ability to follow multiple projects simultaneously.
* Knowledge of the main quality control and cosmetic compliance processes.
* Familiarity with cost and profitability dynamics.
* Excellent command of English.

**The following will be considered a plus:**

* Experience in product development for international beauty brands.
* Knowledge of the Asian, European and international cosmetics markets.
* Experience in companies characterised by frequent product launches.
* Familiarity with digital tools and AI applied to product research and development.

**PERSONAL SKILLS**

* Strong passion for the beauty industry.
* Curiosity and interest in innovation.
* Aesthetic and commercial sensitivity.
* Accuracy and strong attention to detail.
* Good organisational and planning skills.
* Problem-solving skills and operational autonomy.
* Good interpersonal and negotiation skills.
* Quality and results-oriented mindset.
* Teamwork attitude.

**KPIs & OBJECTIVES**

Performance will be assessed through indicators such as:

1. Compliance with product development and launch timelines.
2. Percentage of projects completed within deadlines.
3. Compliance with target costs and profitability objectives.
4. Quality and performance of developed products.
5. Number of innovations introduced.
6. Reduction in sampling and revision cycles.
7. Efficiency in operational supplier management.
8. Reduction of quality-related and technical issues.
9. Contribution to the development of competitive and distinctive products.

**EXPECTED RESULTS WITHIN THE FIRST 12 MONTHS**

jobs.title: Purchase In-Charge/ Manager - Food & Beverage Industry
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

The Purchase Manager is responsible for managing, coordinating, and monitoring purchasing activities across Roast, Cha Cha Chai, and ZAD Food Store.

The role involves working closely with Operations Managers, Outlet Managers, and other concerned employees to identify purchasing requirements, source suitable suppliers, negotiate competitive pricing, ensure product quality, monitor supplier performance, and maintain proper purchasing procedures and documentation.

The Purchase Manager is expected to ensure that all outlets obtain the required products and materials at competitive prices, with the right quality and timely delivery, while maintaining cost efficiency and accountability throughout the purchasing process.

Key Responsibilities1. Purchase Coordination

* Coordinate with Operations Managers and Outlet Managers to understand daily, weekly, and operational purchasing requirements.
* Ensure purchasing requirements are properly communicated, planned, and fulfilled on time.
* Follow up on pending orders, deliveries, shortages, and urgent requirements.
* Ensure outlets purchase products from approved suppliers wherever applicable.
* Monitor purchasing activities across all brands and identify unnecessary, duplicate, or excessive purchases.
* Support outlets in sourcing products whenever required.
* Coordinate purchases for new outlets, menu launches, promotions, and special operational requirements.

2. Supplier Sourcing & Negotiation

* Identify and develop new suppliers for food products, beverages, packaging, cleaning materials, equipment, and other F&B operational requirements.
* Regularly obtain quotations from suppliers and compare prices, quality, delivery terms, and payment conditions.
* Negotiate competitive prices, discounts, credit terms, delivery charges, and other commercial benefits.
* Develop alternate suppliers for key products to avoid dependency and supply disruptions.
* Maintain an updated supplier database with contact details, product specifications, pricing, payment terms, and delivery conditions.
* Establish professional relationships with suppliers and maintain effective communication.
* Conduct regular market research to identify competitive suppliers and better purchasing opportunities.

3. Cost Control & Price Monitoring

* Monitor prices of frequently purchased products across all outlets and brands.
* Maintain updated price comparison records for major food ingredients and operational supplies.
* Identify opportunities to reduce purchasing costs without compromising product quality.
* Monitor supplier price increases and verify whether such increases are justified based on market conditions.
* Inform Management and Operations of significant price changes affecting food cost and profitability.
* Negotiate better pricing based on purchasing volume, frequency, and long-term business relationships.
* Identify opportunities for savings through alternative products, suppliers, packaging, and purchasing arrangements.

4. Coordination With Operations & Outlet Managers

* Work closely with Operations Managers and Outlet Managers to ensure purchasing requirements are fulfilled efficiently.
* Understand outlet consumption patterns, menu requirements, operational priorities, and product specifications.
* Coordinate with Operations before changing suppliers, brands, product specifications, or ingredients.
* Ensure new suppliers and products are evaluated and approved by the concerned Operations team before implementation.
* Resolve supplier-related issues affecting outlet operations.
* Ensure purchasing decisions support operational requirements without compromising service, product quality, or customer experience.

5. Supplier Performance & Quality Control

* Monitor supplier performance in terms of quality, pricing, delivery, reliability, and responsiveness.
* Ensure suppliers deliver products according to agreed specifications and quantities.
* Coordinate with outlets regarding complaints, rejected products, damaged goods, poor quality, and short deliveries.
* Follow up with suppliers for replacements, refunds, credit notes, and corrective action.
* Arrange product samples and trials whenever required.
* Ensure suppliers provide necessary food safety documentation, product specifications, expiry details, and other relevant documents.
* Identify and replace suppliers who repeatedly fail to meet company requirements.

6. Purchase Documentation & Approval Procedures

* Ensure purchases are supported by proper quotations, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices as applicable.
* Ensure purchases are made within approved budgets and authorized approval limits. Make sure that the sytem is updated on the purchase module.
* Maintain proper documentation of supplier quotations, negotiated rates, orders, agreements, and price revisions.
* Verify supplier invoices against agreed prices and approved purchase details.
* Coordinate with Finance regarding invoices, payment terms, outstanding supplier balances, and payment follow-ups.
* Ensure proper transparency and accountability in all purchasing transactions.
* Identify and report unauthorized purchases or deviations from company purchasing procedures.

7. Purchasing Monitoring & Reporting

* Monitor purchasing expenditure across Roast, Cha Cha Chai, and ZAD Food Store.
* Maintain records of major purchases and supplier pricing.
* Prepare regular reports on:
* Purchasing expenditure by outlet and brand.
* Supplier-wise purchases.
* Price comparisons.
* Cost-saving achievements.
* Supplier price increases.
* Pending orders and delivery issues.
* Emergency and unplanned purchases.
* Supplier performance and complaints.
* Highlight areas where purchasing costs can be reduced or purchasing procedures improved.
* Submit reports and recommendations to Management on a regular basis.

8. New Suppliers & Product Development

* Identify suppliers for new menu items, ingredients, beverages, packaging, and operational requirements.
* Source customized and portion-controlled food products where required by the Operations Team.
* Research local manufacturers, catering suppliers, food processors, and alternative vendors.
* Arrange samples, quotations, and product trials for evaluation.
* Support Operations in sourcing products for new menus, seasonal promotions, and business requirements.
* Explore new products and alternatives that can improve cost efficiency and operational convenience.

9. Compliance & Ethical Purchasing

* Ensure purchasing activities comply with company policies and approval procedures.

jobs.title: Category Sales Manager Chocolate MEA
jobs.description:

We sit at the heart of the supply chain, partnering with producers and customers to source, make and deliver products that are vital for living. By providing customers with life’s essentials, we enable businesses to grow, communities to prosper, and consumers to live well.

This position is in our Food Enterprise where we are committed to serving food manufacturers, food service customers, and retailers with a complete range of innovative ingredients and branded products. Our portfolio includes poultry, beef, egg, alternative protein, salt, oils, starches, sweeteners, cocoa and chocolate.

**Job Purpose and Impact**
--------------------------

The Category Sales Manager Chocolate MEA will drive sustainable growth of the chocolate portfolio across the Middle East and Africa region. This role focuses on managing and developing key distributor partnerships as well as direct industrial chocolate customers, building strong customer relationships and identifying new business opportunities to expand market presence and profitability.

The successful candidate will combine strategic account management, sales excellence, and business development capabilities to deliver growth within a complex and dynamic market environment.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Develop and execute commercial plans to establish and grow relationships with key distributors and direct industrial chocolate customers across the MEA region.
* Build and implement customer business plans to achieve sales, volume, margin and growth targets.
* Identify and develop new business opportunities to expand the chocolate category portfolio within existing and new customers.
* Coordinate internal resources to provide value-added solutions and services to customers.
* Develop strong client relationships that provide significant input into product, pricing, channel and service strategies.
* Manage large and complex customer accounts while ensuring long-term profitable growth.
* Lead commercial negotiations and support contract discussions with strategic customers and distributors.
* Monitor market trends, competitive activity and customer needs to identify growth opportunities and drive category expansion.
* Independently handle complex issues with minimal supervision while escalating only the most complex issues to appropriate staff.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Food Science, Marketing or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum of four years of experience in Sales, Key Account Management and/or Business Development.
* Experience managing large customer accounts and driving profitable growth.
* Strong commercial and negotiation skills.
* Willingness and ability to work across the Middle East and Africa region.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the food industry, preferably in chocolate, confectionery, bakery, dairy, ingredients or related categories.
* Experience managing distributor networks and route-to-market strategies.
* Experience working with direct industrial food manufacturers and strategic accounts.
* Proven track record in business development and new customer acquisition.
* Experience working in international and multicultural environments.

**Our Offer**  
We provide a fast paced stimulating international environment, which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents. We also offer competitive salary and benefits combined with outstanding career development opportunities in one of the largest and most solid private companies in the world.
