jobs.title: Bartender - Noia by the Pool
jobs.description:
Mandarin Oriental Downtown, Dubai is looking for a Bartender to join Noia - our Greek Restaurant team.

Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional.

Mandarin Oriental is the award-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognized for creating some of the world’s most sought-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting-edge of luxury experiences.

Located within Wasl Tower on Sheikh Zayed Road, Mandarin Oriental Downtown, Dubai offers an elevated expression of modern hospitality in the heart of the city. Designed by UNStudio, the tower sets a distinctive architectural tone, while the hotel’s 259 guestrooms and suites reflect contemporary, design-led living with panoramic views across the Dubai skyline. The hotel’s dining portfolio includes Yù & Mì, Chitarra, Noia by the Pool, as well as Majestas Group concepts Billionaire, Lion in the Sun and FB1, with forthcoming openings including Osaka, Pavyllon Dubai by Yannick Alléno, and a street-level urban eatery. Additional features include a rooftop helipad, a two-storey spa and wellness sanctuary, landscaped rooftop pools and versatile event spaces. The Residences at Mandarin Oriental Downtown, Dubai are set to open by 2027.

**About the job**

Based at the Mandarin Oriental Downtown, Dubai within Noia - our Greek Restaurant in Dubai, the Bartender will offer and prepare an outstanding selection of creative beverages. They will support the servers in any other required duties and tasks under the guidance of the respective managers and supervisors. Bartender reports to the Assistant Restaurant Manager.

**As a Bartender, you will be responsible for the following duties:**

* Understand and verbally explain the outlet’s concept and food and beverage offerings to guests, including the characteristics of various drinks.
* Mix and match ingredients to create outstanding cocktails, non-alcoholic drinks, spirits, beers, and wines, garnishing them as per standards.
* Handle customer complaints effectively, both verbal and written, and report them to managers without fail.
* Set up the daily bar counter, ensuring all necessary ingredients and equipment are prepared, and check inventory to avoid running out of stock during service periods.
* Clean and sanitize the bar areas after each shift, conduct periodic deep cleaning, and ensure correct date labelling for all products.
* Assist in creating new mixed drinks and cocktails for promotional activities and new menus and operate the point of sales system to process orders.

**As a Bartender, we expect from you:**

* Hold a High School qualification or equivalent, with a Degree or Higher National Diploma in Hospitality/Hotel/Business Management preferred.
* Have 3 years’ experience as a Bartender in a high-end bar with the highest service levels, and a minimum of 2 years’ experience working as a bartender in a luxury hotel/resort.
* Possess basic computer skills, including MS Office, and have strong verbal and written communication skills in English (Arabic or other languages preferred).
* Demonstrate knowledge of bar service procedures and standards, and good knowledge of spirits and cigars.
* Exhibit strong interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively with guests and colleagues, as well as exceptional organizational skills with attention to detail.
* Have physical capabilities to stand for long periods and flexibility to work various shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as business needs.

**Our commitment to you**

* Learning & Development. Your success is our success. We craft unique learning and development programmes for various stages in your career so that you grow, continuously.
* MOstay. When you work as hard as our colleagues do, it’s important to take time off. As a member of the #MOfamily, you can stay with us wherever you go in the world. The MOstay programme offers complimentary nights and additionally attractive rates on rooms for you and your loved ones.
* Heath & Colleague Wellness. Finding the right work-life balance is important. Your wellbeing matters to us. A variety of health benefits and wellness programmes are offered to all our colleagues, globally.
* Colleague Comfort and Convenience: Benefit from comfortable accommodation, a duty transportation, and duty meals to ensure your work experience is both enjoyable and hassle-free.
* Competitive Salary and Benefits: We offer a competitive salary and an attractive benefits package, fully aligned with UAE industry standards, to ensure your financial well-being and stability.

**We’re Fans. Are you?**

jobs.title: Event Manager (Freelancer)
jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Legends Global teams across the world are innate problem solvers and people who thrive on the excitement of developing events that create opportunity and connection. We are meticulous planners, innovative thinkers, relationship specialists and acutely experienced business leaders who love what they do.

At Legends Global, we love events, it's what we do. It's a part of our DNA and what drives us.

**Position Purpose:**

* Responsible for ensuring all events are fully staffed and executed according to client specifications and needs. This role involves identifying and addressing operational issues to enhance customer satisfaction, ensuring the department aligns with company goals and adheres to financial budgets and targets.
* Plan, coordinate, and manage assigned ticketed and corporate events for Coca-Cola Arena, assisting with the service of all Coca-Cola Arena clients in the event planning and execution process when required.
* Manage the Merchandise of ticketed events, when required.
* Identify and communicate the needs of artists, and promoters to all departments to ensure proper service throughout the event.
* Assist with the development and implementation of new innovations, process improvements, and upgrades to existing Coca-Cola Arena products and services.
* Assist the Associate Director of Event Services as required in the operation of the department.

**Key Areas of Responsibility:**

* Manage assigned ticketed, corporate, and sporting events from planning through execution and post-event evaluation.
* Coordinate all event operational requirements including staffing, crowd management, accreditations, logistics, emergency planning, and risk assessments.
* Liaise with promoters, organizers, artists, teams, clients, and internal departments to ensure successful event delivery.
* Prepare event plans, staffing rosters, cost estimates, and event documentation using VenueOps and other operational systems.
* Conduct venue inspections, health and safety checks, and event risk assessments prior to event commencement.
* Lead event-day operations, ensuring Front-of-House services meet Coca-Cola Arena standards.
* Coordinate with Food & Beverage, Security, Medical, Traffic Management, and other operational departments.
* Manage event merchandise operations, including inventory control, supplier coordination, reporting, and merchandise stand setup when required.
* Conduct post-event debriefs and compile event reports, ensuring learnings are captured and implemented.
* Ensure compliance with all company policies, workplace health and safety standards, emergency management procedures, and operational processes.
* Maintain accurate event records, documentation, permits, deposits, and client information.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and identify opportunities to enhance operational efficiency and guest experience.

As part of our commitment to national talent development, this position is open to **UAE National applicants**, and we strongly encourage qualified professionals to apply.

***This role is on a freelancer agreement, and it requires the candidate to have their own visa / sponsorship. A detailed job description can be found below.***

**ABOUT YOU**

Everyday our people are responsible for delivering extraordinary experiences for every guest who walks through our doors.

You will have a shared values and people-centric mind set and genuinely want to make a difference. That's what makes you stand out from the crowd and why we want to meet with you.

You should have:

**Qualifications:**

* Degree or certification in Hospitality, Event Management, Sports Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline; or equivalent industry experience.

**Experience:**

* Minimum 3-5 years' experience in an Event Management, Venue Operations, or similar role.
* Experience managing ticketed events, live entertainment, corporate events, or sports events.
* Front-of-House (FOH) operational experience is essential.
* Background in sports events is desirable.
* Experience with crowd management, event staffing rosters, accreditations, event logistics, emergency planning, and risk assessments.
* Previous experience in the UAE, preferably in the event industry.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Fluent in English, Arabic is a plus.

**Skills and Knowledge Requirements:**

* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Strong event planning, organisational, and project management skills.
* Strong presentation and communication skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and event management systems.
* Experience using event management platforms such as VenueOps or similar systems is advantageous.
* Ability to work effectively within multicultural teams.
* Strong listening, negotiation, and influencing skills.
* Creative thinking with a proactive approach to problem solving.
* Understanding of event risk management, crowd management, and emergency response procedures.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to prioritize competing deadlines.
* Valid UAE driving licence and access to a vehicle is preferred.

**Personal Qualities:**

* Friendly and amicable personality.
* Excellent listening and communication skills at all levels.
* Excellent internal and external stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent personal presentation and grooming.
* Willingness to work as a team member and accept direction.
* Can do attitude without compromise of safety.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

jobs.title: Application Chemist
jobs.description:
#### ***Toshvin Analytical is a place where opportunity meets growth. We believe in providing the best quality service to our clients and in turn, helping businesses grow. We are a team of experienced professionals, looking for bright, motivated and committed individuals.***

#### ***If you are interested in a long-term career with one of the leading instrumentation companies in India, please email your CV to:*** ***careers@toshvin.com***

  

**Position :** Application Chemist

**Reports to :** RM / SM

**Location :** Bangalore

**Minimum Years of Work Experience :** 2 years

**Maximum Years of Work Experience :** 8 years

**Minimum Qualification :** B.Sc. or equivalent Graduation in Organic Chemistry or Analytical Chemistry

**Prefered Qualification :** M.Sc. Or Equivalent Postgraduation in Organic/ Analytical Chemistry or higher

**Maximum Grade in Toshvin :** M1

**Type of Work Experience Required:** Experience in Chromato products

**Type of Work Experience Required:** Experience in GC, GCMS

**Responsibilities & Deliverables:**

* Responsible for providing post sale customer on-site application support on GC, GCMS & GCMS-MS
* Supporting customer method development / method optimisation assistance pertaining to their sample matrices
* Helping customer with method validation support , Trouble shooting of customers application issues
* Demonstrating to customers advanced software capabilities and method packages with sample matrices
* Coordinate with Principals local application lab for any support required to address any unresolved customers application requests
* Conducting application training to customers chemists for effective use and utilization of the system and software
* Preparing effective application support reports detailing activities carried out and final result achieved
* Preparing and making PowerPoint presentations as and when required to customer on application support activity carried out and result achieved

**General Success Behaviours:**

* **Accountability:** Takes ownership of tasks and responsibilities
* **Collaboration & Teamwork:** Works effectively with others across teams and departments
* **Communication:** Communicates clearly, effectively and professionally
* **Customer & Stakeholder Focus:** Understands the internal and external customer needs
* **Integrity & Ethics:** Acts honestly, maintains confidentiality and upholds company values
* **Results Orientation:** Works proactively, manages time to meet deadlines and priorities
* **Professionalism:** Upholds professional standards and represents the organisation positively
* **Organizational Awareness:** Keeps updated on the organization’s goals and industry trends

**Any specific skills/knowledge required for this position:**

* **1. Chromatography Expertise:**
* Hands-on experience in handling chromatography products such as Gas Chromatography (GC), GC with Headspace (GC-HS), Gas Chromatography–Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS), and Triple Quad Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS/MS). Should be comfortable in operating, troubleshooting, and maintaining these instruments
* Should have handled & managed reasonably sized field sales team members (4 to 5 & more) and also Managers (managing their team)
* **2. Sampling Techniques:**
* Familiarity with advanced sampling techniques such as Headspace Samplers, Thermal Desorption Units, Pyrolyzers, and other front-end sample introduction systems
* **3. Analytical Methodology:**
* Proven experience in analytical method development, optimization, and validation using GC, GC-MS, and GC-MS/MS platforms. Ability to design robust methods to address complex analytical challenges and ensure reproducibility
* **4. Application Knowledge by Industry Segment:**
* Understanding of typical application workflows aligned with specific industry requirements (e.g., pharmaceuticals, food & beverages, environmental, petrochemicals, forensic, or clinical research). Should be able to translate customer requirements into analytical solutions
* **5. Regulatory Knowledge:**
* Awareness of global regulatory standards and compliance requirements such as US FDA, EPA, ICH, USP, GLP, and ISO guidelines. Prior experience in working under regulated environments would be highly desirable
* **6. Sample Preparation Techniques:**
* Well-versed with diverse sample preparation methods including extraction (liquid-liquid, solid-phase), digestion, purification, derivatization, and clean-up techniques. Understanding of how these steps impact final analytical results is essential
* **7. Additional Desirable Skills:**
* a. Ability to handle complex data analysis and interpret mass spectral information. b. Familiarity with software platforms used in GC/GC-MS/GC-MS/MS workflows. c. Strong problem-solving aptitude with innovative thinking for method troubleshooting. d. Effective technical communication skills to support customers, teams, and training sessions

Store & Purchase Executive

**Churchgate Hospitality Pvt. Ltd. | Mumbai | Full-time | On-site**

Company Description

Churchgate Hospitality Pvt. Ltd. (CHPL) is a hospitality-led brand house focused on creating distinct, experience-first dining concepts. Each restaurant is built with a clear identity, rooted in culture, refined through design, and elevated by attentive service and strong culinary execution.

The portfolio includes **Nksha**, an Art Deco-inspired North Indian fine dining concept; **Otoki**, a refined Japanese dining experience defined by precision and authenticity; **Tamak**, a bold North Indian concept centred on warmth and social dining; and **Fieno**, a contemporary Italian restaurant celebrating regional Italian cooking, quality ingredients and warm, refined hospitality.

CHPL approaches restaurant development as brand building rather than outlet expansion, ensuring each concept remains distinctive in character, culinary identity and guest experience.

Role Description

The **Store & Purchase Executive** is a full-time, on-site role based in Mumbai, responsible for procurement, receiving, inventory control and store operations across Churchgate Hospitality's restaurant portfolio.

The role works closely with chefs, restaurant managers, finance and vendors to ensure uninterrupted availability of food, beverage, packaging, operating supplies and other restaurant requirements while maintaining appropriate quality, pricing and stock levels.

The Store & Purchase Executive will manage purchase orders, vendor quotations, inward documentation, stock movements and periodic physical inventories. The role requires strong attention to **purchase prices, yields, wastage, consumption patterns and stock variances**, with timely reporting of discrepancies or unusual movements.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage daily and periodic **purchase requirements** across CHPL restaurants.
* Consolidate outlet indents and issue purchase orders based on approved requirements.
* Obtain and compare **multiple vendor quotations** to maintain competitive pricing and consistent specifications.
* Maintain approved vendor lists and negotiate pricing, credit terms, delivery schedules and product specifications.
* Coordinate closely with chefs and operations teams on availability and specifications of fresh produce, meat, seafood, dairy, imported ingredients, beverages and dry goods.
* Monitor purchase rates and immediately flag **significant price increases or supplier changes**.
* Receive materials and verify **quantity, quality, weight, specification, batch, expiry and condition** against purchase orders and invoices.
* Ensure strict **FIFO/FEFO** stock rotation and appropriate storage temperatures and conditions.
* Maintain GRNs, purchase orders, invoices, stock-transfer records, return notes and other store documentation.
* Maintain accurate records of **opening stock, inward, outward/issue, transfers, closing stock and consumption**.
* Conduct regular physical stock counts and reconcile them against system stock.
* Investigate and report **stock variances, excess consumption, shortages, damages, wastage and slow-moving items**.
* Monitor minimum, maximum and reorder levels to prevent both stock-outs and unnecessary overstocking.
* Coordinate inter-outlet stock transfers and maintain proper documentation for every movement.
* Work with Accounts to ensure invoices, purchase orders, GRNs and vendor statements are correctly reconciled.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and traceability for imported and high-value products.
* Support monthly **food cost and beverage cost closing** by providing accurate purchase, consumption and inventory data.
* Maintain store hygiene, organisation, labelling and food-safety standards.
* Assist management with monthly purchase analysis, vendor comparisons and opportunities for procurement savings.

Qualifications

* **2–5 years of experience** in purchasing, stores or inventory control, preferably within restaurants, hotels or hospitality.
* Strong understanding of **food and beverage purchasing and inventory management**.
* Knowledge of restaurant ingredients, especially meat, seafood, dairy, fresh produce, dry goods and imported products, is preferred.
* Experience with **PO, GRN, stock transfer, stock issue and inventory reconciliation** processes.
* Strong numerical ability and attention to detail.
* Proficiency in **Microsoft Excel**, particularly filters, lookups, pivot tables and inventory/purchase analysis.
* Familiarity with restaurant inventory/POS/ERP systems is preferred.
* Ability to negotiate confidently with vendors while maintaining strong supplier relationships.
* Understanding of **FIFO, FEFO, food safety, storage temperatures and hygiene standards**.
* Ability to identify unusual stock variances, price changes and consumption patterns.
* Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Supply Chain, Commerce or a related discipline preferred.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance will primarily be measured through:

* Purchase-price control and vendor competitiveness
* Product availability and reduction of stock-outs
* Inventory accuracy
* Stock variance and wastage control
* Timely PO/GRN/invoice processing
* Vendor delivery and quality performance
* Adherence to approved product specifications
* Monthly stock-closing accuracy
* Reduction of excess and slow-moving inventory
* Timely management reporting

jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

“We Power the Magic!” That’s our motto at Disney Experiences (DX). Our team creates world-class immersive digital experiences for the Company’s premier vacation brands including Disney’s Parks & Resorts worldwide, Disney Cruise Line, Aulani, a Disney Resort & Spa, and Disney Vacation Club.

We are responsible for the end-to-end digital and physical Guest experience for all technology & digital-led initiatives across the Attractions & Entertainment, Food & Beverage, Resorts & Transportation and Merchandise lines of business as well as other initiatives including MyDisneyExperience and Hey, Disney!

As a Software Engineer, you will be part of an early‑career engineering team that powers the magic behind our theme parks, resorts, cruise vacations, and global retail and consumer experiences. In this intermediate role, you’ll apply and grow your technical skills while building and enhancing software that supports both Guests and Cast Members across Disney’s travel and vacation portfolio.

**Responsibilities:**

You will design, develop, test, and implement software components and applications of moderate complexity, contributing to end‑to‑end solutions that help deliver seamless, magical experiences across Disney’s parks, resorts, cruise line, vacation ownership, and consumer products businesses. [Disney Segment Reference] In this early career, problem‑solver role, you’ll work with moderate guidance, analyze a range of solutions, provide informal support to newer team members, and explain complex technical information clearly—helping ensure Disney’s technology remains innovative, reliable, and guest‑centric.

* Complete component‑level software development and fixes using established and emerging technologies, focusing on scalable, high‑volume systems and client‑facing web applications.
* Participate in developing specifications, designing components, and contributing to architectural discussions for web, services, or platform solutions.
* Write clean, testable code; create and maintain unit and integration tests; perform debugging and issue resolution across lower and production environments.
* Collaborate with other engineers, technical operations, and cross‑functional partners to build tools, automation, and user interfaces that improve efficiency and support new business functionality.
* Develop and maintain server‑side and web service‑based solutions, microservices, and APIs, and build an understanding of front‑end technology stacks to assist with end‑to‑end problem solving.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automation tooling, and documentation to support reliable delivery and ongoing quality of Disney Experiences technology platforms.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Strong foundation in object‑oriented programming and software engineering principles, including design patterns, coding best practices, and SDLC concepts.
* Experience developing highly scalable, high‑impact software components, web applications, or services using languages such as Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, .NET, or Python.
* Hands‑on experience with web services or APIs (RESTful and/or SOAP) and microservice or event‑driven architectures.
* Working knowledge of relational and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., SQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, MSSQL, document databases).
* Experience with cloud platforms and infrastructure such as AWS or Google Cloud, including services like EC2/Lambda, API Gateway, containers, or similar offerings.
* Familiarity with modern development tools and practices, including git‑based code management, CI/CD pipelines, test‑driven development, and automation tooling.
* Ability to work as an independent worker and effective team member, with strong problem‑solving skills and the capacity to explain complex information to technical and non‑technical partners.
* MinimumReqiuredEducation: Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field.
YearsOfExperience: minimum 2 years of professional experience in software engineering or closely related development roles.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with AWS services such as Lambda, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, Kinesis, DynamoDB, or container orchestration (ECS/EKS).
* Background in building RESTful APIs or microservices using frameworks like Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, or Node.js, and modern UI development with Angular or similar JavaScript frameworks.
* Experience with test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium or similar) and quality engineering practices across UI, API, and integration layers.

jobs.title: Sr Executive Quality Assurance
jobs.description:
Why Hershey:

At The Hershey Company, our culture is rooted in purpose and inspired by Milton Hershey’s enduring vision that business should create opportunity for others. Through our commitment to corporate philanthropy, we create positive impact by supporting communities, helping children thrive, and operating as a business for good. This includes our deep and long standing partnership with Milton Hershey School, where we invest in education, workforce readiness, and hands on engagement to help students succeed beyond the classroom. Supported by strategic grantmaking, product donations, cross brand collaboration, and strong employee volunteerism, Hershey offers a place to work where making a difference—locally and globally—is part of how we do business every day.

**About The Hershey Company**
-----------------------------

The Hershey Company (NYSE: HSY) is an industry-leading snacks company known for making more moments of goodness through its iconic brands. With a strong portfolio across chocolate, confectionery, and salty snacks, Hershey delights consumers every day. Our beloved brands include Hershey’s, Reese’s, KitKat®, Dots Pretzels, Lesser Evil, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Ice Breakers, and more.

At Hershey, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in the communities where we live, work, and do business. This commitment originated with our founder, Milton Hershey, and continues to shape who we are today.

Guided by our employee value proposition, **Lead Today. Create Tomorrow,** we empower our people to drive impact now while shaping what comes next. Our **One Hershey** mindset brings teams together across functions, geographies, and businesses, enabling us to operate with speed, collaboration, and shared purpose.

The Hershey Company is proud to be recognized as a top employer in the United States, reflecting our commitment to our people, culture, and purpose.

**How will you fit in the big picture?**
----------------------------------------

The Sr Executive - QRC leads shift-level Quality & Regulatory Compliance activities across aseptic packaging and cocoa/non-cocoa syrup manufacturing. The role ensures effective in-process controls, product quality, food safety and regulatory compliance while managing deviations, consumer complaint investigations, corrective and preventive actions, and continuous improvement initiatives. It also provides technical guidance to QRC and shop-floor teams and collaborates cross-functionally to uphold Hershey Quality and Food Safety standards.

**What will you do?**
---------------------

Lead shift-level quality assurance for aseptic packaging and cocoa/non-cocoa syrup manufacturing, including monitoring critical process and quality parameters.

Ensure in-process controls, product analysis, and timely escalation and disposition of quality deviations.

Identify process and product deviations and collaborate with Production, Engineering, Supply Chain, and other functions on root cause analysis and CAPA.

Conduct food safety, GMP, and hygiene audits and ensure timely closure of observations.

Support HACCP activities and reinforce food safety controls across processing and packaging stages.

Support regulatory compliance for food safety and packaging and sustain readiness for GFSI, Hershey Global Standards, and HALAL certification requirements.

Investigate consumer complaints, establish root causes, and implement sustainable corrective actions.

Drive continuous improvement opportunities in product quality, process control, and food safety.

Maintain accurate quality records and shift reports and communicate quality risks and actions to stakeholders.

Provide technical guidance and shift leadership to staff and worker employees and collaborate with internal and external partners on relevant best practices.

**Minimum Education & Requirements**
------------------------------------

Experience:

Minimum 5-6 years of experience in a food, beverage, or aseptic packaging environment, primarily in Quality and Food Safety. Strong knowledge of GMP, HACCP, sanitation and hygiene standards, process quality controls, packaging compliance, Quality and Food Safety Management Systems, root cause analysis, CAPA, deviation management, and consumer complaint investigation is required.

Education:

Graduate or postgraduate degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering, Science, or a related discipline.

**Benefits and Perks**
----------------------

At Hershey, we offer competitive pay and a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your wellbeing, financial security, and life outside of work.

* Health & Wellbeing: Medical plus wellness programs that support your physical and mental health
* Financial Security: Competitive pay, annual incentive opportunities
* Time Off & Flexibility: Paid time off, company holidays, and flexible ways of working where applicable
* Growth & Development: Career development programs, learning opportunities, and internal mobility

*Benefits may vary based on role, location, and eligibility.*

In this environment, every individual can grow, lead, and make an impact, regardless of background, because inclusion fuels how we innovate and win.

jobs.title: Manager, Marketing - Brand Thums Up
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary:**

**Primary Location:** Gurugram, India

**Role Type:** Individual Contributor

**Reporting into:** Senior Director, Marketing - Brand Thums Up

The Brand Manager position is a role which requires setting a strategic vision for the brand, building strong business plans through rigorous insight and then bringing those ideas to life through the year with strong collaboration across the network. The role requires working effectively with many different stakeholders, including other brand team members, extended marketing teams, SMEs, agencies, customer teams, franchise teams, innovation, R&D and commercial leadership, bottling partners as well as other cross-functional partners. The ideal candidate is a good mix of strategic, creative, data-driven & with strong ability to connect the dots across various business verticals.

**What You’ll Do for Us**

As the **Manager, Marketing - Brand Thums Up** , you will play a pivotal role in defining the strategic direction and operational execution of Thums Up’s growth agenda in the INSWA (India & Southwest Asia) region. You will lead the brand's long-term marketing vision, multi-year strategic planning, and the design + implementation of annual business plans to achieve ambitious volume, revenue, and profitability goals. Thums Up is on an exciting journey with a brand restage under way & a recent innovation yet to be scaled, and you will be the architect of **Thums Up’s next chapter of explosive growth in INSWA,** leveraging strong business & consumer insights to deliver plans that drive impact and value. You will spearhead innovation as & when needed as per the strategy, drive consumer-centric solutions, and forge strong partnerships across internal and external stakeholders—propelling **Thums Up** as a brand that resonates with evolving consumer needs and fuels sustainable growth across the region.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Strategic Brand Leadership**

* Co-lead the multi-year **brand growth strategy** and annual business planning for Thums Up in the INSWA Operating Unit.

* Deliver against the **brand’s vision and positioning** —to capture new consumer occasions and uncover untapped opportunities, driving both volume and profit growth across beverage subcategories, packaging, and new channels.

* Build and deliver compelling consumer programs that drive demand and velocity.

* Manage and optimize brand performance, including **NSR, GP, and DME** , ensuring Thums Up achieves ambitious growth and financial targets in the region.

**Innovation & Partnership**

* Support product innovation and category expansion opportunities by closely collaborating with R&D, Supply Chain, Commercial, and Technical teams.

Partner with key stakeholders—including bottlers, agencies, and key customers—to co-create winning brand solutions, unlocking new avenues for growth.  



**Communication & Shopper Engagement**

* Develop high-impact campaigns and deliver clear briefs for agencies and vendors (creative, advertising, media, packaging design, etc.) to execute brand-building initiatives.

Analyze consumer insights and behavior to design communication strategies that shift consumer attitudes and drive enhanced connections with the brand.  



**Stakeholder Influence & Collaboration**

* Cultivate and manage strong relationships with diverse stakeholders.

Communicate & create strong buy-in across the system for business plans, address potential synergies, and negotiate across groups with varying objectives to achieve shared success.  



**Work Focus**

* Support the development and articulation of a multi-year **strategic roadmap** for Thums Up in the INSWA operating unit.

* Support the prioritization, decision-making, and alignment of cross-functional stakeholders across the value chain to ensure long-term brand and business success.

* Demonstrate the **ability to navigate organizational complexities** with a holistic, consumer-first view while delivering against real-world operational challenges and opportunities.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is required; MBA is strongly preferred.

* Minimum 5+ years of progressive experience in brand management or marketing, with a proven track record in driving sustainable growth for brands in a consumer-packaged goods (CPG) environment; beverage industry experience is strongly preferred.

* Proven experience in leading large-scale brands and implementing integrated marketing campaigns (IMX), particularly for global brands.

* Knowledge of procedures and media used to drive increased volume and brand growth, leveraging innovative growth strategies, brand positioning, brand strategy, SWOT analysis, competitive assessment, consumer segmentation, communication planning, and consumer-driven marketing campaigns.

* Strong ability to interpret and utilize syndicated data sources (e.g., Nielsen, IRI, CCT+) to drive insights-led decisions and a passion for understanding consumer behavior

Ability of managing cross-functional teams and external partners, such as creative agencies, suppliers, and bottling partners, to deliver seamless execution.  



**Communication Expectations**

* Act as a **strategic voice** and interface with both internal and external partners at the global, regional, and local levels to align on strategies, initiatives, and outcomes.

Effectively communicate complex brand and business plans, using influence to garner support from stakeholders across the Coca-Cola system and external partners.  



**What We Offer**

* **Challenging & Impactful Work:** Lead the growth agenda of **India’s #1 FMCG & beverage brand** , redefining strategies and driving remarkable business results in one of the most dynamic markets.
* **Truly End to end marketing & business Exposure:** A marketing role that covers every aspect of insighting, demand generation, planning , analyzing as well as delivering & evaluating results.
* **Leadership Opportunity:** Inspire and influence high-performing teams while innovating in a multi-faceted, cross-functional environment.

**Skills Required:**

Analytical Thinking, Brand Architecture, Brand Positioning, Channel Management, Competitive Assessments, Consumer Segmentation, Creative Process, Digital Media Strategy, Group Problem Solving, Marketing Strategies, Media Planning, Quantitative Research, Social Media Strategies, SWOT Analysis, Data & AI Fluency.

**What can help you be successful in the role?**

Empowered: Brings solutions instead of problems. Challenges the status quo. Has the courage to take an unpopular stance.  

**Leadership Behavior**

* Develops Self and Others: Develop self and support others' development to achieve their full potential.
Drive Innovation: Generate new or unique solutions and embrace new ideas that help sustain our business.  

**What We Can Do For You**

* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. We want to make our culture inevitable.

**Job Title: Business Development Manager**

**Location: Pune**

**ABOUT SIEMENS FINANCIAL SERVICES INDIA**

Siemens Financial Services India is a subsidiary of Siemens AG and has been operating in India for approximately 15 years. As part of Siemens AG’s global financial services division, SFS India provides innovative and tailor-made financing solutions, including leases, loans, and working capital solutions, for SMEs and large corporates.

Our industry expertise spans healthcare, manufacturing, renewable energy, technology, and other focused sectors. This enables SFS India to understand sector-specific challenges and structure relevant financial solutions. Technology-enabled platforms, digital processing, online account management, and data analytics support a responsive and efficient customer experience.

**Equipment Financing:** SFS India provides financing solutions for the acquisition of Siemens, domestic, and imported OEM equipment and technology. Solutions include Lease that enable asset usage without ownership and loans structured for specific equipment purchases.

**Project Financing:** Customized financing solutions are offered for infrastructure projects, industrial expansion, and renewable energy initiatives, aligned with project requirements and implementation timelines.

**Working Capital Finance:** Solutions include Extended Payment Terms, Assignment of Receivables, Factoring, and other structures that help businesses manage working capital effectively.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

The Business Development Manager will grow equipment finance business by building strategic partnerships with domestic, imported, and global OEMs, developing embedded financing propositions, and converting partner-led opportunities into sustainable business volumes across SFS-focused industries.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop and manage relationships with domestic, imported, and global OEMs across focused segments such as Healthcare, Packaging, Food & Beverage, Machine Tools, Plastics, and related industries.

* Build and maintain a qualified opportunity pipeline, from vendor engagement and customer identification through proposal development.
* Partner closely with Credit, Risk, Operations & Product functions, and other internal stakeholders to facilitate timely evaluation and turnaround of OEM-led opportunities.
* Build and drive long-term relationships with Indian equipment manufacturers, channel partners, and relevant ecosystem participants.
* Understand customer business models, cash flows, equipment applications, and industry dynamics to structure appropriate lease, loan, and working capital solutions.
* Deliver agreed business volumes, profitability, portfolio quality, and partner activation objectives in line with SFS priorities and governance standards.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activity, investment cycles, and emerging financing needs, and convert insights into targeted business development actions.
* Maintain disciplined pipeline reporting, including opportunity status, forecasts, partner plans, and key risks or dependencies.
* Represent SFS India in vendor meetings, Exhibition / Trade Fairs, Customer Seminars, and joint go-to-market initiatives.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, Economics, or a related field; MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification preferred.
* Proven experience in business development, relationship management, equipment finance, leasing, lending, vendor finance, or a related B2B financial services role.
* Demonstrated ability to originate opportunities, develop strategic partnerships, and manage a transaction pipeline from concept to closure.
* Experience working with MNC OEMs, domestic equipment manufacturers, distributors, or channel partners is preferred.
* Understanding of financial solutions and the ability to develop customized commercial structures for customers.
* Familiarity with Siemens businesses, components, verticals, or partner ecosystems will be an advantage.

**SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES**

* Strong commercial acumen with an understanding of financial statements, cash flows, pricing, risk-return considerations, and solution structuring.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Customer-centric and consultative approach, with the ability to translate business needs into practical financing solutions.
* High ownership, initiative, and ability to work independently in a target-oriented environment.
* Ability to collaborate across functions and navigate internal approval processes effectively.
* Strong planning, analytical, problem-solving, and execution capabilities.
* Integrity, compliance orientation, and disciplined adherence to applicable policies and regulatory requirements.

jobs.title: Product Owner - Buying
jobs.description:
**We are seeking a Product Owner with deep retail business platforms expertise to lead the full product development lifecycle within the Buying and Sourcing domains. This is an end-to-end ownership role — from discovery to delivery — requiring strong domain knowledge in retail buying and sourcing operations, advanced hands-on AI skills, and the ability to independently drive a skilled engineering team without day-to-day management overhead.**

* Own and drive the full product development lifecycle within the Buying & Sourcing domain — discovery, PRD, story writing, delivery, testing, and rollout — with full accountability for outcomes, not just process.
* Lead and engage a skilled, and independent engineering team; set clear priorities, remove blockers, and create the conditions for the team to move fast without constant hand-holding.
* Work directly with buying and sourcing business teams across brands to understand end-to-end workflows, capture pain points, and design platform-first solutions through structured discovery, live walkthroughs, and rapid prototyping and experimentations.
* Apply advanced AI skills across the product development lifecycle — discovery mocks, PRD and spec generation and engineering acceleration — and bring a strong point of view on where AI can embed intelligence directly into buying and sourcing workflows.
* Translate business requirements into well-defined workstreams and hold a high bar for engineering-ready specs that do not require repeated clarification.
* Lead concept rollout — onboarding new departments and brands, running UAT with business stakeholders, and driving adoption and change management with minimal escalation.
* Define and track input & output metrics to measure feature impact and guide prioritization.
* Maintain a clear understanding of system integrations across — Planning , PIM, Merchandising and PLM — and how integration states affect buying and sourcing workflows.
* Champion process standardization across concepts; challenge per-concept customization that creates technical debt and drive alignment on platform-first, scalable workflows.
* Communicate progress, risks, and decisions clearly to leadership; prepare and present updates independently without requiring significant oversight.

**Knowledge, Skills & Experience**

**Job Experience**

* **5–8 years of overall experience**
  with at least 3 years in a Product Owner role with end-to-end ownership — discovery through delivery — in a business platform environment.
* Demonstrated experience working on business platforms in a retail context is a must; enterprise SaaS or consumer app-only experience alone is not sufficient.
* Buying and sourcing domain exposure in a retail or fashion context is strongly preferred; candidates who understand the end-to-end buying & procurment cycle will be prioritized.
* Advanced, hands-on AI skills are mandatory — not just familiarity. Must demonstrate practical use of AI across the product development lifecycle: discovery acceleration, PRD and spec generation, prototyping, test case design, and engineering productivity. A strong point of view on embedding AI into operational workflows is expected.
* Proven ability to independently lead and engage a small, skilled engineering team — setting direction, managing priorities, and creating delivery momentum without requiring day-to-day oversight of team output.
* Experience with PLM systems (Bamboo Rose, Centric, or similar) is a strong added advantage.

**Required Leadership Skills**

* Independently drives full product development — from blank-page discovery to shipped capability — without needing to be managed. Owns outcomes, not just tasks.
* Strong engineering team engagement — creates clarity, sets pace, and builds trust with a skilled team that needs direction and sharp prioritization, not micromanagement.
* Structured stakeholder management — holds productive discovery conversations with senior business leaders and translates outcomes directly into engineering-ready specifications.
* Drives clarity in ambiguous, fast-moving requirements; does not wait for perfect information before moving forward.
* Clear, confident communicator — runs workshops, stakeholder reviews, and leadership updates independently and with credibility.
* Bias toward standardization and scalable platform thinking — challenges requests that create per-concept complexity and advocates for workflows that hold across multiple brands.
* High bias for action in a fast-moving environment where processes and norms are still being built.

jobs.description:

Our attractions are designed to ignite the imagination and create unforgettable memories for visitors from around the world. Whether you're seeking excitement, relaxation, or cultural enrichment, we offer something for everyone.

**About the Role**

The Research Scientist – Microalgal cultures, is responsible for developing and running the microalgal culture operations of the aquaculture research program. is responsible for the development and implementation of research projects fitting in the Center’s research directions in the topic of microalgae. The Research Scientist will develop methods to carry out hypothesis-led laboratory experiments as well as to study marine ecosystems/populations/individuals in situ. The Research Scientist – Microalgal Cultures, will also contribute in the daily operations of the YSWRR for knowledge dissemination and education.

Main responsibilities include:

* Developing and carrying out research projects aligned with the Center’s priorities
* Leading the maintenance and monitoring of multiple microalgal species
* Develop a microalgal bank of multi-species of microalgae
* Leading the quality control of microalgal stock
* Leading the production of scientific communication and articles
* Supporting the Center in its activities and contributing to its overall success
* Supervising high-school and undergraduate students
* Developing local collaborations

**Key Responsibilities**

**Developing and leading the microalgal culturing capabilities of the Center**

* Maintain and culture microalgae strains under laboratory conditions
* Optimize protocols to enhance efficiency, stability and upscaling
* Records information on appropriate production records, logs and other report forms. Provides inputs to reports as required
* Lead experiments and record relevant data
* Prepare and analyze experimental data, documenting results accurately
* Troubleshoot technical challenges related to microalgae, associated equipment and assays

**Leading research projects**

* Acts as Principal Investigator on research projects related to Microalgae to develop proposals and conduct projects; with undertaking and supervision of routine laboratory operations
* Leads the production of high-quality scientific publications, research reports, and other communication material
* Conducts research effectively by maintaining accurate records of sampling/experiments/analyses performed, conducting relevant literature searches, and maintaining an up-to-date knowledge of all current methods of experimentation
* Manages the permitting processes required to perform his/her research projects (Government Permits, etc.) under the supervision of senior researchers
* Develops collaborative research with YSWRR colleagues and actively promotes external contacts and networks for local and regional collaborations
* Develops and assists with educational initiatives and partnership, including citizen science projects and outreach events

**Management of research facility and equipment**

* Oversees supply and equipment inventory to sustain research and routine operations
* Supervises the adequate use, schedule and maintenance of the experimental laboratory equipment and facilities of the Center with production of SOPs and check lists/schedules
* Follow laboratory safety protocols and maintain a clean work environment

**Support the Center’s activities**

* Supports the research training program
* Supports the rescue and research field operations when required
* Actively contributes to the outreach goals of the YSWRR
* Collaborates with SeaWorld Abu Dhabi Zoological and Education teams as required
* Contributes to the overall success of the YSWRRC projects by performing all other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Essential**

* Master degree in marine biology or related fields
* Minimum of 3-year experience in a research laboratory with microalgae culturing facility
* Demonstrated success in publishing research results in refereed scientific journals and peer-reviewed publications
* Evidence of effective communication skills, particularly in communicating research findings to non-academic audiences
* Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities
* Ability to represent the Yas SeaWorld Research and Rescue Center to scientific community, general public, media, government agencies, and non-governmental associations
* Excellent interpersonal skills
* Demonstrated commitment to company values and safety

**Desirable**

* PhD in Marine Biology, Biotechnology or Aquaculture – with focus on Microalgae cutlures
* Previous experience in the GCC region is an advantage
* Evidence of multicultural skills in the workplace is an advantage

**Shape the Future with Us**

At Miral Experiences, we don’t just create world-class destinations - we create unforgettable memories for our guests and remarkable careers for our people.

From theme parks and attractions to guest services and behind-the-scenes roles, every member of our team plays a part in delivering exceptional experiences. We’re driven by passion, powered by innovation, and committed to excellence in everything we do.

We’re looking for passionate, driven, and talented individuals who are ready to grow, lead, and make a difference. No matter your background or expertise, there's a place for you at Miral Experiences.

jobs.title: Product Manager RBSS&ID
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
The Marketing department at Roche Diagnostics Middle East FZCO, operating within the Product Life Cycle Management family under the Laboratory Portfolio Management team, drives regional strategy, commercial enablement, and operational excellence across Dubai and Saudi Arabia (Career Band & Level). As part of an equal opportunity organization, the team collaborates across local and global matrix networks to deliver high-standard diagnostics solutions that make a meaningful difference in healthcare.
  
  
The Product Manager – Blood Safety & Infectious Disease (RBSS/ID), reporting to the Head of Laboratory Portfolio Management, serves as the primary technical and operational expert for the RBSS and ID portfolios (including Transfusion Medicine: NAT + Serology, and IGRA) across the region. In this strategic individual contributor position requiring lateral leadership without direct reporting lines, you will bridge the gap between highly technical global product specifications and local field execution. By securing technical wins in highly competitive blood bank and infectious disease tenders and ensuring strict compliance with customer marketing notifications, you will directly protect and grow market share within a highly regulated, critical disease area.
  
  
**The Opportunity**

* Portfolio & Lifecycle Management: Drive specific portfolio call-to-actions, meticulously managing product lifecycles, material introductions, and Phase-In/Phase-Out (PiPo) transitions to ensure zero disruption to customers or local revenue streams while minimizing write-offs of obsolete stock
* Technical Tender Support & Revenue Protection: Act as the ultimate subject matter expert for the RBSS and ID portfolios, partnering closely with Tender and Key Account Management teams to provide detailed product specifications and technical documentation required to win complex procurement processes, national blood bank tenders, and safeguard high-value, multi-year tender revenues
* Marketing Notifications (MN) Coordination: Manage the local operational requirements for centralized marketing notifications, including overseeing local customer data management, reviewing global content and translations for accuracy, executing manual distribution when required, and coordinating with Quality, Regulatory, and Supply Chain teams to ensure full compliance with local stock and regulatory statuses
* Technical Training & Sales Enablement: Deliver and coordinate advanced technical product training for network commercial and sales teams in strict alignment with global standards, actively engaging and motivating sales teams around complex technical requirements and portfolio transitions
* Cross-Border Collaboration: Act as the primary interface representing local affiliate interests within Global Product Hubs and Regional Communities of Practice (CoP), providing feedback on product activations, aligning on global training standards, and ensuring regional requirements for blood safety and infectious disease are factored into global product strategies
* Commercial Strategy & Integrated Marketing: Directly execute local pricing strategies for the RBSS/ID portfolio during product activations and collaborate closely with Integrated Marketing Partners (B2B) to provide the deep technical narratives and specifications needed to build high-impact solution marketing campaigns
* Lateral Leadership & Operational Excellence: Standardize processes and break down silos across internal sales leaders, cross-functional local teams, and global hubs, leading with integrity and authentic, courageous communication to constructively challenge the status quo and transform challenges into opportunities

**Who You Are**

* Industry Experience: 5+ years of experience in product management, technical application, or specialized sales within the In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) industry
* Education & Professional Background: A university degree in a relevant scientific or healthcare discipline (e.g., Biology, Laboratory Medicine, or Biomedical Engineering), with an advanced business degree preferred, alongside background experience managing complex Phase-In/Phase-Out (PiPo) strategies, pricing, and regulatory or marketing notifications
* Subject Matter & Training Expertise: Deep, specialized product knowledge in Blood Safety & Infectious Disease (specifically Transfusion Medicine, NAT, Serology, and IGRA), with a demonstrated ability to deliver and coordinate advanced product training aligned with global standards
* Tender & Operational Acumen: Strong track record navigating highly technical tender specifications and national procurement processes (such as blood bank tenders), as well as managing the administrative, operational, and technical requirements of product launches and marketing notifications
* Matrix Leadership & Change Agility: Proven capability to influence cross-functional teams and global hubs without direct authority, coupled with the agility to adapt to change, navigate ambiguity, drive new ways of working within a transforming global framework, and build trust through transparent communication

Ready for the next step? We look forward to hearing from you. Apply now to discover this exciting opportunity!
  
  
Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  
**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

jobs.title: Senior Designer
jobs.description:
**About Gloria Jeans**

Gloria Jeans is one of the largest fashion retailers in its home markets, with a history dating back to 1988, when our founder registered one of the first jeans workshops in the country. From that single workshop in Rostov-on-Don, we grew into a leading fast-fashion group with over 600 stores across Russia, Kazakhstan and Belarus, more than 7,000 employees, and over $1 billion in annual revenue. We dress the whole family - style and quality at prices millions can afford.

Now we have moved our headquarters to the UAE and are rebuilding the business for international growth, with the GCC and Southeast Asia as our first priority markets, alongside a fast-scaling e-commerce business and new categories in Home and Beauty. Our ambition is to create a genuinely global fashion group and, over time, grow it into a $10 billion business. We are still founder-led and entrepreneurial: decisions here are made in days, not quarters.

**The role**

The Senior Designer leads the creative development of collections from concept to final product, owning key categories across Denim, Knitwear, Activewear and Outerwear & Sweaters for Women, Men, Teens and Kids. The role combines strong creative sensibility with a deep understanding of commercial fashion, turning market insights and trends into commercially successful collections that reflect the brand identity and respond to customer needs.

Working closely with Buying, Product Development, Pattern Making, Production teams and suppliers, the role suits someone creatively driven yet highly collaborative and pragmatic, able to balance design vision with timelines, cost considerations and market performance. The role reports to the Head of Design and is fully based in Dubai, with relocation support provided.

**What you will own**

* Lead seasonal creative development - mood boards, colour palettes, key fits, fabrics and trims aligned to the brand’s vision and commercial objectives.
* Design garment sketches, prints, graphics and surface patterns for seasonal collections across categories.
* Create detailed tech packs with complete design specifications for suppliers, uploaded and kept current in the PLM system.
* Select fabrics, trims and finishes, and source materials worldwide through trade shows, fabric fairs, supplier visits and shopping trips.
* Oversee the fitting process with Pattern Making and Technical teams, reviewing and approving prototypes and samples through every round of development.
* Partner with Buyers to build commercially balanced collections that meet sales, margin and pricing targets.
* Present design concepts to management clearly and with commercial reasoning.
* Travel internationally for trend research, shopping trips, supplier visits and trade fairs.
* Mentor and guide junior designers, fostering creativity and continuous improvement.

**What we are looking for**

* At least 3 years of design experience as a Fashion Designer in mass-market, fast-fashion or high-street brands, with a degree in Fashion Design.
* A track record they can show - best-sellers and collections they personally drove; a portfolio is recommended, not required.
* Experience at a large fast-fashion group, or comparable high-speed retailers
* Advanced tool mastery - AI tools, Illustrator, Photoshop and CorelDRAW at an advanced level, plus 3D design skills.
* Deep garment craft - fashion trends, fabrics, garment construction and product development, with strong print and pattern design and a commercial eye for volume and price point.
* Excellent illustration and presentation skills, with the presence to present ideas convincingly.
* Daily, hands-on fluency with AI tools (Claude and similar) for analysis, research and everyday work.
* Fluent English; additional languages an advantage.
* Willingness to travel internationally on a regular basis.

**What success looks like**

* Strong sell-through on designed lines, with options adopted into collections and on-time delivery from concept to production.
* A high first-fit approval rate and accurate, complete tech packs in PLM.
* Consistent adherence to the design calendar season after season.

**What we offer**

* Competitive salary
* Annual performance bonus
* Relocation and visa support
* Private medical insurance
* Annual leave
* Best-in-class AI tooling
* Learning and development
* International travel opportunities

**Our Client**

An established regional food business with a portfolio of brands and categories operating across multiple markets. The next phase of growth calls for sharper portfolio choices, faster innovation and stronger commercial returns.

**Your Role**

Margins are under pressure. Consumer preferences are shifting at different speeds across markets. Innovation cycles don’t always keep pace, and supply chain volatility affects each category differently.

The challenge is not simply to grow the portfolio. It is to decide where growth should come from, which categories and geographies deserve investment, and how to protect profitability while the business evolves.

We are looking for a Chief Growth Officer who has built businesses through marketing and innovation, with direct P&L accountability. Someone who has grown brands across categories and markets, gained share through disruption and understands the commercial consequences of the decisions made.

* **Portfolio growth:**

* **Innovation:**

* **P&L performance:**
  Shape pricing, product mix, investment and channel strategy to improve margins and commercial returns.
* **Market expansion:**
  Identify and scale opportunities across existing and new markets, adapting to different consumer and competitive dynamics.
* **Business leadership:**
  Work across marketing, sales, R&D, supply chain and finance to ensure growth plans are commercially viable and executable.

**Must-Have**

* 18+ years in food or beverage FMCG, with substantial business leadership experience.

* Strong understanding of pricing, portfolio economics, channel profitability and supply chain constraints.

**Location**: Dubai, UAE

**Industry:** FMCG / Food & Beverages / Packaged Foods / Confectionery preferred

The company is a modern snacking and confectionery brand focused on building products for contemporary consumers. As the brand expands across the UAE and GCC, we are looking for a highly entrepreneurial Marketing Associate to help build the brand, lead social media execution, manage agencies and marketing partners, and create strong consumer and commercial activation programs.

**Role Overview**

The Marketing Associate will be a hands-on marketing and brand-building role responsible for driving company's social media and digital marketing efforts across the UAE and GCC. The role will work closely with creative and marketing agencies, influencers, e-commerce platforms, distributors and internal teams to develop ideas, briefs, campaigns and marketing collateral that build the brand and drive commercial growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Social Media & Organic Brand Growth**

* Own the day-to-day social media marketing agenda for company across Instagram, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
* Stay connected with current social media trends, formats, creators, memes, cultural conversations and emerging content opportunities.
* Identify opportunities to drive organic reach, engagement, community growth and brand awareness.
* Work with creative teams and agencies to develop high-quality social-first content, reels, static creatives, videos and other formats.
* Track social media performance and continuously recommend improvements based on learnings and consumer response.

**2. Agency & Marketing Partner Management**

* Act as a key point of contact for creative, social media, digital, PR, influencer and other marketing agencies.
* Prepare clear and actionable briefs for agency partners covering objectives, target audience, proposition, deliverables, timelines and expected outcomes.
* Lead regular agency meetings and ensure projects move from brief to execution efficiently.

**3. Brand Strategy & Campaign Ideas**

* Contribute to and develop brand ideas, campaigns and consumer activations for the UAE and GCC markets.
* Translate Company's brand positioning and product proposition into relevant local consumer communication.
* Develop campaign concepts around launches, flavours, products, occasions, cultural moments and consumer trends.

**4. E-commerce & Retail Marketing Collaborations**

* Work directly with e-commerce and quick-commerce platforms to plan and execute marketing campaigns.
* Coordinate with e-commerce partners to secure campaign opportunities, visibility, banners, placements, content and promotional activations.
* Prepare and deliver marketing collateral to e-commerce partners within agreed timelines and specifications.
* Coordinate campaign briefs, creative requirements, product information and commercial inputs with internal and external teams.

**5. Distributor & Trade Marketing Support**

* Work closely with the sales and distribution team to support distributor and retailer marketing requirements.
* Develop marketing collateral and activation ideas for distributor and retail partners.
* Coordinate co-marketing initiatives, launches, sampling, events, retail visibility and other consumer activations.

**6. Creative Development & Design Coordination**

* Work closely with graphic designers, video editors, photographers, agencies and other creative partners.
* Develop clear creative briefs and provide constructive feedback on designs and content.
* Help create marketing collateral including social media creatives, digital banners, product communication, presentations, retailer assets, POSM and campaign materials.

**7. Performance Marketing Understanding**

* Have a good working understanding of Google and Meta advertising ecosystems and the role of paid media in brand growth.
* Work with agencies or internal partners to understand campaign objectives, budgets, targeting, creatives and performance.
* Understand basic metrics such as CPM, CPC, CTR, CPA, ROAS, reach, frequency and conversion.

**8. Campaign Execution & Project Management**

* Own multiple marketing projects simultaneously and ensure deadlines are met.
* Coordinate internal teams, agencies, designers, vendors, e-commerce platforms and commercial partners.
* Create project timelines, action trackers and follow-up mechanisms to ensure timely execution.

**10. Marketing Reporting**

* Prepare regular reports on social media, campaign, agency and partner activity.
* Track key brand and marketing KPIs and communicate key learnings to management.
* Monitor competitor activity and share relevant market intelligence.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* 2–4 years of relevant experience in marketing, brand management, social media, digital marketing or an integrated marketing role.
* Strong practical experience managing social media and content marketing activities.
* Experience working with creative/social/digital agencies and managing external marketing partners.
* Working knowledge of Google and Meta advertising and performance marketing concepts; hands-on expertise is not mandatory.
* Good understanding of basic marketing budgets, P&L and campaign economics.
* Experience in FMCG, food & beverage, packaged foods, confectionery, snacking or consumer brands is preferred.
* UAE/GCC market experience is preferred.

* What's your current salary AED/month
* What's your expected salary AED/month

* Good attention to detail and organizational skills.

jobs.title: Sales Manager - TT

jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly experienced, aggressive, and result-oriented Sales Manager – Traditional Trade (TT) with an extensive background in the FMCG industry, preferably in the bottled drinking water or beverage sector.

The ideal candidate must have a proven track record of leading large sales teams, expanding market coverage, driving revenue growth, developing distribution networks, and achieving ambitious sales targets. Candidates must possess strong expertise in traditional trade operations, route-to-market strategies, distributor management, and general trade channel development.

This is a senior leadership role requiring a commercially strong individual who can independently manage and drive the entire Traditional Trade sales operation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Sales Strategy & Business Development:**

* Develop and execute comprehensive Traditional Trade sales strategies to achieve revenue, volume, and market share targets.
* Drive business growth through new customer acquisition and expansion of existing accounts.
* Identify new market opportunities, territories, routes, and distribution channels.
* Develop effective sales plans, monthly targets, and business growth strategies.
* Ensure strong market penetration across supermarkets, groceries, baqalas, cafeterias, and other traditional outlets.

**Sales Team Leadership & Management:**

* Lead, manage, and motivate Sales Supervisors, Van Salesmen, Business Development Executives, and Merchandisers.
* Set individual and team sales targets and monitor daily, weekly, and monthly performance.
* Conduct regular field visits and accompany sales teams to evaluate market performance.
* Establish accountability and ensure consistent achievement of sales KPIs.
* Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing sales professionals.

**Distribution & Route-to-Market Management:**

* Manage and optimize the distribution network and sales routes.
* Ensure effective utilization of the van sales fleet and sales resources.
* Improve customer coverage, outlet productivity, and order conversion.
* Monitor product availability, stock rotation, market returns, and delivery efficiency.
* Ensure proper coordination between sales, logistics, warehouse, and production teams.

**Market Expansion & Competitor Analysis:**

* Monitor competitor activities, pricing, promotions, and market positioning.
* Develop strategies to increase market share and strengthen brand visibility.
* Build strong relationships with key retailers, wholesalers, and distributors.
* Negotiate commercial terms and develop strategic customer partnerships.

**Sales Performance & Reporting:**

* Prepare and present sales forecasts, budgets, and performance reports.
* Monitor sales volume, revenue, collection performance, outlet coverage, and customer acquisition.
* Analyze sales trends and implement corrective actions to address performance gaps.
* Ensure effective execution of promotional activities and trade marketing initiatives.

**Required Qualifications & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
* Minimum 8–12 years of FMCG sales experience, with substantial experience in Traditional Trade.
* Minimum 3–5 years in a Sales Manager or equivalent senior sales leadership position.
* Strong experience in the UAE FMCG market is highly preferred.
* Experience in bottled drinking water, beverages, dairy, or other high-volume FMCG categories is strongly preferred.
* Proven experience managing large field sales teams and van sales operations.
* Strong knowledge of UAE traditional trade channels and distribution networks.
* Demonstrated ability to achieve aggressive sales and revenue targets.

**Essential Skills & Competencies:**

* Exceptional leadership and team management skills.
* Strong commercial and business development capabilities.
* Excellent negotiation and relationship management skills.
* Strong understanding of route-to-market and distribution strategies.
* Excellent analytical, forecasting, and decision-making abilities.
* Highly target-driven with a strong execution mindset.
* Ability to work under pressure and deliver measurable business results.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

* Monthly and annual sales revenue and volume achievement.
* Traditional Trade market share growth.
* New outlet acquisition and active customer growth.
* Sales team productivity and target achievement.
* Distribution coverage and route efficiency.
* Customer retention and collection performance.
* Reduction in product returns and market losses.

**Candidate Profile:**

We are specifically looking for a strong FMCG sales leader, not just an experienced sales supervisor. The candidate must have the ability to take complete ownership of the Traditional Trade business, lead a large sales force, expand market presence, and deliver significant revenue and volume growth.

Candidates with proven UAE FMCG experience, particularly in bottled water and beverage distribution, will receive priority.
