**Company Description**

Fairmont Ajman is a beachfront 5-star hotel situated in Ajman, just 30 minutes away from the bustling metropolis of Dubai. Combining hospitality and elegance with a deep connection to our natural surrounds, Fairmont Ajman promises exceptional cultural, leisure and dining experiences in a truly spectacular setting. Featuring 252 guest rooms and suites complete with ample space and breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf, Fairmont Ajman presents travelers with all the comforts of home, alongside world-class service.

 **Job Description**

Our guests are always at home at Fairmont Ajman – and their In Room Dining experience is no exception. As a Minibar Attendant, you will play an important role in enhancing the in-room guest experience by ensuring that minibar facilities are consistently stocked, clean, and well maintained. Through your attention to detail, efficiency, and commitment to service excellence, you will ensure guests have convenient access to a well-presented selection of food and beverage offerings while upholding Fairmont's high standards of quality and hospitality.

Key Responsibilities

* Replenish guest room minibars in accordance with established hotel standards and product par levels.
* Conduct daily minibar checks to ensure all items are properly stocked, presented, and within their expiry dates.
* Accurately record minibar consumption and update charges in the hotel's designated system.
* Ensure all minibar postings are completed promptly and accurately to avoid billing discrepancies.
* Check minibar refrigerators for cleanliness, functionality, and appropriate temperature.
* Ensure all minibar products are properly arranged, presented, and maintained in accordance with hotel standards.
* Monitor stock levels, report shortages, and coordinate replenishment requests with the relevant team.
* Conduct regular inventory checks and assist with monthly stocktaking.
* Check product expiry dates and follow proper stock rotation procedures using FIFO (First In, First Out).
* Report damaged, missing, expired, or incorrectly charged minibar items to the supervisor.
* Coordinate with the Front Office, Housekeeping, and Food & Beverage teams to ensure accurate billing and smooth operations.
* Respond promptly to guest requests relating to minibar replenishment and enquiries.
* Maintain cleanliness and organization of minibar storage areas, trolleys, and equipment.
* Handle all minibar products carefully and ensure proper storage to maintain quality and freshness.
* Follow hotel procedures relating to hygiene, food safety, and guest room access.
* Respect guest privacy and maintain confidentiality while working in occupied guest rooms.
* Minimize wastage and support effective stock control and cost-management initiatives.
* Maintain professional grooming standards and demonstrate the Fairmont values and Heartist culture.
* Perform any other reasonable duties assigned by the Supervisor or Department Head.

  
**Qualifications**

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Previous experience in minibar operations, housekeeping, food and beverage, or a similar hospitality role is an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of food and beverage products and stock handling procedures.
* Basic computer skills and familiarity with hotel operating systems is preferred.
* Good command of spoken English; additional languages are an advantage.
* Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
* Good organizational and time-management skills.
* Honest, reliable, and responsible, with the ability to handle inventory and billing accurately.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Flexible to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays.

**Physical Requirements**

* Requires frequent movement between guest rooms and minibar storage areas.
* Ability to lift, carry, and transport minibar supplies and replenishment trolleys.
* Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.

  
**Additional Information**

**Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion****:**

**What is in it for you:**

* Comprehensive medical coverage as per company policy.
* Enjoy meals on duty.
* All Heartist Card offering discounted room rates at Accor Worldwide for you, your family and friends.
* Enjoy special discounts at our restaurants and outlets.
* Benefit from a wide range of learning opportunities and development programs through our Academy.
* Build your career with opportunities to grow within the hotel and explore exciting career paths across Accor’s global network.

jobs.title: Field Sales Executive
jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Sapaad is a global leader in unified commerce platforms, delivering world-class software solutions for the food and beverage industry. Our flagship product, also named Sapaad, has achieved remarkable success over the past decade—empowering thousands of F&B businesses across 40+ countries, with many more coming onboard each day.

Driven by a passionate team of developers, designers, and product experts, Sapaad is constantly evolving—introducing innovative, industry-defining features that set the benchmark for F&B technology. Headquartered in Singapore, with offices across five countries, Sapaad is backed by seasoned technology veterans with deep expertise in web, mobility, and e-commerce.

**JOB OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a driven, field-based Field Sales Executive to join our Sales team in the UAE. This is a hands-on sales role focused on introducing Sapaad’s technology solutions to businesses across the food and beverage industry.

This is a true door-to-door sales role. You will proactively visit businesses, meet owners and managers face-to-face, present the value of Sapaad’s solutions, and convert prospects into customers. You will be responsible for building and managing your own sales pipeline, driving conversions, and consistently delivering against your sales targets.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

**Hit the field daily:** Visit SME businesses and F&B establishments in your assigned areas, proactively approaching owners, managers, and decision-makers to introduce Sapaad’s technology solutions.

**Build your own pipeline:** Identify prospects independently through area mapping, cold visits, referrals, and other field prospecting activities. Follow up consistently and convert interest into new customers.

**Pitch and demonstrate:** Conduct face-to-face presentations and product demonstrations, highlighting how Sapaad’s solutions can streamline business operations, improve efficiency, and address customers’ business needs.

**Close the deal:** Handle questions and objections, negotiate where needed, present relevant commercial terms, and convert prospects into paying customers.

**Achieve targets:** Work towards individual targets for new customer acquisition and revenue generation, contributing to Sapaad’s growth in the UAE.

**Keep accurate records:** Log visits, leads, customer interactions, follow-ups, and pipeline status in the CRM or designated tools.

**Hand over smoothly:** Work with the onboarding and support teams to ensure newly acquired customers are successfully onboarded and their solutions are implemented smoothly.

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING**

**Field sales experience (preferred):** 1 to 3 years in field sales, business development, or a customer-facing role. Fresh graduates with strong communication skills and real drive are welcome.

**Confidence in cold approaches:** Comfortable walking into a business unannounced and starting a conversation with the owner.

**Persistence:** A self-motivated, target-driven mindset with the discipline to follow up until the deal closes.

**Clear communication:** The ability to explain a technology product simply to non-technical business owners.

**Objection handling:** The ability to understand a customer’s needs and adjust your pitch for each type of business.

**Self-management:** Good organisation to plan your own daily routes, visits, and follow-ups.

**Field readiness:** Comfortable travelling across the UAE and spending most of the day out of the office.

**Languages:** Fluent English. Arabic, Hindi, Urdu, or other regional languages are an advantage.

**Driving:** A valid UAE driving license is an advantage.

Pay: AED3,000.00 - AED6,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* What interests you most about the Field Sales Executive role, and why do you think it would be a good fit for you?
* We are looking for someone who can join immediately. Would you be available to start right away?

License/Certification:

* UAE Driving license? (Preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Dubai

jobs.title: Head Waiter - Chitarra
jobs.description:
Mandarin Oriental Downtown, Dubai is looking for a Head Waiter/ess to join our Italian Restaurant.

  
  

Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional.

  
  

Mandarin Oriental is the award-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting-edge of luxury experiences.

  
  

Located within Wasl Tower on Sheikh Zayed Road, Mandarin Oriental Downtown, Dubai offers an elevated expression of modern hospitality in the heart of the city. Designed by UNStudio, the tower sets a distinctive architectural tone, while the hotel’s 259 guestrooms and suites reflect contemporary, design-led living with panoramic views across the Dubai skyline.

  

The hotel’s dining portfolio includes Yù & Mì, Chitarra, Noia by the Pool, as well as Majestas Group concepts Billionaire, Lion in the Sun and FB1, with forthcoming openings including Osaka, Pavilion Dubai by Yannick Alléno, and a street-level urban eatery.

  

Additional features include a rooftop helipad, a two-story spa and wellness sanctuary, landscaped rooftop pools and versatile event spaces. The Residences at Mandarin Oriental Downtown, Dubai are set to open by 2027.

  
  

**About the job**

  
  

Based at the Mandarin Oriental Downtown, Dubai within the Italian Restaurant in Dubai, the Head Waiter/ess is responsible to run a section in the restaurant and serve food and beverage in a timely manner and delight and satisfy each and every guest. Head Waiter/ess reports to the Restaurant Manager.

  
  

**As a Head Waiter/ess, you will be responsible for the following duties:**

* Manage a designated restaurant station, delivering efficient, friendly, and attentive service while ensuring guest satisfaction from arrival to departure.
* Maintain thorough knowledge of the restaurant’s food and beverage offerings, communicate them confidently to guests, and promote products through effective upselling.
* Complete all mise en place, cleaning, stocking, and side duties, ensuring equipment, utensils, and service areas are maintained to hotel standards.
* Accurately process orders, billing, cashiering activities, gift cards, and other payment methods using the POS system and established hotel procedures.
* Support operational excellence by coordinating with supervisors, managers, kitchen teams, and colleagues, while communicating guest preferences, allergies, and special requests.
* Create memorable guest experiences through proactive service, strong teamwork, a positive attitude, attention to guest needs, and adherence to MOHG service standards and quality expectations.

  

**As a Head Waiter/ess, we expect from you:**

* High school education preferred; a degree or diploma in Hospitality, Hotel, or Business Management is an advantage.
* Minimum 2 years of experience as a Senior Waiter/Chef de Rang, preferably in luxury hotels or high-volume restaurants with exceptional service standards.
* Strong ability to understand guest needs and consistently deliver outstanding customer service.

jobs.title: Head PreClinical- Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology
jobs.description:
VENUS MEDICINE RESEARCH CENTRE (VMRC)

Position: Head – Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology

**Department:**
Preclinical Sciences

**Reports To:**
Chief Scientific Officer

**Location:**
On-site, Full-time

Role Overview

VMRC is advancing a diversified pipeline spanning novel anti-infectives, BL+BLI combinations, and differentiated herbal therapeutics. The Head – Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology will lead all in vivo pharmacology, ADME, toxicology, translational PK–PD, and pharmacometrics activities across the portfolio.

This is a senior scientific leadership role requiring deep expertise in anti-infective development, renal pharmacology, nephrotoxicity assessment, PK–PD modelling, and IND-enabling toxicology, combined with strong regulatory and team leadership capability.

Key Programmes

Renal Guard Programme (Phase 1)

A reformulated polymyxin programme focused on reducing nephrotoxicity while maintaining antimicrobial efficacy.

Key areas:

* Renal injury biomarkers: KIM-1, NGAL, Cystatin C, NAG, Osteopontin
* Renal pharmacology and drug disposition
* Histopathology integration
* Complex PK interpretation in limited-literature settings

Meropenem + MET-X Programme (Late Preclinical)

A BL+BLI combination targeting carbapenem-resistant Gram-negative infections.

Key areas:

* IND-enabling ADME and toxicology
* Translational PK–PD
* Monte Carlo simulation & PTA
* Dose optimisation using:
* fT>MIC
* fAUC/MIC
* Cmax/MIC
* Clinical dose projection and resistance suppression strategy

Qualifications & Experience

* Ph.D. in Pharmacology, Toxicology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Translational Medicine, or related discipline
* 10+ years in preclinical in vivo drug development
* 5+ years leading multidisciplinary preclinical teams
* Experience advancing assets through IND/CTA-enabling development
* Strong expertise in:
* Anti-infectives
* Toxicology
* Renal pharmacology
* PK–PD/pharmacometrics
* GLP laboratory and regulatory submission experience preferred
* Strong publication and scientific presentation record

Key Responsibilities

Scientific Leadership

* Define and execute portfolio-wide in vivo strategy
* Lead pharmacology, toxicology, ADME, and PK–PD functions
* Serve as Study Director/PI for internal and outsourced studies
* Lead team development, budgeting, infrastructure, and resource planning
* Interface with CMC, microbiology, clinical, regulatory, and bioanalytical teams

In Vivo Pharmacology & Infection Models

* Lead rodent and non-rodent infection models:
* Thigh
* Lung
* Sepsis
* Resistance amplification
* Dose-fractionation studies
* Evaluate exposure–response, bacterial burden, survival, and resistance suppression
* Support herbal and metabolic programme evaluation

Renal Pharmacology & Toxicology

* Lead nephrotoxicity strategy for Renal Guard
* Integrate biomarkers, PK, and histopathology
* Interpret renal injury pathways and kidney drug disposition

ADME & Translational PK–PD

* Oversee PK, tissue distribution, ELF/renal penetration, and permeability studies
* Lead NCA, compartmental and population PK analyses
* Conduct PTA and Monte Carlo simulations
* Support dose projection and breakpoint justification

Required tools:

* Phoenix WinNonlin
* NONMEM
* R or equivalent platforms

Toxicology & Safety

* Oversee acute/repeat-dose toxicity, safety pharmacology, TK, and local tolerance studies
* Interpret NOAEL, MTD, therapeutic index, and safety margins
* Ensure alignment with ICH and IND/CTA requirements

Regulatory & GLP

* Lead nonclinical regulatory submissions:
* CTD Modules 2.4, 2.6, 4
* FDA, EMA, CDSCO submissions
* Drive GLP compliance, SOP quality, QA readiness, and facility accreditation
* Support publications, scientific presentations, and regulatory interactions

Regulatory Knowledge (Non-Negotiable)

Strong working knowledge of:

* OECD GLP Principles
* ICH M3(R2), S-series, E6(R2)
* IAEC/CPCSEA guidelines
* IBSC requirements
* ARRIVE & 3Rs principles
* IND/CTA/NDA nonclinical documentation

Ideal Candidate

* Proven anti-infective or antimicrobial development experience
* Exposure to BL+BLI or combination products
* Expertise in nephrotoxicity and renal biomarker science
* Strong translational and regulatory mindset
* Demonstrated ability to build high-performing preclinical teams and infrastructure

**Associate Scientist - Analytical Development & Testing**
**R&D Operations | Consumer Health**
**About The Role**
At Kenvue, we believe science is at the heart of exceptional consumer healthcare. We are seeking a highly motivated
**Associate**
**Scientist - Analytical Development & Testing**
to join our Global R&D Analytical Operations team and contribute to the development and lifecycle management of some of the world's most trusted consumer health brands.
  
  
This role offers an exciting opportunity to work across a diverse portfolio of
**Self Care (OTC), Skin Health, Baby Care, and Oral Care**
products while leveraging state-of-the-art analytical technologies in a world-class laboratory environment.
  
  
As a key member of the Global Analytical Sciences organization, you will support new product development, commercial product enhancements, analytical method development and validation, stability assessment, and research initiatives. The position requires a strong commitment to scientific rigor, quality, compliance, data integrity, and operational excellence.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Analytical Testing, Method Development & Technical Excellence**

* Perform analytical testing to support product development, stability programs, and commercial product lifecycle initiatives.
* Execute stability studies and shelf-life assessments utilizing analytical instrumentation, including:

+ HPLC/UHPLC
+ Gas Chromatography (GC)
+ Ion Chromatography (IC)
+ Atomic Absorption Spectroscopy (AAS)
+ UV-Visible Spectroscopy
+ ICP-MS
+ Dissolution
+ Additional modern analytical platforms as required

* Develop, optimize, validate, and document analytical methods for OTC drugs, cosmetic products, and consumer healthcare formulations.
* Support analytical method transfers and ensure successful implementation across laboratories.
* Perform scientific investigations and technical assessments to solve analytical challenges and drive project outcomes.
* Contribute to research-focused initiatives and innovation projects as assigned.

**Advanced Instrumentation & Laboratory Technology**

* Maintain proficiency across a broad range of analytical technologies and laboratory systems.
* Serve as an equipment owner for designated laboratory instruments and technologies.
* Support instrument qualification, calibration, maintenance, and performance monitoring programs.
* Drive continuous improvement in analytical capabilities through adoption of modern technologies and digital tools.

**Technical Documentation & Compliance**

* Author and review scientific and technical documentation, including:

+ Stability protocols and reports
+ Method development reports
+ Method validation protocols and reports
+ Method transfer documentation
+ Investigation reports and technical assessments

* Ensure compliance with Good Documentation Practices (GDP), data integrity requirements, and internal quality standards.

**Quality Systems & Operational Excellence**

* Support laboratory quality systems and critical analytical processes.
* Ensure adherence to cGMP, regulatory requirements, and global quality standards.
* Participate in root cause investigations, CAPA activities, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Promote a culture of quality, compliance, and "right-first-time" execution.

**Global Collaboration & Scientific Partnership**

* Collaborate with regional and global R&D, Quality, Regulatory, and Operations teams.
* Contribute to cross-functional projects and global initiatives.
* Share scientific insights and technical expertise to support successful project delivery across multiple markets.

**Technical Competencies**

* Strong foundation in analytical chemistry and pharmaceutical sciences.
* Experience with analytical method development, validation, troubleshooting, and data interpretation.
* Hands-on expertise with modern analytical instrumentation and laboratory technologies.
* Understanding of stability study design and product shelf-life assessment.
* Working knowledge of cGMP, data integrity principles, and quality management systems.
* Familiarity with regulatory expectations and audited environments.
* Proficiency in digital laboratory systems and scientific software applications.
* Strong technical writing and documentation skills.

**Leadership & Professional Competencies**

* Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and a commitment to high-quality execution.
* Applies scientific curiosity and critical thinking to solve complex analytical challenges.
* Embraces innovation and continuously seeks opportunities to improve processes and capabilities.
* Communicates effectively with diverse stakeholders across functions, sites, and geographies.
* Builds collaborative partnerships and fosters a culture of teamwork and inclusion.
* Delivers results with agility while maintaining the highest standards of quality and compliance.

**Qualifications & Experience**
**Education**

* M.Sc., B.Pharm., M.Pharm., Ph.D., or equivalent qualification in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Analytical Chemistry, or a related scientific discipline.

**Professional Experience**

* 1 to 5 years of relevant experience in:

+ Analytical Development
+ Quality Control
+ Pharmaceutical or Consumer Health R&D
+ Healthcare, Pharmaceutical, Medical Device, or FMCG industries

**Preferred Experience**

* Exposure to analytical method development and validation.
* Experience working within GMP-regulated laboratories.
* Knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11 and data integrity requirements.
* Experience supporting regulatory inspections and quality audits.
* Familiarity with global quality and compliance standards.

**Digital Skills**

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Experience with laboratory informatics systems, chromatography data systems, and electronic documentation platforms is desirable.

jobs.description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Research & Development
  
  
In Research and Development, we're full of highly skilled talents that include Scientists, Engineers, Medical, Clinical and Regulatory professionals - all working to create a cleaner, healthier world. With nine Centres of Excellence, we continually seek out new opportunities by using science, our entrepreneurial flare and our fearless innovation to develop and enhance our existing portfolio, never compromising on quality or performance.
  
  
We do the right thing, always, by ensuring we act with responsibility and integrity, by complying with regulatory legislation across the globe, whilst ensuring our products are safe for our consumers and are to the highest quality.
  
  
The size of our organisation means you'll have the opportunity to learn and work in different functions within R&D, giving you exposure to different disciplines, teams and environments. You will also have access to our Research and Development Academy, designed to develop our team and allow you to grow in our great organisation.
  
  
**About The Role**
The role is ideal for a high-calibre individual with the necessary skill set to manage hands on scientific and technical issues on a range of products and projects primarily focussed on a challenging and complex base business resiliency plan to sustain future growth, primarily, the Self-care product portfolio.
  
  
This diverse role is to collaborate with R&D product development teams, other R&D PDM teams, Regulatory, Marketing, Supply and Production groups to deliver “best in market” consumer solutions.
  
  
Role will be accountable for providing R&D support to a designated range of Reckitt products, enabling revenue protection, revenue growth and compliance of the brands
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Responsible for all R&D technical activities, compliance programme and supply resiliency projects on Selfcare brands
* Support Supply for manufacturing, procurement, or packaging projects, to implement effective technical solutions and solving issues in manufacturing process including safety & sustainability objectives/compliance.
* Responsibility for ensuring all required formulation, feasibility work, analysis, validation, stability testing, industrial trials and dossier preparation is performed on time and to the required standards.
* Accountable for the delivery and execution of the project work as per the timelines
* Accountable for the KPIs / delivery of project milestones and stage gates
* Responsible for project management & budget management for the Technical projects, in addition responsible for Lab set up and equipment maintenance in all time audit ready state.
* Responsible for Formulation assessment for the Self-care portfolio.
* Responsible for the Regulatory submissions, variations and response of RTQs by generating the relevant documents through applicable platforms.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* Minimum of a good degree in a relevant scientific discipline (e.g. Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Science, Chemical Engineering, Biology, Biochemistry)
* Post graduate qualifications in further scientific disciplines would also be beneficial (i.e. PhD, or MSc, post-graduate diplomas (e.g. Pharmaceutical Quality by Design)
* Experience in project and stakeholder management
* Significant R&D experience with a proven track record of delivery.
* Experience of working in a Healthcare environment is desirable
* Working knowledge of CTD modules and regulatory frameworks
* Proven track record as a leader in planning, prioritization and implementing projects as well as identifying costs savings and problem solving
* Proven track record in active collaboration with R&D and non-R&D functions

The skills for success
  
  

* The candidate should be comfortable with ambiguity and be a ‘self-starter’ with the ability to quickly learn and implement to keep up with the fast pace of the role
* Technically diligent and able to grasp new science and visualise a business benefit
* Prioritisation and time management skills are essential
* Stakeholder collaboration, communication and the ability to manage expectations are also key
* Strong leadership, influencing, motivational and interpersonal skills.
* Capable of building strong working relationships and motivating teams to deliver outstanding results.
* Strong negotiating skills.
* Strong analytical and technical skills.
* Ability to anticipate, plan and realize significant projects involving multiple technical and scientific hurdles.
* Ability to perform solid thinking into action (a thinker and an achiever).
* Strong intellectual curiosity.
* Appetite for exploring new and previously uncharted territories.
* Openness to change and ability to think out of the box.
* The business language in Reckitt is English, therefore fluency in English is essential and fluency in local languages advantageous
* Flexible to travel, if required

What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

jobs.title: Research Engineer
jobs.description:
While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth.
  
  
If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi!
  
  
**Research Engineer, Applied Research (BioTech AI – Drug Discovery)**
**About The Company**
Quantiphi is an award-winning AI-first digital engineering company, driven by a deep desire to solve transformational problems at the heart of businesses. Our signature approach combines groundbreaking machine-learning research with disciplined cloud and data-engineering practices to create breakthrough impact at unprecedented speed.
  
  
Quantiphi has seen 2.5x growth YoY since its inception in 2013 to 3500+ team members globally.
  
  
For more details, please visit our website or LinkedIn page.
  
  
**About Phi Labs**
Phi Labs is an R&D practice at Quantiphi focused on advancing the frontiers of AI technologies with Applied Machine Learning at its core. We ideate and build novel solutions to high-impact, cutting-edge challenges, with a focus on advanced prototyping and scalable proof of concepts.
  
  
Within this unit, the AI-Accelerated Drug Discovery practice is a key pillar that aims to apply state-of-the-art AI methodologies to revolutionize the way new therapeutics are discovered and developed. We are committed to driving meaningful scientific breakthroughs by combining strong AI research with deep cross-disciplinary collaboration.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Level:**
Research Engineer
  
  
**Work Location:**
India
  
  
**The Role**
This is a unique opportunity to work on scientifically impactful problems at the intersection of AI and biotechnology within Phi Labs, Quantiphi’s Applied Research team. In this role, you will work on the development of core AI models and algorithms aimed at accelerating the drug discovery process. This position focuses on key peptide engineering workstreams. This includes In Silico design of Antibodies, mini proteins, cyclic peptides etc.
  
  
The position involves working with a diverse, lively, and proactive group of nerds who are constantly raising the bar on translating the latest AI research in Healthcare and Life Sciences into tangible reusable assets for the community. Hence this would require a high level of conceptual understanding, attention to detail and agility in terms of adaptation to new technologies.
  
  
**While prior experience in the biotech or life sciences domain is highly valued and will elevate the candidate profile, we are equally open to exceptional AI/ML researchers from other domains who are excited to explore and learn the nuances of this rapidly growing field**
.
  
  
***Please note: This is a core AI research role, not a software engineering or system integration position. We are particularly keen to engage with candidates focused on scientific AI innovation rather than application development or LLM/GenAI-centric workflows**
.*
**Responsibilities**

* Stay ahead of the AI research curve, focusing on foundational AI methodologies applicable to protein analysis and protein design.
* Build rapid prototypes, conduct detailed experimental studies, and develop advanced AI models in areas such as generative modeling, reinforcement learning, graph-based learning, and property prediction.
* Work closely with interdisciplinary teams including biologists, chemists, and life science domain experts to design scientifically sound AI approaches.
* Contribute to Quantiphi’s IP portfolio through the development of novel algorithms, proof of concepts, and potential publications.
* Drive thought leadership through documentation, knowledge dissemination, and participation in conferences, blogs, webinars, and publications.
* Publish Research papers in prestigious Conferences and Journals.

**Requirements**
**Must Have:**

* Master’s degree, PhD, or equivalent experience in Biological Sciences/ Biotechnology, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, or related fields.
* Minimum work experience required : from new graduates to 3+ yrs of research experience post graduation (in ML research)
* Strong foundation in AI/ML concepts with hands-on experience in model development, experimental design, and large-scale data analysis.
* Excellent in-depth understanding of ML concepts and the respective underlying mathematical know-how.
* Working knowledge of using NLP with biological sequences.
* Solid research mindset with a track record of working on complex AI problems—experience with drug discovery datasets is a plus but not a prerequisite.
* Excellent programming skills in Python, with experience using AI/ML frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Hands-on experience in developing and deploying models with various deep learning architectures in multiple ML areas like Computer-Vision, NLP, Statistics etc
* Ability to independently learn new scientific domains and apply AI techniques to novel bio-pharmaceutical problems.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to present complex ideas in an accessible format across audiences.
* Ability to translate abstract highlights into understandable insights in multiple knowledge-dissemination formats like blogs, presentations, paper-publications, tutorials and webinars

**Good To Have**

* Prior exposure to molecular datasets, cheminformatics, bioinformatics, biophysics simulations, or life sciences.
* Hands-on experience with in silico techniques in small molecule or peptide design
* Hands-on experience with the model family of RFDiffusion, ProteinMPNNs and other backbone design techniques
* Familiarity with generative models, graph neural networks, reinforcement learning, or multi-objective optimization.
* Demonstrated industry research experience will be considered as an additional bonus.
* Research publications in AI/ML conferences such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, or relevant bioinformatics journals
* Experience with cloud environments like GCP or AWS and scalable model training.
* Strong classical education on math/physics/mechanics/CS/Engineering concepts will also be an advantage.

**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity to work at the cutting edge of AI and biotechnology, solving problems with real-world scientific impact.
* Exposure to interdisciplinary teams and a culture that encourages continuous learning and exploration.
* Contribute to an R&D environment that values curiosity, innovation, and the advancement of AI for good.

*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us*
*!*

Principal Scientist – Advanced Analytical Technologies

Enzene Biosciences Ltd.

Chakan, Pune, Maharashtra (On-site)

**Job Description**

**About Enzene**

Enzene is a Continuously Innovative Development and Manufacturing (CIDMO™) partner supporting innovators and biosimilar developers across discovery, development and commercial supply. Operating from facilities globally, Enzene provides integrated biologics services enabled by its EnzeneX® fully-connected continuous manufacturing™ (FCCM™) platform, alongside NeX™, an end-to-end partnership program for governments, institutions and biopharma.

* Strong background in biologics or biosimilar analytical development
* Experience guiding a team, plus exposure to regulatory submissions
* Hands-on experience with HPLC, UPLC, LC-MS, peptide mapping, glycan analysis, CD, FLR, AUC, SEC-MALS, FTIR, MFI, Karl Fischer, and capillary and gel electrophoresis

**Company:** Northern Solvents Private Limited

**Location:** Vaishali Nagar, Jaipur, Rajasthan

**Job Type:** Full-time

**About the Company**

Northern Extracts is a manufacturer of oleoresins, essential oils, and herbal extracts, specializing in North Indian herbs and spices. We serve the seasonings, flavors, fragrance, and nutraceutical industries across domestic and international markets.

Our Corporate Office is in Jaipur, with a manufacturing facility in Roopangarh, near Ajmer. The company is committed to quality, food safety, and regulatory compliance, with applications for FSSC 22000, ISO, Kosher, Halal, and FSSAI certifications.

**Role Overview**

To ensure timely procurement, optimum inventory availability, supplier performance, material traceability, and cost-effective purchasing in coordination with Production, Planning, QA/QC, R&D, Stores, Finance, and other functions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Purchase & Procurement:** Procure raw materials, essential oil ingredients, botanical materials, packaging, chemicals, and consumables; obtain quotations; negotiate commercial terms; prepare POs; follow up deliveries; and maintain approved suppliers.
* **Inventory Management:** Maintain optimum stock, minimum/maximum and safety levels; monitor slow/non-moving and excess stock; conduct physical verification; reconcile ERP records; and ensure FIFO/FEFO and batch-wise control.
* **Material Planning:** Coordinate with Production, Planning, QA/QC, R&D, and Stores; review production plans; prepare MRP; ensure critical material availability; and identify shortages in advance.
* **Food-Grade / Essential Oil Control:** Procure against approved specifications; coordinate COA, food-grade, allergen, MSDS/SDS and origin documentation; support incoming inspection; maintain batch/lot traceability and suitable storage conditions.
* **Vendor Management:** Develop alternate suppliers; negotiate annual/long-term rates where practical; monitor TAT (Turn Around Time), rejection, lead time and competitiveness; resolve supplier issues; and conduct vendor performance reviews.
* **Stores & Warehouse Coordination:** Coordinate inward receipt, GRN (Goods Receiving Note), inspection and issue; maintain identification, labeling and location control; support segregation of approved/rejected/under-inspection/expired materials; and coordinate returns/transfers.
* **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) & Documentation:** Maintain Purchase request, RFQ (Requisition Form), quotation comparison, PO (Purchase Order), GRN (Goods Receiving Note), stock and supplier records; ensure authority-matrix compliance; support audit documentation; and coordinate PO/GRN/invoice matching with Finance.
* **Cost Control:** Identify purchase savings and optimization opportunities; compare historical/market prices; control emergency purchases and excess inventory; and negotiate improved commercial terms without compromising quality or supply continuity.

**Key Competencies**

* Procurement & negotiation
* Inventory planning & stock control
* Vendor management
* MRP / material planning
* ERP-based purchasing
* Food-grade documentation & traceability
* Cross-functional coordination

jobs.title: Technical Service and Nutrionist
jobs.description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
At Novonesis, we believe solutions rooted in biology can help solve some of the world’s biggest challenges. In this role, you will bring deep animal nutrition expertise together with regional technical leadership to help customers across Middle East, India & Africa (MEIA) turn science and data into practical solutions.
  
  
**The role & your impact**
As Technical Service Specialist & Nutritionist, you will be the single regional owner for technical planning across MEIA, covering all three subregions.
  
  
You will translate commercial priorities and customer needs into disciplined technical plans, coordinate structured customer trials and registration support, mobilize specialist technical-service resources, and accelerate the resolution of advanced customer requirements.
  
  
You will also lead the establishment and continuous development of regional technical capabilities, including feed-analysis testing and service laboratories. Your work will help strengthen customer support, improve the quality and reuse of technical evidence, and accelerate evidence-based adoption of Animal Biosolutions across MEIA.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities In This Role**

* Own and actively manage an integrated technical-service plan across all three MEIA subregions, aligned with commercial priorities, product strategies and customer needs.
* Maintain visibility of technical projects, trials, registrations, capability-building initiatives, priorities, dependencies and resource requirements.
* Establish consistent ways of working, decision criteria, documentation standards and review routines across the subregions.
* Identify capability gaps and determine where regional expertise, external partners or global specialist support should be deployed.
* Design and coordinate customer trials with clear hypotheses, protocols, success criteria, responsibilities, timelines and data requirements.
* Ensure trial plans reflect customer production systems, feed materials, animal species, formulation practices and relevant local conditions.
* Guide data collection, analysis, interpretation and technical reporting to deliver credible, reproducible and decision-ready outcomes.
* Translate trial learning into reusable protocols, technical arguments, case studies and regional best practices.
* Coordinate technical inputs for product registrations in partnership with Regulatory Affairs and relevant internal experts.
* Connect customer and market requirements with the appropriate subject-matter experts, laboratories, application teams and global technical-service resources.
* Act as the regional focal point for complex or high-value technical customer requirements that go beyond routine local support.
* Triage technical escalations and lead root-cause assessment and resolution planning for advanced nutrition, feed-performance and application issues.
* Define the roadmap for regional technical capabilities, including feed-analysis testing, service laboratories, methods, equipment, partners and competencies.
* Lead the setup, qualification and continuous improvement of regional testing and service-laboratory capabilities in line with applicable quality, safety and compliance requirements.
* Establish appropriate test methods, sample-handling practices, data-integrity expectations, reporting standards and service levels.
* Build a practical network of internal and external laboratories to provide timely and reliable analytical support across MEIA.
* Provide expert guidance on animal nutrition, feed matrices, formulation principles, ingredient variability and the use of feed-formulation software.
* Build technical capability within sales and technical teams through coaching, training, field support and reusable technical tools.
* Monitor relevant technical, scientific, competitive and market developments and translate them into implications for the regional business.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful In This Role**

* A degree in Animal Nutrition, Animal Science, Veterinary Science, Feed Science or a related discipline.
* Typically 10–15 years of relevant experience in the Animal Health and Nutrition industry, with substantial exposure to technical service, animal nutrition, feed applications or related work.
* Strong knowledge of animal nutrition, feed ingredients, nutrient specifications, feed matrices and formulation principles.
* Demonstrated experience designing and executing structured commercial or research trials and translating results into customer recommendations.
* Practical experience with feed analysis, laboratory services, analytical methods and interpretation of nutritional data.
* Proficiency with feed-formulation software, including the ability to interpret formulation outputs, constraints and economic trade-offs.
* Ability to develop trial protocols, evaluate data quality, interpret results and prepare clear technical reports.
* Understanding of feed-analysis testing, sample management, laboratory methods and quality expectations.
* Ability to diagnose complex customer requirements and coordinate specialist support across organizational boundaries.
* Strong planning, prioritization and project-management skills, combined with disciplined follow-through.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem solving and sound judgment, including when working under time pressure.
* Clear and credible communication with technical experts, commercial teams, senior stakeholders and customers.
* Ability to work collaboratively and build trust across functions, cultures and geographies in a matrix organization.
* Fluency in English.
* Willingness and ability to travel across MEIA in line with business needs.

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**

* An advanced degree in Animal Nutrition, Animal Science, Veterinary Science, Feed Science or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting product registrations, regulatory technical documentation or cross-functional registration projects.
* Experience working across culturally and commercially diverse markets within MEIA.
* Additional languages relevant to the MEIA region.

**What We Offer You**
You will have the opportunity to work at the intersection of science, customer needs and commercial priorities across a diverse international region.
  
  
The role offers extensive collaboration with regional and subregional Sales, Marketing and Business Development teams as well as Technical Service, R&D, Application, Laboratory, Product Management, Regulatory Affairs and Quality colleagues.
  
  
As a regional individual contributor, you will have significant ownership of how technical expertise, evidence and capabilities are coordinated and shared across MEIA, with opportunities to build knowledge, strengthen ways of working and contribute directly to customer outcomes.
  
  
**Working conditions**

* Primary location: Türkiye.
* Secondary location: Dubai.
* Hybrid work mode.
* Regional scope covering all three MEIA subregions.
* Travel requirement: approximately 40–50% across MEIA, in line with business needs.

**Relevant information**
This is an individual contributor position within Technical Service / Animal Nutrition, with responsibility across Middle East, India & Africa (MEIA).
  
  
**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Opportunities for everyone**
We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

**Job Summary:**   
The Certification Executive – Organic Compliance will be responsible for managing end-to-end organic certification activities across the manufacturing and processing facility. The role includes ensuring complete compliance with **NPOP, USDA NOP, EU Organic Regulations**, and other applicable standards from **raw material inward to finished goods dispatch**, including APEDA TraceNet operations, Transaction Certificate (TC) management, batch traceability, production compliance, documentation, and certification audits.

**Educational Qualification**

* B.Sc. Agriculture / M.Sc. Agriculture
* B.Tech Food Technology / M.Sc. Food Science
* Biotechnology / Microbiology
* Quality Assurance or equivalent qualification
* Additional certification in Organic Standards, HACCP, ISO 22000, Food Safety, or Internal Auditor will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* 4–5 years of relevant experience in organic food processing, certification, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience in certified organic food manufacturing or processing units is mandatory.
* Experience in export-oriented food manufacturing will be preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Organic Certification Management**

* Ensure compliance with NPOP, USDA NOP, EU Organic Regulations, and customer-specific organic requirements.
* Coordinate with certification agencies for inspections, surveillance audits, renewals, and certification updates.
* Maintain certification validity and statutory compliance.

**2. Raw Material (Inward) Compliance**

* Ensure segregation of organic, in-conversion, and conventional materials.

**4. Batch Creation & Traceability**

* Create production batches with complete lot traceability.
* Maintain batch-wise inward, production, processing, and packing records.
* Ensure complete forward and backward traceability.
* Conduct mass balance verification and stock reconciliation.

**5. Finished Goods Compliance**

* Verify finished product labeling as per organic regulations.
* Ensure packaging materials comply with certification requirements.
* Approve finished goods for dispatch after compliance verification.
* Maintain finished goods inventory records.

**6. Transaction Certificate (TC) Management**

* Generate inward and outward Transaction Certificates.
* Manage APEDA TraceNet transactions.
* Coordinate with certification bodies for TC issuance.
* Ensure timely documentation for domestic and export consignments.

**7. Documentation & Record Management**

* Maintain certification documents and statutory records.

* Batch Manufacturing Records (BMR)
* Batch Packing Records (BPR)
* Stock Registers
* Processing Records
* Yield Reports
* Traceability Records
* Cleaning & Sanitation Records
* Dispatch Documentation

* Coordinate internal, customer, and certification audits.

**9. Warehouse & Inventory Compliance**

* Ensure proper segregation and identification of organic inventory.

**10. Cross Functional Coordination**

Coordinate closely with:

* Procurement
* Production
* Quality Assurance
* Warehouse
* Sales & Exports
* Dispatch & Logistics

Support new product approvals, certification requirements, employee training, and customer audits.

**Company Description**

Syngenta Bioscience Private Limited (SBPL) is one of Syngenta's three global Research & Technology centers, our Goa facility stands at the forefront of agricultural innovation. Our world-class team specializes in developing novel active ingredients, pioneering sustainable synthesis routes and advancing cutting-edge chemical technologies. We have diverse scientific talent pool, with deep expertise in organic chemistry, drives solutions that enhance global food security and sustainable agriculture. At SBPL Goa, we combine scientific excellence with meaningful career growth opportunities, contributing directly to Syngenta's mission of feeding a growing world sustainably.

 **Job Description**

**Role Purpose**

Lead the Analytical team of 5 to 6 scientists in delivering reliable, timely and compliant analytical support to Product Chemistry, Formulation Development, Technology & Sourcing, Manufacturing and Quality. The role requires strong technical expertise, structured problem solving, people leadership, and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.

**Key Accountabilities**

**Technical and Operational Excellence**

* Lead analytical testing, method development, validation, transfer, verification and troubleshooting activities for active ingredients, intermediates, formulations and relevant raw materials.
* Ensure methods, instruments, laboratory systems and data meet applicable Quality, Health Safety and Environment (HSE), Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and data-integrity requirements.
* Provide expert scientific judgement for complex deviations, out-of-specification results, investigations, root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions.
* Drive laboratory efficiency, robustness and continuous improvement through fit-for-purpose technologies, standardization, automation and lean ways of working.
* Ensure high-quality technical reports, analytical documentation and defensible scientific data to support product, process and regulatory decisions.
* Manage laboratory resources, priorities, capacity, equipment readiness and budget to meet agreed service levels.

**People Leadership**

* Build a capable, engaged and inclusive Analytical team through clear objectives, regular feedback, coaching and performance management.
* Develop technical capability, succession pipelines and individual development plans using structured learning, peer learning and on-the-job experience.
* Promote a culture of scientific curiosity, ownership, collaboration, safety, quality and continuous improvement.
* Recruit, retain and develop talent; ensure appropriate competency assessment and training for laboratory roles.
* Lead by example in applying Syngenta behaviours and creating a respectful, diverse and rightful working environment. The internal people-management framework highlights talent development, coaching and inclusive leadership as core expectations.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner closely with Product Chemistry, Process Technology, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Supply, HSE and external laboratories/suppliers.
* Translate business and technical needs into clear analytical strategies, plans, priorities and realistic delivery commitments.
* Communicate complex analytical findings clearly and influence decisions at project, site and regional levels.
* Manage stakeholder expectations proactively, escalating risks, resource constraints and technical issues early with practical options for resolution.
* Represent Analytical in cross-functional project teams, audits, technical reviews and customer/regulatory interactions where required.

**Key Interfaces**

Internal: Product Chemistry, Process Technology, Manufacturing, Quality Assurance/Quality Control, Regulatory Affairs, HSE, Production & Supply Chain, Research, HR and Finance.  
External: Contract research/testing laboratories, equipment vendors, consultants, auditors and regulatory bodies.

 **Qualifications**  

* A PhD or Post Doc with specialization in Analytical Chemistry is preferred OR Organic chemistry or allied sciences qualification with high exposure to analytical and or formulation activity from a reputed institution in India or abroad. A 10+ years of experience analytical laboratory experience, including 5+ years leading teams or technical workstreams. OR
* Master’s degree in chemistry preferable analytical or allied Science, area from the reputed Universities with strong academic records and good communication skills Typically, 15+ years of relevant analytical laboratory experience, including 5+ years leading teams or technical workstreams.
* Deep practical experience with chromatographic and spectroscopic techniques, e.g., HPLC/UPLC, GC, LC-MS/GC-MS, IC, UV-Vis, IR and particle/physical-characterisation techniques as relevant to the function.
* Demonstrated experience in analytical method lifecycle management, validation, transfer, stability/support testing, data review and investigation leadership.
* Experience working in a regulated quality environment (GLP etc.,) and leading stakeholder-facing technical projects.

**Essential Competencies**

* **Technical expertise:** recognised analytical subject-matter expertise; sound scientific judgement; disciplined problem-solving.
* **People leadership:** develops people, gives clear feedback, manages performance and builds inclusive, accountable teams.
* **Stakeholder management:** communicates with influence, builds trust and aligns diverse functional priorities.
* **Delivery focus:** plans effectively, manages risk and resources, and delivers to agreed quality, cost and timeline commitments.
* **Continuous improvement:** challenges inefficient practices and converts learning into sustainable laboratory improvements.
* **Quality, safety and integrity**: demonstrates uncompromising commitment to HSE, quality systems and data integrity.

InspireXT is on a mission to become the world's most trusted supply chain consulting partner, and to create a company where our clients, our people and our partners flourish. **WHY** **InspireXT****?**

Because transformation, at its best, is human. You’ll work with people who care deeply about what they do, who believe in trust before transactions, and who want to leave every client stronger than they found them. We are on a strong path of growth, and you’ll get to be part of that journey — helping shape the systems, culture, and capabilities that will scale with us. If that sounds like you – we’d love to hear from you. Apply to be part of our growth story.

Note - we are an equal opportunities employer, committed to fostering diversity & growth for all. We welcome applications from traditional and unusual backgrounds and also are happy to discuss any specific accommodations required in the recruitment process to help you shine.

Are you ready to inspire? #MakingWinners #InspireXT #SupplyChainExperts

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Food & Beverage Industry Subject Matter Expert (SME) with 15+ years of industry experience and strong domain expertise in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), product specification management, packaging development and regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of end-to-end F&B product lifecycle processes, including product development, formulation, ingredient management, raw material specifications, packaging specifications, finished goods, quality management and product commercialization.

The candidate will play a critical role in providing functional and domain expertise for PLM transformation initiatives, helping translate business requirements into scalable digital solutions. The role will involve working closely with business stakeholders, product development teams, R&D, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Packaging, Manufacturing and IT teams.

A sound understanding of global food regulatory frameworks, particularly EU and USA regulations, is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

PLM & Product Lifecycle Management

  

* Provide subject matter expertise across the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and product development to commercialization and product maintenance.
* Understand and define PLM processes covering product development, formulation, ingredient management, product specifications, quality and change management.
* Drive standardization of PLM processes, workflows, approval mechanisms and governance across business functions.
* Define business requirements and translate them into functional specifications for PLM platform implementation.
* Support PLM transformation initiatives, process optimization and digitalization programmes.

Product Specification Management

  

* Demonstrate strong expertise in managing product specifications across raw materials, ingredients, intermediates, finished goods and packaging materials.
* Understand specification attributes, technical data, nutritional information, allergen declarations, composition, physical and chemical properties and quality parameters.
* Define and manage specification lifecycle processes, including creation, review, approval, version control and obsolescence.
* Understand specification relationships, hierarchies, inheritance, dependencies and cross functional data requirements.
* Establish governance for specification accuracy, completeness, traceability and data integrity.

Packaging Management

  

* Provide functional expertise in primary, secondary and tertiary packaging processes and specifications.
* Understand packaging materials, structures, dimensions, weights, artwork, labeling, packaging components and material compliance.
* Support packaging development, packaging change management, supplier collaboration and packaging approval processes.
* Understand packaging sustainability, recyclability, material composition and environmental compliance requirements.
* Work with packaging engineering, procurement, quality and regulatory teams to define packaging specifications and associated workflows.

Global Regulatory & Compliance Requirements

  

* Possess a sound understanding of food safety, product labeling, ingredient declarations, packaging compliance and regulatory requirements across global markets.
* Understand supplier declarations, Certificates of Analysis (CoA), Certificates of Compliance (CoC), Statements of Composition and Declarations of Conformity (DoC).
* Work with regulatory teams to ensure product and packaging specifications capture relevant compliance attributes and documentation.
* Familiarity with EU regulatory frameworks, including:

* EU Regulation 178/2002 – General Food Law.
* EU Regulation 1169/2011 – Food Information to Consumers.
* EU Regulation 1935/2004 – Food Contact Materials.
* EU Regulation 10/2011 – Plastic Materials Intended to Come into Contact with Food.
* EU Regulation 2025/40 – Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR).
* REACH and applicable chemical substance compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with USA regulatory frameworks, including:

* FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA).
* FDA 21 CFR requirements applicable to food and food packaging.
* Food allergen labelling requirements under FALCPA and FASTER Act.
* FDA food contact substance requirements.
* Nutrition Facts and ingredient declaration requirements.
* Applicable food packaging and labelling compliance requirements.

Business Process & Stakeholder Management

* Engage with R&D, Product Development, Packaging, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Procurement and Supply Chain stakeholders.
* Conduct business workshops, discovery sessions, process assessments and fit-gap analysis.
* Document AS-IS and TO-BE business processes, functional requirements and process flows.
* Define business rules, approval workflows, roles and responsibilities.
* Support solution demonstrations, functional validation, UAT and business acceptance.
* Act as the domain bridge between business stakeholders and technology implementation teams.

PLM Platform Implementation & Transformation

  

* Provide functional leadership during PLM platform implementation and transformation programmes.
* Support configuration of product, ingredient, specification, packaging and regulatory management capabilities.
* Define functional requirements for data migration, integrations and reporting.
* Support product data governance, master data management and specification harmonization.
* Participate in solution design reviews, sprint planning, testing, defect resolution and deployment.
* Support user training, change management and post-implementation stabilization.

**Key Deliverables**

  

* Business process assessment and AS-IS / TO-BE documentation.
* Functional requirements and PLM solution design inputs.
* Product, ingredient, raw material and finished goods specification models.
* Packaging specification and lifecycle management processes.
* Regulatory and compliance requirement mapping for EU and USA markets.
* Functional workflows, approval processes and change management definitions.

**Role purpose**

Design and implement subsidies and incentive mechanisms that improve productivity, sustainability, and farmer livelihoods while ensuring
**fiscal sustainability, compliance, and measurable impact**
. This role is a technical lead within the TMO portfolio and owns the end-to-end subsidy reform workstream.

**Responsibilities:**

**Diagnosis and design**

* Map existing subsidy landscape: eligibility, spend, leakage risks,incentive distortions, overlaps.
* Segment beneficiaries (farm types, size,crop/livestock systems, geography, vulnerability).
* Design alternative subsidy models:
* Targeted input subsidies (seed/feed/fertilizer) with controls
* Outcome/conditionality-linked incentives (water efficiency, compliance, productivity)
* Capital grants/ co-investment schemesfor modernization (irrigation, greenhouses, renewables)
* Develop fiscalscenarios and trade-offs for government decision-makers.

**Targeting, eligibility, and controls**

* Define eligibility rules, verification methods,and audit trails(registry integration, land/farm ID, production evidence).
* Design leakageprevention controls (claimsvalidation, supplier vetting,anomaly detection triggers).
* Develop compliance mechanisms and enforcement pathways aligned with regulations.
* Develop cost-benefit scenarios to define and review on an ongoing basis applicability of the subsidies.

**Implementation of architecture**

* Translate designinto executable implementation plan: policy drafts,operating procedures, system requirements, vendor/process changes.
* Work with digital/data teamson:
* Farmer registryintegration
* e-voucher / digital disbursement logic
* Case management workflows for exceptions and appeals
* Support procurement packages (system integrators, payment rails, verification services).

**Monitoring and impactevaluation framework**

* Define an impact evaluation approach:
* Logic models(inputs → outputs→ outcomes)
* Baselines and measurement methods(surveys, remote sensingproxies, administrative data)
* Quasi-experimental designoptions were feasible(phased rollout, comparison groups)
* Establish a benefits trackingdiscipline within the TMO (impactreporting cadence, auditability).

**Stakeholder management**

* Coordinate with finance/treasury, audit,regulators, farmer associations, suppliers, and service providers.
* Develop communication materials to supportadoption and managepolitical economic risks.

**Required experience and qualifications.**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in economics, public policy, agricultural economics, or related.Advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years in agricultural subsidy/incentives, social supporttargeting, agri-policy implementation, or development programs at leading organization.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing targeting and payment/disbursement mechanisms (public sector preferred).
* Strong quantitative capability: fiscal modeling,program evaluation methods.
* Familiarity with global best practices (FAO, World Bank, IFAD style program disciplines) preferred.

Organizational Overview

TG Therapeutics is a fully integrated, commercial stage, biotechnology company focused on the acquisition, development and commercialization of novel treatments for B-cell diseases. In addition to a research pipeline including several investigational medicines, TG Therapeutics has received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for BRIUMVI® (ublituximab-xiiy) for the treatment of adult patients with relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis, including clinically isolated syndrome, relapsing-remitting disease, and active secondary progressive disease, as well as approval by several foreign nations for BRIUMVI to treat adult patients with RMS who have active disease defined by clinical or imaging features. For more information, visit www.TGTherapeutics.com.

Role

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is a field-based regional Medical Affairs professional responsible for developing and enhancing relationships with medical professionals, researchers, clinical trial support staff, advocacy, and other members of the Myasthenia Gravis (MG) scientific and clinical community. Additionally, the MSL will demonstrate scientific, clinical, and therapeutic area expertise during scientific engagements with key opinion leaders (KOLs) and other healthcare professionals (HCPs) and requires credibility to engage top national and regional thought leaders.

Reporting into the MSL Team Field Director, the MSL is a critical role in TG Therapeutics’ customer-facing field model, collaborating compliantly with cross-functional teams including Clinical Development, Sales, Marketing, and Market Access to provide clinical support and education.

This role will cover the following territory: ME, VT, NH, CT, MA, NY, PA, NJ, MD, DE, RI

* Be a credible medical/scientific expert
* Fair-balanced scientific engagement across the assigned geography; establishes and maintains relationships with KOLs, HCPs, clinics and institutions, payers, and other stakeholders within the MG area

Professional Experience/Qualifications

Education

**Level:**

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Animal Nutrition Trial Specialist to support the planning, technical evaluation, and analysis of animal nutrition research and feeding trials. This role focuses on remote trial protocol review, nutritional data analysis, feed formulation assessment, laboratory report review, research documentation, and virtual coordination with animal nutrition and veterinary teams.

The successful candidate will collaborate with animal nutritionists, veterinarians, feed scientists, researchers, laboratory personnel, and agricultural stakeholders to evaluate trial outcomes, assess nutritional performance, and recommend evidence-based improvements. The position is entirely remote and does not involve physical animal handling, feeding, sample collection, laboratory testing, or on-site trial supervision.

Key Responsibilities

* Review animal nutrition trial protocols, study objectives, feeding schedules, and technical documentation.
* Analyze nutritional trial data, including feed intake, nutrient composition, growth performance, feed conversion, and relevant health indicators.
* Evaluate feed formulation records and assess the nutritional suitability of ingredients and dietary specifications.
* Review laboratory reports relating to feed composition, nutrient analysis, digestibility, and other relevant nutritional measurements.
* Assess trial results and identify trends, variations, and potential factors affecting animal performance.
* Support statistical and comparative analysis of nutritional trial outcomes.
* Review research documentation for completeness, consistency, traceability, and adherence to approved study protocols.
* Collaborate remotely with qualified local personnel to investigate data discrepancies and monitor trial progress.
* Support the preparation of technical reports, research summaries, performance dashboards, and nutritional recommendations.
* Evaluate opportunities to improve feed efficiency, nutrient utilization, and trial methodology.
* Assist with the review of animal welfare documentation and compliance records within the scope of assigned responsibilities.
* Maintain accurate records and comply with applicable research integrity, animal welfare, confidentiality, and data management requirements.

Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Animal Nutrition, Veterinary Science, Animal Science, Agricultural Science, Feed Technology, or a related discipline.
* Significant professional experience in animal nutrition research, feeding trials, feed formulation, or livestock nutrition analysis.

jobs.title: Country Medical Director
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Our CMDs drive scientific, medical and clinical excellence and innovation through strategic leadership, strong cross-functional interactions and continuous engagement with the scientific community and key health care ecosystem stakeholders and as a consequence we should see accelerated adoption of our transformative medicines as standard of care. CMDs ensure medical compliance and superior patient outcomes while fostering a high performance culture and continuous professional development of the Medical team. CMDs are part of the affiliate’s leadership team and are the local delegate of authority of Roche’s Pharma Chief Medical Officer.
  
  
**Core Accountabilities**
Strategic Leadership
  
  

* As part of the affiliate leadership team the CMD has a shared responsibility for the affiliate enterprise strategy, short, mid and long term outcomes with an E2E perspective, prioritization and adequate resourcing as well as impactful delivery of the agreed business objectives
* Establish and maintain highest medical and scientific rigor in all areas, particularly in our current Therapeutic Areas and Diseases with end-to-end leadership
* Ensure business success through competitive medical strategies built from fit for purpose evidence generation, value demonstration, scientific data positioning and dissemination whilst maintaining integrity and preserve the company’s reputation
* Represent Roche and our scientific positions and portfolio as appropriate among key external stakeholders eg. ecosystem representatives including , Drug regulatory authorities, policy makers, scientific partnerships, media interactions, patient advocacy, other pharma companies (individual or association). It is understood that for selected key customers the CMD serves as the primary point of contact with the ambition to drive positive healthcare system changes and where feasible earlier adoption of our transformative medicines
* Act as a role model mastering our Roche leadership framework (Visionary, Architect, coach & Catalyst) and ensure medical team members work effectively cross-functional for the benefit of the pipeline and on-market portfolio centered on patients and anchored in our innovation & science
* Build scientifically sound medical teams capable of making portfolio differentiating decisions that translate into clinical practice adoption and broad access to our portfolio in full alignment with country opportunities and challenges
* Ensure medical and scientific contribution to the development of competitive and differentiating local and regional strategies and appropriate locally adapted execution of tactics across the entire life cycle of our portfolio - overall balancing rigor and speed
* Enhance local and cross-country scientific activities to accelerate advocacy, community engagement, clinical adoption, lasting preference and access to our portfolio
* Support and foster integrated Outcome-based customer experience based on customers needs informing scientific and medical interventions that catalyze clinical practice adoption and advocacy

License to Operate (LTO) Champion
  
  

* Assurance of medical compliance as the local delegate of authority of Roche`s Pharma CMO
* Accountable for appropriate resourcing and qualification of employees in Medical Functions and their adherence to assigned trainings to fulfill our LTO obligations
* Local integrator of affiliate License to Operate (LTO) functions namely clinical operations, regulatory, quality, PV safety to ensure that affiliate License to Operate functions work coherently and integratively at local level and to cover local and - if applicable - regional accountabilities in line with rules and regulations
* Ensures appropriate risk assessment and issue management in the LTO or Medical Domain via either the Affiliate Medical Compliance Oversight process or via formed fit for purpose cross-functional teams
* Accountable for the appropriate approval process of non-promotional and promotional materials ensuring compliance with applicable local and global requirements. Accountable for the strategic and appropriate provision of medical Grants, Sponsorships and Donations
* In Digital Health solutions, the CMD is accountable to ensure adherence to quality standards, rules and regulations. Considerations of the risks, the portfolio fit and/or desired return of investment rests with the affiliate leadership team

**Who you are?**
**Required Education And Experience**

* Medical degree is a preference, while pharmD or human-centered scientific PhD (e.g. molecular biology) with relevant experience may be considered
* Solid understanding of pharmaceutical business with profound Medical Affairs experience including medical scientific and strategic aspects of drug development and commercialization and Medical Compliance including experience and knowledge on GCP, GVP, Healthcare Compliance
* Understanding of the local health care system, incl. regulatory and payer environment

**Required Competencies And Skills**

* Business and financial acumen
* Excellent command of both written and spoken English with strong communication skills
* Forward thinking and innovative with ability to work across organizations at all levels
* Ability to demonstration the company’s Values, Leadership Commitments and Core Competencies
* Ability to operate successfully in a matrix environment with shared accountability and responsibilities
* Functional competencies, including but not limited to evidence generation, value demonstration, scientific data positioning and dissemination, regulatory environment understanding, prioritization and planning skills, clinical research, communication & executive presence

Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  
**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
