jobs.title: Manager, Deputy QPPV UAE & Regulatory Affairs MEA
jobs.description:
Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Deputy QPPV UAE & Regulatory Affairs MEA professional to join our regional team in Dubai.
  
  
This is a unique hybrid opportunity combining UAE pharmacovigilance responsibilities with broad Regulatory Affairs exposure across the Middle East and Africa. Approximately 20% of the role will focus on Deputy QPPV responsibilities, with the remaining 80% focused on Regulatory Affairs activities across MEA Partner Business markets.
  
  
As our company-employed, UAE-based Deputy QPPV, you will provide qualified backup coverage to the UAE QPPV and help ensure continued pharmacovigilance oversight, business continuity and inspection readiness. At the same time, you will lead and coordinate regulatory activities across MEA, working closely with local partners, distributors and cross-functional teams to support product registrations, lifecycle management and continued product availability.
  
  
The Role
  
  
**In This Position, You Will**

* Act as the UAE-based Deputy QPPV, providing qualified backup coverage to the UAE QPPV and supporting local pharmacovigilance governance, compliance and business continuity.
* Maintain PV inspection and audit readiness, supporting local documentation, safety agreements, compliance monitoring, training evidence, CAPAs and timely resolution of findings.
* Support oversight and escalation of local safety activities, including adverse event reporting, safety information exchange, risk-minimization activities, product information updates and urgent safety matters.
* Plan and deliver regulatory activities across MEA markets, including new registrations, variations, renewals, labeling and safety updates, post-approval commitments and lifecycle maintenance.
* Translate local and regional regulatory requirements into practical strategies supporting product supply, launches, market expansion and commercial priorities.
* Manage regulatory interfaces with distributors, local agents and third-party partners, ensuring responsibilities, timelines and compliance expectations are clearly defined and monitored.
* Support interactions with Health Authorities and relevant industry bodies, directly or through local partners as appropriate.
* Monitor evolving regulatory requirements across the region and provide regulatory intelligence and recommendations to regional and global stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate regulatory data and records in company systems, including Veeva RIM or equivalent regulatory information management platforms.
* Collaborate closely with Pharmacovigilance, Quality, Medical, Supply Chain, Commercial, Legal and global and regional Regulatory Affairs teams to manage risks and ensure compliant execution.

**Essential**
Your Skills and Experience
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy.
* Valid UAE Pharmacist license.
* Educational and professional background sufficient to meet applicable UAE Deputy QPPV requirements.
* Typically 10+ years of relevant pharmaceutical, biotechnology or healthcare industry experience, with significant experience in Regulatory Affairs and/or Pharmacovigilance.
* Strong practical knowledge of UAE pharmacovigilance and regulatory requirements.
* Demonstrated experience with regulatory activities such as product registrations, variations, renewals, labeling or safety updates and post-approval commitments.
* Experience with pharmacovigilance systems, local safety oversight, inspection readiness, safety agreements, compliance monitoring and issue escalation.
* Experience managing distributors, local agents or third-party service providers, ideally across Middle East and Africa markets.
* Fluent English and Arabic, both written and spoken.
* Ability to work effectively across multiple markets and within a complex global matrix.
* Strong judgment, prioritization, stakeholder management and problem-solving capabilities.

**Preferred**

* Advanced degree or postgraduate qualification in Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs or a related discipline.
* Broad knowledge of regulatory and pharmacovigilance requirements across the Middle East and Africa.
* Experience using Veeva RIM or similar regulatory information management systems.

The successful candidate will lead and contribute to a large-scale epidemiological analysis, with a focus on chronic disease risk factors and health outcomes. PHRC offers a multidisciplinary research environment with access to clinical, lifestyle and behavioral data.
  
  
Applicants must hold a PhD in epidemiology, public health, biostatistics, population health, or in other related field, with no more than five years post receipt of this degree, with a proven record of scientific publications and demonstrable experience in analyzing large-scale epidemiological or population-based datasets. Experience with longitudinal data analysis, statistical modeling in Stata, SPSS, R, Python, or related statistical software is highly desirable. Terms of employment include a competitive salary and benefits.
  
  
To be considered, all applicants must submit a cover letter, curriculum vitae, transcript of degree/ copy of highest degree, research statement, and contact information of at least two professional references who can provide letters of recommendation. jobs.description:
**Job Description**
*GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.*
**Job Title:**
Medical Science Liaison Oncology, Gulf
  
  
**Reports to:**
Medical Affairs Manager, Gulf (Therapy Area Medical Lead, Gulf)
  
  
**Based in:**
Dubai, UAE
  
  
**Job Purpose And Key Responsibilities**
The Medical Science Liaison will be responsible for:
  
  

* Drive impact through robust scientific exchange, improving healthcare professionals scientific understanding of our data, and supporting optimal care for people living with therapy area associated diseases in the Gulf.
* Capturing important scientific insights from the external environment to support GSK’s research efforts as well inform overall medical strategy.
* Identifying Investigators and sites for clinical trial participation, recruitment for clinical trials.
* Attending relevant congresses, organizing advisory boards, training, and coaching other MSLs in the execution of field medical responsibilities.
* Following regulatory and corporate guidelines, as the MSL you'll ensure execution of activities in support of the functional and departmental program strategy.
* The Medical Science Liaison will be responsible for the medical & clinical aspects of GSK Gulf within the assigned Therapy Area/s (including oncology, onco-hematology).

**Accountability:**

* Represent Management during field interactions with healthcare professionals, support external experts and seek relationship development and maintenance
* Support clinical research programming across the continuum (Investigator sponsored research, Cooperative Group and Collaborator research, Company Sponsored trials)
* Provide business with regular updates on insights/opportunities
* Drive unwavering compliant work practices
* Support safe and appropriate use of research compounds and products
* Serve as a scientific, clinical, and medical content expert
* Partner within all areas of Medical Affairs (e.g. Medical Directors, Medical Governance, Medical Information, Value Access)
* Establish and maintain a compliant, supportive partnership with Sales team and other counterparts within the Commercial organization
* Manage all programs within their designated scope, schedule, and resources

Given the complexity of the disease landscape and the urgent need for treatment to reach patients, you should be able to demonstrate following:
  
  

* Develop and execute on strategies that shape the external environment without significant oversight and at a rapid pace.
* Work within matrix teams and have a strong ability to influence and align the team and strategy to seize the opportunities identified with external organizations.
* Demonstrated leadership, communication, and presentation skills
* Command respect among senior executives, both inside and outside GSK.
* Identify, consolidate, and communicate key insights and subsequently contribute to the translation of these insights into executable and innovative Medical Affairs strategies and plans that clearly define the value of our medicines / products to our customers.
* Identify and engage the external community appropriately in robust scientific dialogue that generates insight and advances scientific and medical understanding as well as secure advice to inform the development of products of value, for the benefit of patients/ consumers.
* Anticipate the changing healthcare, regulatory & competitive environment throughout the product lifespan; delivers innovative strategies to inform evidence-based prescribing/ usage within this environment e.g. new comparator or real-world efficacy data.
* Understand the impact of new data on the value/positioning of products in guidelines/ formularies.

**Why You?**
**Basic Qualifications & Skills**
**We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:**

* Medical Doctor/Medical Degree/Life sciences Degree. Post graduate studies is an advantage
* Experience and success, supported by evidence, in MSL organizations in therapeutic oncology (mandatory)
* Preferably oncology experience – (Lung / Gyn-Onco) - within last 2-3 years
* A demonstrated understanding of the country/area healthcare environment, including knowledge of health technology assessments and market access challenges.
* Understanding of pharmaceutical ethics and governance; and a clear understanding of pharmaceutical compliance policies and procedures
* Basic financial and budget management
* Prior experience with product launches
* Prior experience with commercial and/or government payers
* Prior experience and willingness to travel extensively (across the Gulf and globally)
* Expert public speaking and written communication skills
* Skilled in multiple computer-based tools, in addition to software programs such as Word, PowerPoint and Excel
* Fluency in English, Arabic language is an advantage

**Personal skills:**

* Values based collaborator – respectful and accountable
* Able to relate and work with a wide range of people to achieve results
* Successful and superior influencing skills across all levels of the organization and with external collaborators
* Problem solving and risk-mitigation skills
* Confident, positive attitude, enthusiastic and charismatic
* Strategic and creative thinker
* Strong time management and organizational skills
* Able to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment

***Please note that relocation support cannot be provided; therefore, only candidates who are already based in the indicated territory can be considered.***
*Please take a copy of the Job Description, as this will not be available post closure of the advert.
  
  
When applying for this role, please use the ‘cover letter’ of the online application or your CV to describe how you meet the competencies for this role, as outlined in the job requirements above. The information that you have provided in your cover letter and CV will be used to assess your application.*
**Skills**
Digital Fluency, Enterprise Thinking, External Stakeholder Management, High Impact Communication, Medical Affairs, Patient Impact
  
  
**Why GSK?
  
  
Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Title:**
Senior Sales Representative

**Location:**
Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

**Position Type:**
Full Time

**Overview:**

The Technical Sales Representative – Farm Solutions will support the growth of Agrivita’s Farm Solutions portfolio, starting with Biosecurity Solutions, by creating demand at Small Poultry farms (SPF), Vet Pharmacies, Hatcheries and Slaughterhouses’ channels, conducting structured customer visits, demonstrating correct product application, and converting technical needs into sustainable sales. The role requires a young, high-potential profile with strong learning agility, poultry technical grounding, excellent interpersonal skills, and the ability to build trust with farm owners, veterinarians, production managers, and farm teams. Exposure to large animals is an added advantage.

**How Will You Make An Impact?**

**Sales Operations**

* **Demand Generation:**
  Promote Agrivita Farm Solutions, with immediate focus on Biosecurity Solutions, across poultry farms, SPF, Vet Pharmacies, Hatcheries, Slaughterhouses and relevant retail/outlet customers.
* **Poultry Technical Support:**
  Provide first-line technical guidance on cleaning and disinfection programs, biosecurity routines, product selection, dilution, application method, and safe handling in line with approved labels and company guidance.
* **Customer Development:**
  Identify and qualify new farm opportunities, build strong relationships with owners, veterinarians, farm managers and production teams, and follow up consistently to convert interest into orders.
* **Farm Visits & Demonstrations:**
  Conduct regular face-to-face visits, product demonstrations, farm walk-throughs and post-visit follow-ups to reinforce correct usage and value creation.
* **Technical Learning & Product Mastery:**
  Rapidly build and maintain strong knowledge of the Farm Solutions portfolio, poultry production basics, disease pressure drivers, and competitive offerings.

Location: Dubai (UAE) | Remote
  
  
**About The Role**
Are you ready to build your commercial career in a specialised market where animal biosecurity, food safety and hygiene make a real difference?
  
  
We are looking for a
**Junior Sales Representative – Animal Biosecurity & Food & Beverage (Middle East)**
to support the growth of LANXESS’ Material Protection Products business across the Middle East. You will focus on developing new business, strengthening customer and distributor relationships, and expanding our presence across animal biosecurity and Food & Beverage applications.
  
  
The portfolio includes
**speciality biocides, disinfectants, hygiene solutions and preservation technologies**
used across animal production, poultry, dairy, livestock, food processing, beverage manufacturing and related industrial hygiene markets.
  
  
This is a commercially focused role for someone who enjoys being close to customers, spotting opportunities and developing business across different markets and cultures. You will work with customers, distributors, and internal technical, regulatory, and marketing colleagues while building your knowledge of the region and our applications.
  
  
The position is based in Dubai and covers the wider Middle East region.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Build and strengthen relationships with customers, regional producers, multinational companies, distributors, consultants and other industry partners.

* Collaborate with regulatory, marketing and technical colleagues on product registrations, approvals and market-access activities.
* Monitor customer needs, market trends, competitors and regulatory developments, and turn those insights into commercial opportunities.
* Maintain sales forecasts, opportunities, customer visit reports and relevant market intelligence through CRM and IBP processes.
* Represent LANXESS at relevant exhibitions, conferences, trade associations and technical seminars.

* Travel regularly across the Middle East to meet customers, distributors and other business partners.

**Work Experience**
We are looking for someone early in their commercial career who combines business drive with an interest in technical products and customer applications.

This opportunity lets you develop your sales career in a regional, customer-facing role covering the Middle East, working with an international speciality-chemicals business and a technically differentiated portfolio spanning animal biosecurity, hygiene, and Food & Beverage applications.

Provide individualized medical nutrition therapy (MNT) through a multi-disciplinary approach for inpatients and or outpatients in Health Care Facilities / Homecare/ Kidney Care and or Ambulatory Healthcare Services.
  
  
MNT is implemented according to the American Dietetic Association (ADA) Nutrition Care Process (NCP) which provides a framework for the Clinical Dietitians to individualize care, taking into account the patient’s needs and values and using the best scientific evidence available to make decisions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Encourages teamwork by creating an environment of empowerment and accountability

Implements Departmental standards of practice
  
  
Able to utilize marketing techniques and participation in revenue generation, where appropriate
  
  
May be responsible in maintaining sufficient inventory of nutrition consumable items, general material management and equipment required for patient care and performance of duties
  
  
Responsible for Medical Nutrition Therapy and thus assess patients using the Nutrition Care Process (NCP) which is a systematic approach to providing high-quality nutrition care. The NCP consists of four distinct, interrelated steps: Nutrition Assessment, Nutrition Diagnosis, Nutrition Intervention, and Nutrition Monitoring and Evaluation.
  
  
Responsible to individualize and evaluate care and service processes within organization systems specific to the discipline of nutrition and dietetics.
  
  
Documenting a comprehensive assessment for all consulted and referred patients as per facility policies and procedures.
  
  
Discuss and/or refer complex cases to Senior Dietitians/Supervisor for guidance to ensure high-quality evidence based nutrition care.
  
  
Responsible to update nutritional standards of care and procedures for the facility and to promote evidence based guidelines.

May liase with Food Service on preparation of therapeutic diets, ordering appropriate menus and additional/alternative food products for individual patients
  
  
Communicating complex sensitive information in an understandable form to patients, carers, medical, nursing and food service using negotiation, counseling and behavioral change skills. This will frequently involve clients/carers who have complex emotional, physical and psychological problems
  
  
Communicating goals and progress of nutritional care plan to referring health care professionals by writing in medical case notes, file where applicable, letter to medical practitioner or verbal communication
  
  
Plan and organize provision of Nutritional items for patients being discharged on enteral (tube) feeding. May liaise with Long Term Facilities and their healthcare team to communicate nutritional plan of care.
  
  
Follow the Department of Health Abu Dhabi’s Standards of Practice
  
  
Clinical Dietitian are required to maintain Registration/license as required by the Department of Health Abu Dhabi

Research should be evidence based medicine, clinical research on human subjects within the realm of: national laws, international and local standards and guidelines, and accreditation standard requirement, by adopting the highest ethical and human subject protection criteria.
  
  
Conducting research must comply with the guidelines of local regulatory bodies such as Department of Health, Abu Dhabi.
  
  
Prepare and participate in accreditation activities. Identifying opportunities for improvement Promoting and maintaining quality in all services and ensure continuous quality improvement measures are in place
  
  
Follow facility approved reference guidelines or follow the Academy of Nutrition, ASPEN and ESPEN nutritional guidelines

Communicating in a professional and courteous manner with patients, family and other medical personnel as necessary to obtain information for nutrition diagnosis, nutrition assessment, intervention, monitoring and evaluation to explain procedures, clarify orders and communicate status
  
  
Able to establish rapport with clients/patients or groups when conducting nutrition education in an environment that enhances nutrition education outcomes
  
  
Planning and delivering training and education sessions for facility and department staff
  
  
Acting as a preceptor of dietetics or other students. Instructing and training dietetic interns, when applicable
  
  
Developing and presenting seminars or lectures for health professionals or students
  
  
Participating in departmental education projects and presentations annually
  
  
Writing, preparing and reviewing new nutrition education material
  
  
Utilizing varied techniques to educate patients regarding nutrition goals
  
  
**Required**
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* BSc degree in Nutrition & Dietetics from an accredited

program

jobs.description:
**Position: AMET Public Affairs Lead**
**Reporting to: AMET GM**
**Location: UAE or Turkey**
*Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.*
*Our mission: to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be for over half a billion consumers worldwide.*
*At the core of this mission is our 100+ loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and four specialized science and innovation development centers.*
*Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan. B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet.*
*Find out more about our mission to bring health in your hands at*
*www.opella.com.*
**Job Purpose**

* Opella is looking to recruit a seasoned public affairs & policy lead for their business in Africa. This role is designed to achieve Consumer Healthcare business objectives and growth ambitions by shaping the external public policy environment to support Self Care and ensuring business strategy is informed by a clear understanding of the external policy environment, as well as stakeholders’ needs and expectations.
* This role is vital to shape the external policy and operating environment in support of Self Care, conducive to grow the Opella Consumer Healthcare business in the AMET Zone (Africa Middle East and Turkey).
* The role will require a strong government affairs experience with a track record of success in public policy advocacy with the agility to navigate the complex policy, regulatory, and business environment. The candidate must demonstrate a strong understanding of the continent’s landscape complexity and is able to provide clear guidance and strategic counsel to the Opella business in support of its growth ambitions in AMET - Africa Middle East & Turkey.
* Finally, the role will involve strengthening our participation in the regional industry association (MENAP-SMI), as well as those local trade associations in the key markets to support the Opella growth ambitions.

**Key Results/Accountabilities**

* The primary objective of this role is to establish and execute a robust public affairs & policy strategy and action plan aimed to grow the CHC business in AMET.
* Identify key policy priorities and levers to support business growth, provide a robust analysis of the self care policy and operating environment in AMET.
* Regularly inform the AMET GM, the Global Public Affairs Head and other relevant CHC business leaders/partners (i.e., CHC Commercial/Categories, Regulatory Affairs) to ensure seamless understanding and alignment on issues and topics.
* Anticipate public affairs & policy trends and competitive dynamics (i.e., self care, e-commerce, pharmacy channel, etc.) that represent opportunities or threats to the business; and build a clear plan of action to leverage the opportunities or mitigate threats to Opella's reputation and to the business.
* Monitor external developments and effectively communicate potential threats or opportunities to the AMET GM and the Global Public Affairs Head, and CHC business leaders/partners.
* Lead in proposing CHC positions on key issues affecting the CHC business and industry in AMET– in alignment with the AMET Zone GM, relevant counterpart CHC functions and the Global Public Affairs – and develop position papers/statements to advocate with policy makers and other key external audiences, ensuring internal sign-off prior to engagement.
* Strengthen engagement with key external stakeholders, and foster new ones, given the evolving policy environment around Self Care.
* Lead and work collaboratively with cross-functional teams ensuring that business risk is mitigated, and opportunities are swiftly identified and successfully executed.
* Develop scenarios and risk mitigation plans, which reflect a thorough understanding of the policy, government decision-making processes, decision-makers, and influencers, and provide recommendations and solutions to the CHC business
* Gain a clear understanding of Sanofi’s Consumer Healthcare strategy for growth and contribute to the formulation of such strategies.
* Remain current and alert on relevant industry changes (activities likely to include monitoring trade journals and press releases (in collaboration with the Communications team), networking with agenda-setting institutions like WHO and the African Union, venture capital firms and companies, and attending conferences to learn about and monitor new business development opportunities).

**KEY WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**

* The position holder will be a key member of the extended leadership team of AMET.
* Strong interactions with relevant functions in the AMET Zone including e.g. digital, marketing/categories, regulatory, finance, medical, communications, among others.
* Strong partnership and collaboration with the AMET Science Head and AMET Communications Lead.
* A wide-ranging network of external stakeholders to manage in the AMET healthcare ecosystem, including establishing a strong presence in our industry associations in both the regional (MENAP-SMI) and priority countries to drive the Opella agenda.
* Selection, direction, and oversight over third party agencies, firms, and/or consultants to support this role in accomplishing its objectives
* See list below for key working relationships:

**AMET GM and leadership team**

* Country Heads and leadership team (key countries supported)
* Global Public Affairs team
* Communications counterparts
* Science counterparts

**Skills, Experience & Knowledge Requirements**

* A high-calibre professional with comprehensive working experience in the public affairs, policy, and market access space (at least 8-10 years) and track record of success delivering on shaping the external environment to address business objectives; broad cross functional understanding & general knowledge of the pharmaceutical business is preferred; knowledge and experience in the field of Consumer Healthcare/FMCG a plus
* Solid experience navigating the AMET Zone healthcare ecosystem, preferably with strong existing network, having past experience proactively dealing with government ministries that have oversight on health policy, public health, reimbursement, finance, among others.
* Proven track record of successful initiatives in public affairs, market access/development, innovative reputation-building, and stakeholder engagement is required. Experience conceiving programs that join diverse stakeholders to deliver on a common public interest is an asset.
* Experience working in highly regulated environment and a demonstrated understanding of AMET's various national, provincial/regional health authorities, including experience dealing with World Health Organization Regional Office for Africa; knowledge/familiarity of New Partnership for Africa’s Development (NEPAD), the African Medicines Regulatory Harmonization (AMRH) initiative, and the African Continental Free Trade Area are a plus.
* An entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to understand consumer needs and business transformations to create new business opportunities to build CHC’s business in the AMET Zone.
* Experience working in a matrixed environment and driving results through influence is required, but with a Compliance-first mindset.
* Ability to work under a multi-country accountability, with experience managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced and matrix environment, demonstrate flexibility and superior organizational, analytical, strategic thinking, and decision-making skills.
* Results-oriented with strong cross-functional collaboration mindset.
* Exercise a high level of independent judgment even in challenging, complex situations is required.

jobs.title: Fraud Senior Analyst –Payment Integrity Provider Investigation
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**
The Fraud Senior Analyst plays a critical role in protecting the organization’s International Health portfolio by leading Fraud, Waste and Abuse (FWA) investigations, driving measurable affordability outcomes, and strengthening prevention strategies across the claims lifecycle. The position combines investigative expertise, data-driven insight, and stakeholder influence to reduce financial leakage, improve claim governance and support sustainable savings delivery across the region. This role is responsible for detecting and recovering FWA payments, creating solutions to prevent claims overpayment and future spend monitoring within a dedicated region. He / She will work closely with other PI team members, Network, Medical Economics, Data Analytics, Claims Operations, Clinical partners, and Product.
  
  
**Job Profile**
Operating with a high degree of independence, the Fraud Senior Analyst owns end-to-end investigative activities within a dedicated region. The role extends beyond case handling to include proactive identification of systemic risks, development of preventive controls, and partnership with regional and global stakeholders to enhance Payment Integrity strategy. The incumbent acts as a subject matter expert, contributing to operational improvements, automation initiatives, and cross-market collaboration to strengthen FWA detection and mitigation capabilities.
  
  
**Reports to:**
Fraud Manager
  
  
**Critical Tasks And Expected Contributions / Results**

* Lead FWA investigations across International Markets, applying investigative judgement to identify billing anomalies, emerging fraud typologies, and systemic risk patterns.
* Deliver quantifiable financial impact through cost containment, recoveries, and forward-looking prevention initiatives aligned to regional savings objectives.
* Translate data insights into actionable investigation strategies by partnering closely with Data and Analytics teams to refine triggers, reporting frameworks and automation opportunities.
* Influence provider behavior through structured Provider audit engagement, negotiation, and collaboration with regional and global stakeholders to reduce future risk exposure.
* Drive continuous improvement of Payment Integrity processes by identifying operational gaps and proposing scalable solutions that enhance efficiency and accuracy.
* Produce clear, defensible investigative findings and recommendations for senior stakeholders, ensuring transparency and audit readiness.
* Ensure investigations and cost containment actions are balanced with fair member outcomes, regulatory expectations, and client commitments.
* Collaborate with Customer Service and Client Management teams to support clear, consistent communication approaches that protect member experience while maintaining investigative integrity
* Operate within established governance frameworks, ensuring investigative activities are compliant with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and audit standards.
* Collaborate with the Member Investigation Unit on Fraud cases when required.
* Perform periodic TPA oversight and partner with TPAs on FWA investigations when required.
* Partner with Data Analytics team in building future FWA triggers automation.
* Mentor and provide support through knowledge sharing, quality review input and guidance on investigative best practices and share FWA claiming schemes.
* Ad hoc duties as assigned

**Key Challenges / Anticipated Changes In Environment**

* Rapid evolution of provider billing models and fraud schemes requiring adaptive investigative approaches.
* Increasing claim volumes and evolving FWA typologies requiring advanced analytical and investigative skills
* Balancing operational turnaround times with deep investigative rigor, stakeholder expectations and member experience considerations
* Expanding use of automation, data analytics, and cross-market collaboration within Payment Integrity operations
* Managing complex provider relationships while maintaining firm compliance and cost containment positions
* Navigating diverse regulatory and healthcare environments across multiple international markets

**Developmental Value Of Position**

* Strengthens strategic thinking through ownership of regional investigative portfolios and measurable savings delivery.
* Builds advanced expertise in international health insurance investigations, audit frameworks, and provider engagement strategies
* Develops leadership capabilities through ownership of complex cases, cross-functional collaboration, and influence without direct people management
* Provides exposure to advanced analytics initiatives, provider strategy discussions and global Payment Integrity frameworks
* Opportunity to deepen technical knowledge in healthcare claims coding, regulatory consideration and fraud risk management

**Experience/Knowledge, Education And Other Requirements**

* You should enjoy working in a team of high performers, who hold each other accountable to perform to their very best.
* Experience of investigation within payment integrity or similar discipline.
* Minimum of 4 years of health insurance or health care provider experience.
* Knowledge of Mainframe, GlobalCare, Actisure and / or Diamond essential.
* Knowledge of claims coding, regulatory rules and medical policy.
* Medical/ paramedical qualification is a definite plus.
* Critical mind-set with ability to identify cost containment opportunities.
* Experience with data analytics
* Demonstrated strong organization skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to quickly learn new and complex tasks and concepts.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to balance multiple priorities at once and deliver on tight timelines.
* Flexibility to work with global teams and varying time zones effectively.
* Experience in liaising with internal stakeholders and ability to work independently within a cross functional team.
* Strong organization skills with the ability to juggle priorities and work under pressure to meet tight deadlines.
* Fluency in foreign languages in addition to fluent English is a strong plus.

**About The Cigna Group**
Cigna Healthcare, a division of The Cigna Group, is an advocate for better health through every stage of life. We guide our customers through the health care system, empowering them with the information and insight they need to make the best choices for improving their health and vitality. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science-based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

**Key responsibilities**

  
  

**Label update implementation and asset control**

Update records from approved materials and documented decisions and flag incomplete or conflicting entries for resolution.

Link claims records to relevant promotional materials and source documents to maintain traceability across updates.

Maintain print inventory records and coordinate stock checks, replenishment requests and distribution with relevant partners. Flag low stock, excess inventory and obsolete materials and coordinate agreed actions.

Coordinate replacement or retirement of printed materials following label or content updates. Track vendor production and delivery status, resolve routine issues and retain print and inventory records.

  
  

**Required qualifications**

Experience coordinating marketing materials, document control or regulated review workflows.

Strong attention to detail and ability to manage asset records, timelines and follow up across stakeholders.

Ability to coordinate multiple asset updates and maintain clear ownership, approval status, source traceability and version history.

Ability to coordinate vendor deliverables, maintain resource and inventory records and escalate label, claim and review questions to appropriate subject matter experts.

Experience maintaining field resource guides, approved claims workbooks or source libraries.

Experience coordinating print production, physical material distribution or inventory management with agencies and vendors.

Experience supporting Repatha, cardiovascular marketing or field sales teams.

As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by **bringing together data, science, technology** and **human ingenuity** to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a **client-first mentality** to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

  
:

**Content Platform & Services Manager**

**About the Role**

ZS seeks a Content Platform & Services Manager to join our team in Bengaluru, India. This role will own end-to-end content operations for marketing and promotional materials and Medical-Legal-Regulatory (MLR) review workflows. The position sits at the intersection of content production and compliance process management, ensuring that content moves efficiently and compliantly from creation through approval to publication and archival.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience managing content lifecycle platforms, such as Veeva Vault PromoMats or an equivalent platform, in a regulated industry and is comfortable partnering with Marketing, Medical, Legal, and Regulatory stakeholders to keep review cycles on track. The role will also lead the evaluation, build, and rollout of AI-based accelerators, such as automated tagging, claims and reference checking, and pre-MLR quality screening, that reduce manual effort and accelerate review cycles.

We are looking for someone with 10+ years of experience in content operations, marketing operations, or promotional review management, ideally within pharmaceutical, life sciences, or healthcare industries. A bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, marketing, communications, or a related field is required; an MBA is preferred.

**What You'll Do**

* **Own content operations.** Manage intake, tagging and metadata, routing, review coordination, approval, publishing, and archival of promotional and non-promotional materials.
* **Manage MLR reviews.** Schedule review cycles, track reviewer comments and claims, ensure timely turnaround, and maintain complete audit trails.
* **Administer the platform.** Optimize Veeva Vault PromoMats or similar DAM/CLM systems, including user access, workflows, and metadata taxonomy.
* **Enable review-ready content.** Partner with Brand and Marketing teams to plan content pipelines and ensure correct references, claims substantiation, and formatting.
* **Coordinate cross-functionally.** Work with Medical, Legal, Regulatory, and Compliance reviewers to resolve bottlenecks and maintain SLA adherence.
* **Maintain compliance.** Ensure content meets internal standards, brand guidelines, and applicable pharmaceutical marketing and regulatory requirements prior to release.
* **Govern the content lifecycle.** Maintain accurate records of approved content, expiry and renewal dates, and withdrawal of outdated materials.
* **Improve operations.** Identify inefficiencies and drive continuous improvement across workflows, templates, and SOPs.
* **Report performance.** Create leadership dashboards covering review cycle time, throughput, bottlenecks, and compliance metrics.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary
  
  
The Quality Assurance Manager leads the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the facility's Quality Management System and patient safety programs. The role ensures compliance with Dubai Health Authority (DHA) requirements and international accreditation standards, including Joint Commission International (JCI), and drives a culture of safety and continuous improvement across clinical and non-clinical departments.
  
  
**Reports to:**
Chief Executive Officer / Medical Director |
**Location:**
Dubai, UAE
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Quality Management System
  
  

* Develop, implement, and maintain the Quality Management System, including annual quality and patient safety plans aligned with organizational objectives.
* Maintain controlled policies, procedures, and guidelines with effective document control and version management.
* Establish quality objectives, indicators, targets, and improvement priorities.

Patient Safety and Risk Management
  
  

* Lead patient safety initiatives; monitor incidents, adverse events, near misses, medication errors, falls, and complaints.
* Coordinate incident investigations and Root Cause Analysis (RCA); develop and track Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).
* Conduct risk assessments, maintain risk registers, and escalate serious or high-risk findings to senior management.

Audits and Performance Monitoring
  
  

* Plan and execute annual clinical and operational audits, including medical record, infection prevention and control, medication management, and patient identification audits.
* Develop and monitor KPIs and quality indicators; prepare monthly and quarterly dashboards for senior leadership and committees.
* Track closure and effectiveness of corrective actions.

Regulatory Compliance and Accreditation
  
  

* Ensure continuous readiness for DHA inspections and other regulatory assessments.
* Oversee preparation for JCI and other accreditation surveys, including mock surveys and gap assessments.
* Monitor changes in UAE healthcare regulations and accreditation standards and implement required changes.
* Liaise with regulators, surveyors, and external auditors.

Continuous Improvement and Leadership
  
  

* Lead quality improvement projects using PDCA/PDSA, Lean, and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Chair or coordinate quality and patient safety committees, producing agendas, reports, and action trackers.
* Manage, mentor, and develop the quality team; provide staff training on quality, safety, and accreditation requirements.
* Monitor patient complaints and satisfaction results and lead patient experience initiatives.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Nursing, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, or a related field from a recognized Western institution (US, UK, Canada, Australia, or EU); Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum 7 years of healthcare experience, including at least 3 years in a quality, patient safety, or accreditation leadership role.
* Proven experience leading a facility through successful JCI accreditation or re-accreditation.
* Strong working knowledge of DHA regulations and UAE healthcare standards.
* Professional certification preferred: CPHQ, Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt, or equivalent.
* Eligibility for DHA professional licensing, where applicable.

Core Competencies
  
  

* Strategic thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills, and data-driven decision-making.
* Strong knowledge of quality improvement and statistical methodologies.
* Ability to influence stakeholders at all levels and lead change.
* Excellent communication skills in English; Arabic is an advantage.

**Senior Manager Quality & Risk (Hospital) | Dubai, UAE**

**About Us**

Our client is a new premium tertiary hospital in Dubai Healthcare City, opening in 2027. Backed by Scope Investment, it is being developed as an academic medical centre for the region. Advanced gastroenterology is its flagship programme, supported by a growing range of specialist services and centres of excellence. The hospital combines the latest medical technology with an academic approach to care, teaching and research, in a state-of-the-art building with premium design and a seamless digital patient journey. Care is physician-led and organised around the patient, and the hospital is designed to meet JCI standards from day one. Joining us now means helping to shape a new hospital from the ground up and building your career in an academic setting, with teaching, research, and fellowship opportunities alongside clinical practice.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager Quality & Risk to establish and lead the Quality, Patient Safety and Risk Management function for our new multi-specialty tertiary hospital in Dubai.

The successful candidate will lead the hospital’s quality governance, regulatory and accreditation readiness, patient safety, clinical risk management, performance improvement, clinical audit and policy management programmes.

This role requires a senior healthcare quality leader with proven UAE hospital experience and hands-on involvement in new hospital commissioning, DHA licensing and inspection readiness, JCI accreditation, go-live and post-opening stabilisation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the Quality and Risk Management workstream through hospital commissioning, pre-opening, phased activation, go-live and operational stabilization.
* Establish and maintain the hospital-wide Quality Management System, Quality and Patient Safety Plan, governance framework, policies, procedures and reporting mechanisms.
* Lead DHA licensing, inspection and regulatory readiness, including gap assessments, compliance trackers, mock inspections, evidence files and corrective action follow-up.
* Drive JCI accreditation readiness through mock surveys, tracers, standards interpretation, evidence management and closure of identified gaps.
* Lead patient safety and clinical risk programmes, including incident reporting, adverse-event review, near-miss analysis, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) and risk registers.
* Develop and manage the hospital’s clinical and operational audit programme, leadership rounds, patient safety rounds and compliance monitoring activities.
* Establish quality indicators, KPIs and dashboards; ensure data validation, trend analysis, executive reporting and timely escalation of significant risks or performance gaps.
* Lead multidisciplinary improvement initiatives using recognised methodologies such as PDCA, PDSA, Lean, Six Sigma and DMAIC.
* Oversee policy development, document control, review cycles, approvals, version control and compliance with approved hospital policies and procedures.
* Monitor patient complaints, feedback, safety culture and service-quality indicators, and coordinate sustainable improvement actions.
* Build and lead the Quality and Risk team and collaborate closely with Medical, Nursing, Pharmacy, Operations, Infection Prevention and Control, Health Information Management, Facilities, IT, HR and other project stakeholders.

**Essential Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Management, Nursing, Medicine, Pharmacy, Allied Health, Quality Management, Public Health or a related healthcare discipline. A relevant Master’s degree is preferred.
* Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in healthcare quality, patient safety, clinical governance or risk management, including at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Proven UAE hospital experience; direct involvement in commissioning, opening, licensing, or major expansion of a hospital is highly desirable.
* Strong working knowledge of DHA requirements, JCI accreditation standards, patient safety principles, clinical governance and healthcare risk management.
* Demonstrated experience in mock surveys, tracers, clinical audits, incident investigations, RCA, CAPA, risk registers, quality indicators and executive dashboards.
* Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary quality-improvement projects and support organisational change in a complex hospital environment.
* Experience managing quality teams, governance committees, policies, training programmes, departmental budgets and regulatory or accreditation evidence.
* Professional certification such as CPHQ, CPPS, Lean Six Sigma, Lead Auditor/Internal Auditor or an equivalent healthcare quality or risk credential is preferred.
* Excellent leadership, analytical, communication, project-management, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Ideal Candidate**

**We are particularly interested in healthcare quality leaders who have successfully supported the commissioning and opening of a new hospital in the UAE and can establish the complete Quality and Risk function from the ground up.**

Candidates should demonstrate direct responsibility for DHA inspection readiness, JCI accreditation, Quality Management Systems, patient safety, incident investigation, RCA, CAPA, clinical audits, risk registers, KPIs, dashboards, policy management, and post-opening stabilisation.

**Please note: This position requires extensive hospital Quality and Risk leadership experience. Applicants without relevant hospital experience will not be considered.**

**Role Overview**
The Quality & After-Sales Manager is responsible for ensuring that yachts meet the company's quality standards throughout production, commissioning, delivery, and after-sales service.
  
  
The role focuses on identifying and resolving quality issues, managing customer complaints and warranty claims, coordinating repairs, and ensuring that recurring problems are addressed to improve the quality of future yacht builds.
  
  
The position requires close coordination with Production, Engineering, Project Management, Service, and other departments to maintain high-quality standards and customer satisfaction.

**2. After-Sales & Warranty Management**

**5. Team & Cross-Department Coordination**
**6. Reporting & Performance Monitoring**

* Quality Management & Control
* Oversee quality inspections during yacht construction, assembly, commissioning, and final delivery
* Ensure all work meets approved drawings, technical specifications, company standards, and applicable marine regulations
* Identify quality defects and nonconformities across structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, interior, and finishing works
* Monitor quality checkpoints at different stages of yacht production
* Coordinate with Production and Engineering teams to resolve quality issues before yacht delivery
* Ensure corrective actions are completed and verified within agreed timelines
* Maintain quality inspection records, defect reports, and corrective action documentation
* Manage after-sales service activities, warranty claims, and technical complaints received from yacht owners, captains, and service representatives
* Review reported defects and coordinate technical assessments to identify the cause of problems
* Plan and coordinate warranty repairs, maintenance, and rectification works with internal teams and external service providers

* Monitor outstanding warranty claims and follow up until successful closure
* Coordinate technical support for yachts operating in different locations when required
* Maintain proper records of warranty claims, repair costs, service history, and completed rectification works
* Investigate recurring quality defects and after-sales complaints to identify their root causes
* Determine whether defects originate from design, production, installation, materials, suppliers, or commissioning
* Work with Engineering, Production, and Procurement teams to implement corrective and preventive actions
* Ensure lessons learned from delivered yachts are applied to ongoing and future yacht projects
* Recommend improvements to production processes, inspection procedures, and quality standards
* Monitor recurring defects to reduce warranty costs, rework, and customer complaints
* Coordinate final quality inspections before yacht handover
* Ensure all identified defects and outstanding items are documented and resolved before delivery
* Work with Project Managers, Production, and Commissioning teams to ensure yachts meet delivery requirements
* Review punch lists and monitor the closure of outstanding items
* Support sea trials, technical inspections, and customer acceptance activities when required
* Ensure proper handover of quality records, warranty documentation, and outstanding service items to the after-sales team

* Track recurring defects and provide recommendations to management

+ Closure of corrective and preventive actions
+ Customer satisfaction and repeat complaints

jobs.title: Industry Technology Specialist (ITS) Technical Service: Distilling & Biofuel
jobs.description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
At Novonesis, we work in close partnership with our customers to create a better world every day. We use science and biosolutions to help industries improve performance and make better use of our planet’s resources.
  
  
Join our Grain Processing team within Planetary Health Biosolutions in Bangalore, India, where you will work alongside industry technology specialists and laboratory colleagues to support customers in the Distilling and Biofuel industry.
  
  
**The role & your impact**
As Industry Technology Specialist (ITS) – Distilling & Biofuel, you will provide technical service and expertise to customers in the grain processing, distilling, and biofuel industries.
  
  
You will lead plant trials and technical experiments, troubleshoot complex production challenges, analyze process data, and translate technical findings into practical recommendations. Through close collaboration with customers and cross-functional teams, you will help advance technical solutions and contribute to meaningful business outcomes.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities In This Role**

* Provide technical service and process expertise to grain-based ethanol and biofuel customers.
* Develop and lead experimental plans and plant trials and communicate findings and conclusions to support business development.
* Troubleshoot fermentation challenges, including stuck or sluggish fermentation, contamination, reduced ethanol yield, and yeast performance issues.
* Support optimization of grain milling, liquefaction, saccharification, fermentation, distillation, and DDGS processes.
* Optimize process parameters including temperature, pH, nutrient levels, and enzyme dosage to improve production efficiency.
* Support yeast strain selection, propagation, viability, vitality, and fermentation performance.
* Conduct root cause analyses using process data, trends, and statistical tools to address production deviations.
* Identify and help mitigate contamination through effective sterilization and CIP practices.
* Collaborate with customers and internal teams and share technical knowledge to help prevent recurring production challenges.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful In This Role**

* A Bachelor’s degree (BE/B.Tech), Master’s degree, or Ph.D. in Biotechnology, Food Technology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Chemical Engineering, Bioprocessing, or a related discipline.
* 5–10 years of professional experience in a grain-based distillery or biofuel production environment.
* Practical expertise in grain-based ethanol production processes.
* Experience with grain milling involving materials such as rice, corn, sorghum, or wheat, as well as liquefaction, saccharification, fermentation, distillation, and DDGS processes.
* Practical knowledge of yeast selection, propagation, viability, vitality, metabolism, and fermentation performance.
* Experience troubleshooting fermentation, yeast performance, contamination, and ethanol-yield challenges.
* Ability to develop and execute experimental plans and plant trials.
* Willingness and ability to travel frequently across India to provide technical services to ethanol-producing plants.

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including root cause analysis.
* Experience analyzing process and statistical data and managing technical data using Microsoft Excel or other relevant tools.
* Ability to clearly communicate technical findings and conclusions to customers and cross-functional stakeholders.
* A collaborative approach to technical problem-solving and knowledge sharing.
* A proactive approach to your work, with an interest in developing and implementing innovative technical solutions.

**What We Offer You**
You will join a collaborative technical environment where scientific expertise, innovation, and practical problem-solving come together. You will have opportunities to work closely with customers, cross-functional colleagues, and specialists while contributing to the development and application of biosolutions for the Distilling and Biofuel industry.
  
  
**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Opportunities for everyone**
We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.
  
  
We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.
  
  
**Explore Other Openings**
If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

jobs.title: Industrial Technical Consultant
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
Founded in 1923, Ecolab is the global leader in water, hygiene and energy technologies and services that protect people and vital resources. With 2022 sales of $13 billion and 48,000 associates, Ecolab delivers comprehensive solutions and on-site service to promote safe food, maintain clean environments, optimize water and energy use and improve operational efficiencies for customers in the food, healthcare, energy, hospitality, commercial laundry and industrial markets in more than 170 countries around the world.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Responsible for Providing technical consulting services that leverage NALCO Water’s intellectual property & assist sales force in increasing account revenue & profitability. Provides Expert advice and assistance to NALCO Staff & customers.
* Understands Nalco's application portfolio and the Industry processes directly impacted by these applications within chemical / power / primary metals industry segments, as well as understands the value of Nalco programs to the customer and has the ability to actively promote this value to the customer and within the organization.
* Working as technical resource with the local sales team & Application engineers to audit and assess customer operations to determine where Nalco chemical applications and digital technology can help improve operational efficiency, reduce total cost of operations, maximize productivity, improve finished product quality, reduce waste and improve safety.
* Conduct on-site audits to assess and solve customer problems or meet customer requirements on Water & Process applications. Summarize findings in a technical report and support the presentation of key findings and service reports during customer review meetings with value documentation and benefits
* Provides on-the-job product and sales training as appropriate and identifies training and reference materials needed for field sales training programs.
* Work with Marketing, RDE and Sales stakeholders to identify new products and program applications, potential innovations pipeline and appropriate promotion & training to sales team towards these new technologies after their launch.
* Actively participate in the development and commercialization of new programs by working with PLM, SBUs, sales and marketing management for the assigned product, application, and/or market. Participation includes field trial assistance, technical training development or rollout, and after commercialization sales support.
* Ability to track product margin on monthly basis and discuss with stakeholders during deviations, identify alternate products/Innovation to retain customers and product GM.
* Proactive in supporting & developing strategic market plan for specific segment/product which includes target customer segment, estimate market potential, competitor info, revenue plan, support required, etc.
* Assists in creating value documentation & value delivery tools to our sales team to identify and quantify value provided by Nalco programs. Work with SBUs, PLM and sales to implement value delivery projects at customer sites. Provide feedback on the performance of Nalco value delivery projects at customer sites.
* Develop case studies and participate in Industry seminars for showcasing technologies and paper submission.
* Maintains a high degree of technical knowledge of the industry / market segments by monitoring new developments, new products, new research, new concepts, etc. in the industry.
* Develop and grow water treatment applications business.
* Bring in new products/ chemistries/Technologies understanding customer challenges and addressing their key business drivers.
* Deploy Nalco technologies and digital solutions along with PAC products/chemistries.

**Skills And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree preferably in Chemical engineering or science or biotechnology (chemical, mechanical, industrial, chemistry, geochemistry)
* Strong background in water treatment chemistries and applications.
* Knowledge of water, wastewater plant operation and recycle systems.
* Knowledge of water automation, digital solutions, and managed operations.
* Knowledge in microbiology and environmental chemistry and local regulations.
* Experience in troubleshooting water and wastewater plants. (Ability to identify problems and guide sales team to resolve it)
* Agile, self-driven, and results oriented.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Role requires frequent domestic and international travel.
* Fluency in English is a must. Candidates with fluency in Arabic are preferred.

**Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion & Belonging**
Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin,citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.
